abra_flexi.atomic_progress: Documents appear in the target company only after loading and accounting checks finish. A cancelled or failed run leaves no partial transfer.
abra_flexi.blocked: The transfer contains blocking issues. Resolve the listed reasons before loading more data.
abra_flexi.catalog_progress: Products and positive stock are saved in batches. The next run skips saved cards; changed stock requires review.
abra_flexi.connection_help_save: Verify and save connection checks access and loads available accounting years. The source company ID must match the currently selected company in MyÚčto when transferring data.
abra_flexi.connection_help_url: Copy the HTTPS URL of the specific company from the ABRA Flexi web interface. It ends in /c/company_name or /flexi/company_name, without an evidence name or additional parameters.
abra_flexi.connection_help_user: Enter the ABRA Flexi username and password of a user with API access and permission to read this company's accounting data. A dedicated read-only user is recommended.
abra_flexi.credentials_hint: Enter the HTTPS company URL in ABRA Flexi and credentials of a user allowed to read data. Fields are cleared on submission. The server never returns saved credentials.
abra_flexi.failed: The operation failed. Refresh the status and retry the request.
abra_flexi.imported_hint: The initial transfer has already run. Subsequent loads add new data from the selected years and preserve links to transferred records.
abra_flexi.intro: Connect ABRA Flexi and transfer its records into the currently selected company.
abra_flexi.issue_unknown: The protocol contains a warning requiring review.

issues.bank_account_number_unavailable: Some bank accounts have no usable account number. Compare their movements with the source.
issues.bank_account_registration_rejected: A bank account could not be safely registered as belonging to this company. Review its ownership.
issues.bank_account_source_analytic_not_221: Some source bank accounts do not use a 221 analytic. They received their own 221 analytic in the target, but historical journal entries remain on the original account. Review their accounting classification.
issues.bank_movement_without_source_journal_req: Some imported bank movements have no source journal entry in ABRA Flexi. They remain for manual review and will not be posted automatically.
issues.cash_register_mapping_ambiguous: Source cash registers cannot safely be merged into one target register. The transfer stopped before creating movements.
issues.cash_vat_requires_review: A cash document contains VAT that cannot yet be transferred safely. The transfer stopped without saving documents.
issues.catalog_ean_skipped: An overlong EAN was not transferred.
issues.catalog_identity_invalid: A catalog item lacks a valid code or name and was not transferred.
issues.catalog_price_invalid: Some sale prices are missing or outside the supported range.
issues.catalog_price_rounded: Some source prices have more than two decimal places and were rounded to cents in the target.
issues.catalog_source_changed_requires_review: An imported item changed in the source. The target card was not overwritten.
issues.catalog_stock_flag_unknown: The stock flag is unclear for some items. Review their settings.
issues.catalog_target_changed_requires_review: An imported stock card changed in MyÚčto. It was not overwritten.
issues.catalog_target_conflict: Another target card already uses the product code. The item was not transferred.
issues.catalog_type_unsupported: Some catalog item types cannot be transferred safely.
issues.catalog_unit_defaulted: The unit ks was used for items without a source unit.
issues.catalog_unit_invalid: Some item units are too long.
issues.catalog_vat_rate_requires_review: A target VAT rate could not be assigned safely to some items.
issues.chart_evidence_missing: The source does not provide a chart of accounts.
issues.document_items_missing_snapshot_total_us: The source did not provide items for some documents. A replacement item was created from the document total.
issues.document_number_collision_requires_revie: Another target document already uses an issued document number. Review the original number.
issues.document_number_requires_review: An issued document number did not fit the target format. Compare it with the source before filing the control statement.
issues.document_payment_symbol_requires_review: The source payment symbol did not fit the target field. Review it on the document.
issues.document_snapshot_requires_review: Document amounts were preserved, but their tax classification is not fully transferred yet. Review before using VAT returns.
issues.document_source_total_mismatch_requires_: The source document total differs from its base and VAT. The document remains a draft; the source total is in its review note.
issues.document_tax_classification_requires_rev: Some items use VAT classifications that cannot be transferred safely. Their documents remain drafts.
issues.document_vat_projection_mismatch_require: The document tax base differs from current ABRA Flexi VAT data. Its tax was not changed automatically.
issues.document_vat_projection_target_modified_: The imported document was changed in the target. Source tax values were not applied automatically.
issues.document_vat_rate_outside_cz_schedule: A source document uses a rate outside the Czech schedule for its date. The item rate and amounts were retained; review the document.
issues.document_vat_rate_placeholder_requires_r: A source document uses a rate outside the target catalog. Its rate and amounts were retained, but review the rate before using the document.
issues.document_vendor_number_collision_require: Several received invoices share a vendor, number, and date. The target number was disambiguated; the original is in the document note.
issues.document_zero_quantity_requires_review: Some items have zero quantity but a nonzero amount. Review them on the transferred document.
issues.fiscal_year_mismatch: ABRA Flexi accounting periods start the accounting year in a different month than the company. Set the month in which the ABRA Flexi periods start in the company settings (Settings → Taxes and accounting → Accounting year starts) and run the transfer again.
issues.foreign_document_tax_requires_review: Foreign-currency documents need an exchange-rate and tax treatment review.
issues.journal_document_link_target_missing: A journal row has no matching document in the target. Its accounting entry remains intact.
issues.journal_evidence_missing: The source does not provide an accounting journal.
issues.journal_foreign_amount_missing: A foreign-currency bank or cash posting lacks its original-currency amount.
issues.journal_foreign_bank_transfer_ambiguous: A foreign-currency transfer between bank or cash accounts has ambiguous currency attribution. Review the source posting.
issues.journal_unchanged_reconciliation_skipped: The journal did not change. Repeated reconciliation was not needed.
issues.journal_zero_entries_skipped: Zero-value technical journal rows were skipped; their count is in the transfer report.
issues.opening_balance_changed: An opening balance changed after the initial transfer and needs manual review.
issues.opening_balance_evidence_missing: The source did not provide opening account balances. Review the first imported year's trial balance.
issues.opening_balance_unbalanced: Opening balances in the base currency do not balance.
issues.opening_balances_adjusted_to_source: Opening balances were adjusted with new journal entries to match ABRA Flexi. The original entries remain available for audit.
issues.opening_base_currency_missing: A foreign-currency opening balance has no matching base-currency accounting balance.
issues.opening_foreign_adjustment_requires_revi: A foreign-currency opening balance changed. An automatic adjustment could distort the exchange difference.
issues.opening_foreign_base_missing: A foreign-currency opening balance has no base-currency value.
issues.opening_foreign_currency_ambiguous: An account has opening balances in multiple foreign currencies and needs manual review.
issues.opening_target_integrity_failed: An imported opening journal entry changed in the target accounts.
issues.payment_cancelled_document_requires_revi: A payment link points to a cancelled target document. It remains cancelled and the link requires review.
issues.payment_cash_allocation_requires_review: A cash movement is only partly allocated to this document. The payment was not linked to avoid importing the full amount.
issues.payment_currency_conversion_requires_rev: A payment between different currencies requires manual matching. The bank movement, invoice, and accounting journal remain intact.
issues.payment_links_evidence_missing: The source does not provide payment links.
issues.source_cancelled_movement_requires_revie: A previously imported bank or cash movement was cancelled at the source. Review it before the next synchronization.
issues.source_cancelled_target_missing_requires: A cancelled source document has no matching target document. Review the transfer.
issues.source_cancelled_target_modified_require: The source document was cancelled, but the target document was edited or posted. Review its status.
issues.source_oss_extra_regime_requires_review: The source uses another OSS scheme that the target does not transfer automatically.
issues.source_period_label_mismatch: The ABRA Flexi accounting period is labelled with a different year than the one it starts in. MyÚčto labels a fiscal year by its starting year; such a period cannot be transferred.
issues.source_period_missing: The selected accounting period is missing in the source.
issues.source_record_changed: A previously transferred record changed in the source and requires manual review.
issues.source_target_ico_mismatch: The source and target company identifiers differ.
issues.source_trial_balance_missing: The source trial balance needed for reconciliation is missing.
issues.stock_card_invalid: A stock card is missing its product, warehouse, quantity, or valuation.
issues.stock_item_requires_review: The target product is inactive or uses unsupported inventory tracking.
issues.stock_negative_quantity_skipped: A stock card with negative quantity was not transferred.
issues.stock_negative_valuation_skipped: A stock card with negative valuation was not transferred.
issues.stock_quantity_precision_unsupported: A stock card quantity has more than three decimal places.
issues.stock_source_changed_requires_review: An imported stock balance changed at the source and was not overwritten automatically.
issues.storno_payment_movement_skipped: A cancelled bank or cash movement was not imported.
issues.target_date_locked: The opening balance date falls in a locked accounting period.
issues.target_not_double_entry: The target company must use double-entry accounting.
issues.target_period_closed: The target accounting period is closed.
issues.unsupported_document_link: Some links to orders, stock or internal documents are not converted into payments. The accounting journal remains intact.
issues.vat_projection_period_missing_requires_r: The VAT source data cannot be limited to the selected accounting periods. Compare the return with the source.
issues.vat_projection_unavailable_requires_revi: VAT source data is unavailable. Compare the return with the source.
issues.zero_amount_link_skipped: Zero amount relations connect documents; they are not payments. The accounting journal remains intact.

abra_flexi.scope_accounting_hint: Accounting periods and chart, partners, invoices and items, cash, bank transactions, payment links and the original accounting journal.
abra_flexi.scope_catalog_hint: Products, codes, units, catalog prices, and current nonnegative stock. Historical stock movements are not transferred. Cards with negative valuation require review.

abra_flexi.scope_warehouses_hint: Warehouses, inventory cards, stock and movements linked to products. This add-on cannot be enabled yet.
abra_flexi.security_help: Credentials are encrypted for the selected company and the source API is read only. Invoices with clear domestic VAT classification are imported as issued or booked without new automatic accounting or stock issues; uncertain tax treatment remains a draft for review. Verify VAT and period closing before filing.

abra_flexi.support_notice: This import is intended for smaller amounts of data. Migrations from other systems are not supported by their vendors and data exports differ between versions and installations, so {recommend}. As part of our paid service we will be happy to help with the migration and tailor it to your needs; it typically takes up to 10 hours at CZK 1,500/h + VAT. book.hint_de: Confirms tax depreciation for the year for all assets in use. Tax evidence posts nothing; confirmed depreciation enters expenses in the income tax return.

de_kind.032: Works of art and collections (not depreciated)

editor.acc_by_tax_hint: Accounting depreciation equals the tax one — annual, on the last day of the year. Useful life is not entered. Use only where the accounting and tax views genuinely do not differ (§28/6 of the Accounting Act).
editor.acc_prospective_hint: Changes to accounting parameters apply prospectively from the following month (CAS 013).
editor.accumulated_hint: Derived from the asset account; empty = non-depreciated asset (§27).
editor.dimensions_hint: Put into use, accounting depreciation and disposal take the card dimensions. A split between several values (e.g. 60/40) is set on the card detail. Left empty, the dimensions of the acquisition purchase invoice are used.
editor.err_acc_months: Accounting useful life in months is required for depreciated assets.
editor.err_extraordinary: Extraordinary depreciation §30a requires a zero-emission vehicle and first depreciator.
editor.err_historical_date: A historical asset requires a put-into-use date.
editor.err_tax_group: Depreciation group is required for straight-line and accelerated methods.
editor.extraordinary_hint: Extraordinary depreciation §30a: zero-emission vehicle acquired 2024–2028, first depreciator; 24 months (60 % / 40 %), no pausing, improvements do not increase the input price.
editor.historical_hint: The card is created directly in use with depreciation already claimed; the put-into-use entry is not posted (balances came in via opening balances).
editor.intangible_months_de_hint: Intangible assets are depreciated evenly by months over the period you enter (Section 24(2)(v) of the Income Tax Act). Choose it by the expected period of use and keep it documented.
editor.kind_de_hint: Nothing is posted in tax evidence. The type only decides whether the asset is depreciated.
editor.locked_hint: The field is locked — the depreciation method and input price cannot be changed once depreciation has started (§30/2 ITA).
editor.m1_limit_hint: M1 vehicle above {limit}: only a proportional part of depreciation is deductible (§30e).
editor.subtitle: Fixed asset card — tax and accounting depreciation parameters.
editor.tax_locked: Tax parameters are locked after the first confirmed depreciation (§30/2 ITA).

assets.empty: No asset cards match the filter.

hints.asset_vat_adjustment_evidence: For liquidation, shortage or damage, retain evidence of the disposal and verify any required input VAT settlement or adjustment (§77 and §78e of the Czech VAT Act).
hints.below_80k: Movable tangible assets up to CZK 80,000 need not be tax-depreciated assets (§26/2) — consider a one-off expense.
hints.donation_vat_output: For donated assets where input VAT was deducted, verify output VAT based on the open market value (§13(4)(a) and §36(6)(a) of the Czech VAT Act). Disposal does not create an internal tax document.
hints.improvement_manual_entry: Post the improvement to 02x / 042 with a manual journal entry — the card reflects it in depreciation and acquisition cost automatically.
hints.sale_invoice_641: Issue an invoice — the sale revenue (641, incl. VAT) is booked via an issued invoice, not the asset card.
hints.sale_invoice_de: Sale income is not recorded from the asset card. Issue an invoice; it enters the cash journal when it is paid.
hints.tz_below_80k: Improvements totalling up to CZK 80,000 per year are not a technical improvement per §33 — consider a one-off expense.

improvement.added: The technical improvement has been added.
improvement.err_fields: Completion date and a positive amount are required.

lifecycle.delete_confirm: Really delete the asset card? This action cannot be undone.
lifecycle.delete_in_use_confirm: Really delete the asset card in use? Its put-into-use journal entry will also be deleted. This cannot be undone and is allowed only without confirmed depreciation or technical improvements.
lifecycle.dispose_book: Post the disposal (net book value and removal from the register)
lifecycle.dispose_de_hint: Tax depreciation for the year of disposal is computed (half of the annual amount for straight-line and accelerated depreciation). The tax residual value of a sold or liquidated asset is included in expenses in the income tax return; for a donation it is not an expense and for damage only up to the compensation received.
lifecycle.dispose_no_book_hint: Without posting: the disposal is already in the journal (conversion from another program, manual 54x entry against accumulated depreciation). The card is linked to the disposal entry on the disposal date and the tax return takes the net book value from it.
lifecycle.download_card_error: Could not download the asset card.
lifecycle.pause_hint: Pausing tax depreciation per §26/8 — later years continue as if there had been no pause. Straight-line and accelerated methods only.
lifecycle.paused: Tax depreciation for {year} has been paused.
lifecycle.put_into_use_done: The asset has been put into use.
lifecycle.put_into_use_no_book_hint: Without posting — asset balances must already be in the books (opening balances, historical assets).
lifecycle.revert_confirm: Really revert the disposal? Reversal entries will be created and the disposal-year depreciation deleted.
lifecycle.unpaused: The pause for {year} has been cancelled.

override.clear_confirm: Remove the manual override of the {year} tax depreciation and restore the computed amount?
override.cleared: The override for {year} has been removed.
override.err_fields: A non-negative amount and a reason are required.
override.hint: Sets the year's tax depreciation manually, typically when taking over figures from an accountant who calculated them outside the program. The amount flows into the tax return (difference between book and tax depreciation, depreciation table in the appendix) and shifts the tax net book value. Bulk confirmation of depreciation does not overwrite it. The change is recorded in the activity log.
override.saved: The tax depreciation for {year} has been overridden.

balance_inventory.sign_hint: Book value and actual state are stated on the account's normal side — for liability, contra-asset and equity accounts that means a positive number. Accounts with no fixed side (±, e.g. 343 or 431) are stated signed: positive on debit, negative on credit.
balance_inventory.subtitle: Inventory list of balance-sheet accounts (classes 0–4) with the closing balance at the balance sheet date, documentation and signature space (Czech Accounting Act §29–30).

balance_sheet.negative_net_hint: The row's correction exceeds its gross amount. The allowance is most likely assigned to a different row than the receivable or asset it belongs to. Adjust the statement mapping overrides (correction following the receivable account).

closing.abort_confirm: Really abort the closing and return the period to the Open state?

approve.confirm_text_17_7: Once the financial statements are approved, the books can no longer be reopened (§17(7) of the Accounting Act). Corrections are made in the following period (§35).
approve.locked_hint: The statements are approved and the approval cannot be revoked (§17/7). Corrections are made in the period in which the error is found (§35).

archive.info: The archive contains the company's accounting data in JSON Lines format: periods, chart of accounts, journal, posting rules, assets, depreciation, invoices, bank and codebooks, including a manifest with SHA-256 checksums. PDF documents are not included (covered by the PDF backup).
archive.restore_note: Restoring an archive is a server-admin CLI helper only (api/bin/archive-restore.php, dry-run validation only) — it cannot be done from the application.
archive.subtitle: Per-company archival of accounting data — ZIP export with a manifest and checksums (§31/§32 of the Accounting Act).
archive.title: Accounting archive

assist.fields_required: Select a posting rule and fill in a positive amount and description.
assist.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
assist.reverse_confirm: Really reverse entry #{id}? A mirror entry will be created.

checks.property_reconciliation: Property subledger reconciles to the general ledger
checks.property_funding_reconciliation: Owner advances and income reconcile to the general ledger
checks.property_service_reconciliation: Property services reconcile to the general ledger
checks.accounts_unusual_side: Accounts with a balance on the unusual side (per account type)
checks.acquisition_04x_open: Non-zero balances of 041/042 — assets under construction
checks.assets_without_accumulated_depreciation: Assets on an account without booked accumulated depreciation
checks.attachment_mismatch: Documents that differ from their extracted attachment (amount, company ID, variable symbol or tax point day) — informative
checks.attachment_vat_period: Document tax point does not match its attachment and falls into another month — the document may be in the wrong VAT period and control statement
checks.cancelled_with_entry: Cancelled documents whose journal entry is still active (books and records contradict each other)
checks.card_clearing_open: Card payment clearing account (378.x) with a balance — unsettled card payments at the balance-sheet date
checks.card_payments_unmatched: Card payments without a document older than the limit in the card posting settings
checks.clearing_accounts_open: Clearing (suspense) accounts with an open balance at the balance-sheet date
checks.cnb_rate_deviation: Document exchange rate deviates from the daily CNB rate
checks.deposits_314_324_open: Unsettled advance accounts 314/324 at the balance-sheet date
checks.depreciation_missing: Assets in use without booked accounting depreciation for the year
checks.dimension_account_map_invalid: The account-driving dimension map points to an analytic account that no longer matches its synthetic account (parent, type or tax deductibility)
checks.dimension_account_unmapped: P&L entries left on a synthetic account with an account-driving dimension, without an analytic account (missing dimension value or mapping)
checks.drafts_in_period: Unposted journal drafts in the period
checks.entries_without_description: Posted journal entries with no description of the accounting case (§ 11(1)(b) of the Accounting Act) — add a description
checks.estimates_unreleased: Estimated liabilities/assets carried from the previous period were not released (CAS 019) — the cost may be booked twice
checks.fx_footprint_missing: Foreign-currency lines on an FX account without a complete currency footprint (currency_code/amount_foreign)
checks.income_tax_hint: Book the current income tax (591/341) via the Income tax closing step — CIT base report
checks.inventory_unresolved: Balance-sheet account stocktaking (§29–30 of the Accounting Act) is not completed or has unresolved differences
checks.journal_unbalanced: The period journal is not balanced (Σ Dr ≠ Σ Cr)
checks.nonprofit_tax_assessment: Current confirmed tax assessment of activities under Decree 504
checks.paid_advances_no_payment: Paid supplier advance invoices without a booked payment on 314
checks.paid_invoices_open_saldo: Paid issued invoices with an open balance on 311 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.paid_proformas_no_advance: Paid proformas without a booked received advance on 324
checks.paid_purchases_open_saldo: Paid purchase invoices with an open balance on 321 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.payment_match_audit: Matched payments that don't add up (currency, amount, FX difference, counterparty)
checks.pl_balance_before_period: Non-zero expense/revenue balances before the period start
checks.prior_period_open: The previous period is not closed
checks.procurement_111_131_open: Non-zero balances of 111/131 — unsettled procurement of materials/goods
checks.realized_fx_unbooked: Realized FX difference not booked to 563/663 (settled foreign-currency document)
checks.related_party_price_deviation: Prices charged to related parties differ from prices for unrelated ones (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act) — the difference must be documented
checks.related_party_transactions: Related-party transactions in the period — prices must match arm's-length prices (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act)
checks.section18_statements_required: The entity category also requires a cash flow statement and a statement of changes in equity (§ 18(2) of the Accounting Act) — without them the financial statements are incomplete
checks.settled_but_unpaid: Documents in the Sent state but with a payment already in the journal (update the status to Paid)
checks.small_asset_cards_incomplete: Small-asset cards do not match the 501.200 turnover (missing cards)
checks.transit_261_documented: Balance of 261 is documented by {count} open transfers ({amount})
checks.transit_261_open: Non-zero balance of 261 — Money in transit
checks.unposted_invoices: Issued invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.unposted_purchases: Received invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.vat_343_vs_return: Account 343 balance vs. VAT return for the period
checks.vat_clearing_stale: VAT clearing does not match the period turnover
checks.vat_period_entitlement: Entitlement to quarterly VAT period (§ 99a — prior-year turnover and registration year)
checks.vat_registration_due: Turnover exceeded the VAT registration threshold (§ 6 VAT Act) — liability arises by law; check the date and file the registration
checks.vat_status_s79_missing: VAT payer status changed during the period without a line-45 deduction adjustment (§ 79 deduction claim on registration / § 79a deduction reduction on deregistration) — assess the business assets as of the transition date and record any items in the VAT corrections agenda

close.blocked_not_closing: The books can only be closed after the closing has started (Closing state).
close.blocked_precheck: The books cannot be closed yet — the pre-checks report an error: {checks}. Fix it and run the checks again in step 1.
close.blocked_steps: The books cannot be closed yet — one of the previous steps is neither confirmed nor skipped.
close.confirm_text: Closing entries will be booked as of {date} (UZ document series) and period {year} will become Closed. The step can be undone until the financial statements are approved.
close.hint: Closes P&L accounts via 710 - Profit and loss account and balance sheet accounts via 702 - Final balance sheet account. Requires all preceding wizard steps completed or skipped and checks without errors.
close.journal_link: Show closing entries in the journal
close.override_reason_ph: E.g. document delivered after closing, will be posted in the next period
close.override_text: The period has unposted active documents. You may close the books over them only with a documented reason — the exception is recorded in the audit log and the closing package.

deferred_revenue.hint: From issued invoice lines marked with a from–to period whose revenue extends beyond the year end (annual subscriptions, rent, service contracts). The part belonging to future periods is computed pro rata by days and deferred to 384 (debit revenue account / credit 384). It is released automatically in the next year.
deferred_revenue.load_failed: Failed to load the deferred revenue preview.
deferred_revenue.no_items: No issued invoice lines in this period are marked for accrual.
deferred_revenue.title: Deferred revenue (384)

closing.depreciation_book_hint: Books accounting depreciation for every in-use asset card (551 / accumulated depreciation). Re-running overwrites the entries instead of duplicating them. Once the closing has started this is the only route — the Fixed assets module posts into an open period only.
closing.depreciation_hint: Verify that the year's accounting depreciation is booked (551 / accumulated depreciation).
closing.depreciation_link: Go to Fixed assets — Book depreciation
closing.depreciation_not_applicable: There was no depreciable asset in this period — the step resolves itself and does not block closing the books.

errors.bank_transfer_candidates: Bank transactions for this transfer exist — see the warning.
errors.closing_entries_exist: Closing entries exist — first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.
errors.closing_unbalanced_702: The closing entry is not balanced (final balance sheet account 702) — check the journal.
errors.cross_currency_manual_only: Confirm cross-currency transfers with a manual entry.
errors.missing_account: A required closing account is missing from the chart of accounts.
errors.opening_takeover_mismatch: The taken-over opening balances of the next year do not match the closing balances — review the differences table in the Open the new year step.
errors.period_gap: The following period does not immediately follow the closed period.
errors.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
errors.period_overlap: The period overlaps an existing period.
errors.precheck_errors_exist: Pre-closing checks contain errors — the books cannot be closed.
errors.previous_period_open: The previous period must be closed first.
errors.use_closing_workflow: Use the closing wizard — the status cannot be changed directly.
errors.version_conflict: The period was modified by another user — data has been reloaded.

estimates.none: No recurring cost with a missing invoice for the last month.
estimates.suggest_hint: The system finds recurring monthly costs (energy, rent, telco, cloud) whose invoice for the last month of the year is missing at the balance-sheet date, and proposes a passive estimate (389) equal to the average of the recent invoices. Review and confirm each proposal per vendor — the system never posts automatically.

fx.bank_section: Foreign-currency bank accounts and cash desks
fx.ledger_hint: The foreign-currency balance comes from the journal and is revalued automatically; nothing to enter.
fx.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
fx.no_bank_rows: No foreign-currency balances — add a row if you keep a currency account or cash desk.
fx.no_open_items: No open foreign-currency documents to revalue.

income_tax.amount_required: Enter a positive income tax amount.
income_tax.booked: Income tax payable has been booked.
income_tax.computed_from_ledger: Computed from the ledger (no finalized return) — verify before booking
income_tax.no_return: No finalized CIT return for the year — enter the amount manually per the tax-base adjustments report.
income_tax.not_applicable_fo: Personal income tax is not an expense of the accounting entity and is not posted to 591/341. Explicitly skip this step.
income_tax.stock_pending: The inventory close (step 8) has not run yet. Under method B the closing stock is removed from expenses, so the tax base will still change — do not rely on this figure yet. Book the inventory first, then come back.

open.confirm_text: The opening entry will be booked as of the first day of period {year} (OT document series).
open.done: The new year has been opened.
open.fx_reversal_created: The revaluation reversal was booked on the first day of the period.
open.fx_reversal_note: If the reversal of receivable/payable revaluation is enabled in settings, a mirror FX entry is booked on the first day of the new period (KR document series).
open.hint: Books opening balances of balance sheet accounts via 701 — Opening balance sheet account into the following period (created automatically if missing) and transfers the profit or loss to 431.

opening_takeover.compare_note: Accounts and dimension allocations are compared; 70x clearing accounts are skipped and account 431 is compared at the synthetic level.
opening_takeover.done_replaced: The taken-over opening balances were replaced with the calculated ones. Reason: {reason}
opening_takeover.done_taken_over: Opening balances taken over — they match on {count} accounts, nothing was booked.
opening_takeover.match_hint: The next year already has an opening entry from another source (data transfer or manual entry) and it matches the closing balances account by account. The step takes it over and books nothing new.
opening_takeover.mismatch_hint: The next year already has an opening entry from another source, but it does not match the closing balances. The year cannot be opened until the differences are resolved or the taken-over balances are explicitly replaced with the calculated ones.
opening_takeover.preliminary: Preliminary comparison — it becomes final after the books are closed.
opening_takeover.replace_button: Replace taken-over balances with calculated ones
opening_takeover.replace_reason_ph: E.g. the taken-over balances contained an error in receivables
opening_takeover.replace_text: The taken-over opening entries of the next year will be deleted (with an audit trail) and the calculated opening entry will be booked. State why the taken-over balances are not valid.
opening_takeover.revert_keeps: Undoing this step does not delete the taken-over entry.
opening_takeover.status_label: Opening balances of the next year
opening_takeover.to_create_hint: The next year has no opening entry yet; this step will book it.
opening_takeover.unavailable_hint: Closing balances cannot be calculated — run the checks in step 1.

payment_match_audit.counterparty_mismatch: Payment counterparty does not match the document counterparty
payment_match_audit.currency_mismatch: Payment currency does not match the document currency
payment_match_audit.fx_on_czk_czk: FX difference (563/663) booked on a CZK transaction against a CZK document

closing.precheck_empty: Checks have not run yet — start them with the button above.
closing.precheck_stale_hint: The check results are stale — data changed since they were saved (typically the previous period being closed). Run the precheck again; the errors shown below may no longer apply.

prepaid_expense.hint: From received-invoice lines marked with a from–to period whose cost extends beyond year-end (insurance, parking, subscriptions). The system pro-rates by days the part belonging to future periods and defers it to 381 (Dr 381 / Cr expense account). Released automatically in N+1.
prepaid_expense.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.
prepaid_expense.no_items: No invoice lines marked for time accrual in this period.
prepaid_expense.title: Prepaid expenses (381)

profit_distribution.already_booked: Profit distribution is already booked for this period.
profit_distribution.date_required: Enter the general meeting decision date.
profit_distribution.description: Distribution of profit / settlement of loss after approval (431 → 428/429, fund allocations, shareholder shares 364 + withholding tax 342). Booked into the open period.
profit_distribution.shareholder_row_hint: Each Shareholder shares row must represent one shareholder; withholding tax is rounded down separately for each shareholder.
profit_distribution.title: Profit distribution

provisions.none: No overdue receivables to create allowances for.
provisions.rule_hint: Statutory allowance proposal: §8c small receivables up to CZK 30,000 over 12 months → 100 %; §8a over 18 months → 50 %, over 30 months → 100 %. Adjust per receivable — the system never posts automatically.
provisions.save_before_page: Post your changes or reload the receivables before changing pages.
provisions.time_barred_warning: The receivable may be time-barred — verify debt acknowledgement or suspension of the limitation period.

reopen.text: Reopening a closed period touches closed accounting records and is recorded in the audit trail. If closing entries exist, first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.
reopen.title: Reopening period {year}

revert.confirm: Really undo this step? Its closing entries will be deleted (with an audit trail).

series.empty: No document series yet — they are created when the first number is issued.
series.format_hint: The number format is optional — an empty field means the built-in PREFIX-YYYY-CCCC. Placeholders (always in curly braces): PREFIX series prefix · YYYY 4-digit year · YY 2-digit year · C+ counter, the number of Cs sets the width. For example PREFIX and CCCCC in curly braces with prefix 26HP yields 26HP00011.
series.format_invalid: The number format must contain a counter — add e.g. CCCC in curly braces, otherwise numbers would repeat.
series.hint: Journal document series per year — the prefix, number format and next number are editable, numbers are issued sequentially and gaps after deleted entries are not reused.
series.next_number_invalid: The next number must be an integer between 1 and 999999999.
series.prefix_invalid: The prefix must be 1–10 uppercase letters or digits.
series.title: Document series

settings.avg_employees_hint: Goes into the corporate income tax return appendix (poc_zam) — the app does not compute headcount from payroll, fill it in manually.
settings.comparative_from_prior_year: Take the prior period of the statements from last year's closed statements
settings.comparative_from_prior_year_hint: The prior period column is built with the mapping exceptions valid in the previous year, i.e. the same way as the statements you filed for that year. Without this option the prior period is recalculated using the current year's classification; explain the change in the notes.
settings.fx_reversal_at_open: Reverse receivable/payable revaluation on the first day of the new period
settings.fx_reversal_at_open_hint: Unrealised FX differences on receivables and payables are reversed on the first day of the new year (the subledger keeps the document rate).
settings.manual_doc_series: Automatic document numbers for manual entries (ID series)
settings.manual_doc_series_hint: A manual entry without a document number gets one from the ID series.
settings.small_asset_accrual_hint: Accounting policy (§7 ZoÚ, optional): how small assets up to CZK 80,000 are spread onto 381. None = full cost in the year of acquisition; pro-rata = by acquisition date; flat = fixed % of the price. Pre-filled in the closing 'Accruals' step.
settings.statutory_audit: Subject to statutory audit (§20 of the Accounting Act)
settings.statutory_audit_hint: An audited entity always prepares full-scope statements (§3a of Decree 500/2002 Coll.).
settings.tax_authority_offset: Present taxes due to/from the tax office as a single net amount
settings.tax_authority_offset_hint: An overpayment of one tax (income tax, VAT, other taxes) is offset against an underpayment of another in the balance sheet, as allowed by Section 58(2) of Decree No. 500/2002 Coll. Disclose the net presentation in the notes; a suggested sentence is shown with the accounting principles. Without this option tax receivables and payables are presented separately.
settings.title: Closing & statement settings

small_asset.hint: Small assets are not depreciated — the whole cost hits 501 in the year of acquisition. Deferring part of it to 381 is an optional accounting policy (Sec. 7 of the Accounting Act), not a legal rule. Pick a mode and the system proposes the deferral; it is released automatically in the next year.
small_asset.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.
small_asset.materiality_hint: The flat rate is a policy only for an immaterial homogeneous set of small assets. Provide a documented materiality limit (base of 501 turnover); without it the flat rate cannot be used.
small_asset.materiality_missing: The flat rate requires a documented materiality limit — add one, or use pro-rata accrual.
small_asset.materiality_over: Base 501 ({base}) exceeds the materiality limit ({limit}) — the set is material, use pro-rata accrual.
small_asset.materiality_required: For the flat rate, enter a positive materiality limit (base 501).
small_asset.no_cards: There are no small asset cards to accrue in this period.
small_asset.posted: Small asset accrual has been posted.
small_asset.title: Small asset accrual

deferred_tax.title: Deferred tax
deferred_tax.description: Voluntary evidenced method with separate asset and liability presentation.

close_books.description: Closing P&L accounts via 710 and balance sheet accounts via 702, determining the profit or loss (CAS 002).
close_books.title: Close the books

deferrals.description: Prepaid and accrued items (381–385) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.
deferrals.title: Accruals & deferrals

depreciation.description: Booking of the year's accounting depreciation (Fixed assets module, CAS 013).
depreciation.title: Asset depreciation

estimates.description: Estimated receivables and payables (388/389) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.
estimates.title: Estimated items

fx_revaluation.description: Revaluation of foreign-currency receivables, payables and currency accounts at the CNB rate as of the balance sheet date (§24/6+7 Accounting Act, CAS 006) — accounts 563/663.
fx_revaluation.title: FX revaluation

income_tax.description: Booking of the income tax payable (591/341) as of the balance sheet date — amount from the finalized corporate income tax return / tax-base adjustments report. Optional step.
income_tax.title: Income tax

open_next.description: Opening balance sheet accounts via 701 and transferring the profit or loss to 431 in the following period.
open_next.title: Open the new year

precheck.description: Completeness checks before closing — drafts, unposted documents, technical account balances.
precheck.title: Pre-closing checks

provisions.description: Allowances for overdue receivables (§8a/§8c Reserves Act) — proposed from the aging ledger, statutory allowance (558) and accounting allowance beyond it (559) against 391. Optional step.
provisions.title: Receivable allowances

stock.description: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015) — posting the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (112/501, 132/504), reclassifying inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648.
stock.title: Inventory

stock.closing_title: Closing stock as of the balance sheet date
stock.hint: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015): posts the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (materials 112/501, goods 132/504, products 123/583), reclassifies inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648. The opening stock is charged to consumption when the new year is opened.
stock.needs_closing: This step becomes available once closing has started (status Closing).
stock.no_data: No data yet — post the step with the button below; the system computes the closing stock from stock records.
stock.not_applicable: The company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping — the inventory step is skipped automatically and does not block closing the books.
stock.skipped: The inventory step was skipped (the company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping).

closing.title: Period closing

transfer.bank_candidates_warning: A bank transaction for this transfer exists — post it from the statement; a manual entry would duplicate it.
transfer.fields_required: Fill in both accounts, a positive amount and both dates.
transfer.hint: Two legs of a transfer via 261 — Money in transit: dispatch (Dr 261 / Cr from-account) and receipt (Dr to-account / Cr 261). Both legs share a PP-series document number.
transfer.same_accounts: The source and target accounts must differ.
transfer.title: Transfer between accounts (261)

closing_package.include_xlsx: Also include XLSX (except VAT book, tax return and §38a advances notice, which are PDF/XML only)

job.in_progress: Package is already being prepared — please wait.
job.started: Package is being prepared in the background (job #{jobId}).
job.warnings_notice: Done with warnings — {count} optional part(s) could not be built. The mandatory core is complete; see README and manifest.json in the package for details.

closing_package.notes_incomplete_hint: The notes to the financial statements can be completed in the editor — filled-in sections are included the next time the package is generated.

parts.income_tax_report: Income tax return report (PDF, working copy, not a filing)

cost_centers.code_auto: Filled in automatically from the name; you can override it.
cost_centers.code_immutable: The code cannot be changed after creation because it may be used in journal entries.
cost_centers.deactivated_due_to_usage: The cost center is used in journal entries or templates, so it was only deactivated.
cost_centers.delete_confirm: Remove cost center "{code}"? A used cost center will only be deactivated.
cost_centers.empty: No cost centers have been created yet.
cost_centers.name: Name
cost_centers.required: Enter both the cost center code and name.

error.duplicate_account: An account with this code already exists.
error.duplicate_period: A fiscal period for this year already exists.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
error.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
error.unbalanced_entry: The entry is not balanced (Dr ≠ Cr).

expense_rules.amount_hint: Narrows the match by unit price per piece without VAT. Not a criterion on its own.
expense_rules.application_mode_hint: Rules created by the assistant start safely as suggestions. Enable automatic mode only after verification.
expense_rules.criteria_hint: Fill at least one of: vendor, vendor name or item description. An amount band alone does not make a rule.
expense_rules.err_amount_band: Invalid amount band — minimum is greater than maximum.
expense_rules.err_criteria_missing: Fill at least one criterion: vendor, vendor name or item description.
expense_rules.err_generic: The operation could not be completed.
expense_rules.err_recurring_prepaid_tax_evidence: Prepaid annual subscriptions are not accrued in tax evidence.
expense_rules.err_target_account: Invalid target account — it must not be an open-item, VAT or bank account, and the account must be active.
expense_rules.err_target_account_tax_evidence: In tax evidence a rule sets no account, only the kind and tax deductibility of the expense.
expense_rules.err_vendor_not_found: The selected vendor was not found.
expense_rules.form_help: A rule applies when ALL filled criteria match (AND). The first one by priority wins.
expense_rules.kind_hint: Drives the expense account: Service → 518, Material → 501, Small asset → 501 + register card, Fixed asset → 042 and depreciation.
expense_rules.kind_hint_tax_evidence: Long-term assets are not an expense when paid (depreciation applies instead); small assets are added to the small-asset register.
expense_rules.subtitle: Pre-fills the expense kind on received-invoice lines by vendor or text. When a rule matches it suggests the kind (and optionally the account); posting stays up to you.
expense_rules.target_account_hint: Set only when the account differs from the kind — e.g. insurance is a Service but books to 548. Empty = derived from the kind.
expense_rules.tax_deductible_hint: Set when the document is received, only if automatic rules match all of its items and agree. The cash journal uses it to sort the payment into deductible or non-deductible expenses.
expense_rules.title: Expense rules

finding_remedy.error: The entry could not be saved.
finding_remedy.gone: The finding no longer exists — it was most likely resolved in the meantime. Close this window and re-run the check.
finding_remedy.no_proposal: The data does not imply a single correct treatment here — it may be a partial payment, an overpayment, or a wrong match. Enter the entry manually; anything else would be a guess for you to rubber-stamp.
finding_remedy.reversal_only: This calls for a reversal, not an additional entry — which is why the proposal has no lines.
finding_remedy.title: Posting a correction

fx_rates.mode_hint: Switching applies to the future only — already posted documents keep the rate fixed on the header.
fx_rates.prefill: Fetch from CNB (first day of period)
fx_rates.prefilled: CNB rate as of {date} filled in.

general_ledger.empty: No accounts with movement or opening balance in the selected range.
general_ledger.month_expand_hint: Click a month to show its journal lines.
general_ledger.month_more: Showing the first {shown} of {total} lines — continue in the account statement.

journal.already_reversed: The entry has already been reversed.
journal.att_drop: Drop files here or click Add attachment
journal.att_duplicate: This attachment already exists on the entry (duplicate).
journal.bank_deleted: The bank entry was deleted and the transaction returned to the unposted queue.
journal.delete_bank_confirm: Really delete bank entry #{id}? No reversing entry will be created and the transaction will return to the unposted queue.

posting_backfill.explainer_body: Automatic posting is a hook on document CREATION — it fires when an invoice is issued, a purchase invoice is received or a recurring invoice is generated. A document that is already in the system (typically imported from another system) never passes through it, no matter how automation is set. This job is the only way to post such documents in bulk; it posts them with the same code as the accounting activation wizard.
posting_backfill.explainer_title: Why turning on automation is not enough
posting_backfill.scope_hint: The job posts issued and purchase invoices. Cash, bank and settlements are posted through their own paths.

posting_errors.advance_payment_only: An advance document is not posted as a liability. Post its bank or cash payment to account 314 instead.
posting_errors.advance_settlement_ambiguous: The advance has several tax documents for payment, so the advance VAT to deduct cannot be determined unambiguously. Check the links between the advance and its tax documents for payment.
posting_errors.advance_tax_document_oss: The tax document for the payment received carries OSS VAT only and is not posted on its own (under OSS no tax document is issued for an advance). Cancel it and issue the final invoice without it, or settle the advance with a manual entry.
posting_errors.advance_tax_document_unposted: The tax document for the payment received on this advance is not posted. Post it before the final invoice, otherwise the advance would be settled against VAT that is not on the account yet.
posting_errors.date_locked: The entry date falls into the locked part of the books. An admin can move the lock in accounting settings.
posting_errors.ddkp_reverse_charge_unsupported: A tax document for payment under the reverse-charge regime is not posted automatically — post the VAT with a manual entry.
posting_errors.document_not_postable: The document has no lines to post (e.g. proformas, advances or reversals are not posted).
posting_errors.empty_entry: The document has no lines to post.
posting_errors.entry_reversed: The document's entry has been reversed — post a correction as a new entry.
posting_errors.generic: The document could not be posted.
posting_errors.missing_exchange_rate: The foreign-currency document has no exchange rate — fill in the rate for the accounting date.
posting_errors.no_accounting_period: No accounting period exists for the document date — create one first in Accounting → Closing.
posting_errors.period_missing: The accounting period for the document year does not exist — create it first in Accounting → Closing.
posting_errors.period_not_open: The accounting period is closed — it cannot be posted into.
posting_errors.repost_date_shift_confirmation_required: The original date is closed or locked — confirm that both the reversal and the correction will land on a different date.
posting_errors.unbalanced_entry: The journal entry is not balanced (debit ≠ credit) — check the posting rule and document amounts.
posting_errors.unknown_account: A required account is missing from the chart of accounts — check the posting rule or seed the chart.

repost.blocked_date_locked: The books are locked up to {date}, today included, so there is nowhere to write the correction. An admin can move the lock in accounting settings.
repost.blocked_period_not_open: The original entry sits in a “{status}” period and there is no open accounting period for today — there is nowhere to write the correction. Open a period in Accounting → Closing.
repost.confirm_date_shift: I understand that the reversal and the correction will be posted on {to} instead of the original {from}.
repost.dimensions_hint: Dimensions are analytics only. “Save dimensions only” applies them to the entry lines without a reversal and without changing accounts or amounts, even in a closed period. With a re-post they are saved together with it.
repost.dimensions_preview: Entry lines after saving the dimensions
repost.dimensions_refused: The dimensions cannot be saved like this: the document items have different dimensions, there is only one posted line and the entry sits in a closed or locked period. Splitting the line would change amounts, which only a re-post may do.
repost.hint: The entry must balance (Σ debit = Σ credit). Double entry, period status and the date lock are enforced by the server — re-posting does not change VAT, that is corrected by editing the document.
repost.proposal_from_rule: The counter account is prefilled from the new rule. Review it and repost.
repost.reason_date_locked: The books are locked up to {date} — nothing may be written into a locked date.
repost.reason_entry_reversed: The original entry has already been reversed, so the correction goes in as a new entry.
repost.reason_period_not_open: The original entry sits in a “{status}” period — closed periods must not be touched.
repost.reverse_because: It cannot be rewritten in place because {reason}.
repost.strategy_replace: The existing entry will be rewritten — its current lines are deleted and these are written instead.
repost.strategy_replace_in_place: The entry is rewritten in place on {date}, without a reversal. It only moves amounts between accounts with no tax impact.
repost.strategy_reverse: The existing entry is not deleted: it is reversed by a mirror entry and the correction is written as a new entry. Both stay in the journal (§35 of the Accounting Act).
repost.tax_neutral_available: The entry date is locked up to {lock} by a filed VAT return, but the year is not closed. If the correction only moves amounts between accounts (e.g. 511 → 518.100, merging a discount into the goods) and does not change VAT, the payable, the receivable or cash, the entry is rewritten in place on {date}, without a reversal. Once the income tax return for the year is filed, only within the same account class and without changing tax deductibility. Otherwise a reversal and a new entry are posted. The lines you edit decide.

repost.violation_tax_account_changed: VAT or another tax account (34x) changes
repost.violation_tax_deductibility_changed: the income tax return is filed and tax deductibility changes

A hold under § 32 keeps records even after the period expires — use it during a tax audit, appeal or litigation; it cannot be placed without a documented file number or proceeding description.

byFunction.explainer_body: Classification by nature can be derived from the account number; by function it cannot — costs are classified by the function they serve, and the account number does not carry that. The same Services account may be cost of sales at one company and administrative overhead at another. Until the mapping is complete the statement will NOT be produced — an unassigned cost would silently drop out and overstate both gross profit and the result.
byFunction.explainer_title: Why this statement needs your input
byFunction.incomplete_title: The statement cannot be produced yet
byFunction.map_empty: No account has been assigned yet.
byFunction.map_hint: Mapping can also be done per analytic account (511.100 distribution, 511.900 administration) — longest-prefix wins.
byFunction.subtitle: Decree 500/2002 Coll., Annex 2 Part II (§ 39b)
byFunction.title: Income statement — by function
byFunction.unassigned_title: Accounts with turnover that are not assigned

mapping.differences_title: Differences in the return appendix (CZK thousands)
mapping.empty: The company has no accounts for this statement.
mapping.explainer_body: The global map places an account by its synthetic number. The regulation, however, leaves the company choices the account number cannot express: a shareholder loan due in more than a year belongs to long-term liabilities, income and expenses towards a controlled or controlling entity go to their own sub-rows, and a specific analytic account may belong elsewhere than its synthetic account. An exception applies only to this company and is used by the balance sheet, the income statement, their exports and the corporate income tax return appendix.
mapping.follows_hint: The allowance goes to the row where the statement places the given receivable account, even after you reclassify it. The selected row applies only if the receivable account is not in the map.
mapping.inherited_hint: The exception for group {prefix} applies; edit it in the account group exceptions below the table. Choosing another row here adds an exception for this account only.
mapping.note_placeholder: Reason for the exception, e.g. maturity
mapping.orphans_hint: The exception applies to every account whose number starts with the prefix. A specific account can have its own exception, which takes precedence.
mapping.other_years_hint: These exceptions are limited to other years. For one account and balance side the validity years of exceptions must not overlap.
mapping.preview_disabled: First change the row of some account.
mapping.preview_empty: The changes do not move any statement row.
mapping.preview_unbalanced: After the change the balance sheet would not balance.
mapping.prior_hint: The filed return also carries the previous period column. These exceptions apply up to {year}; an existing exception of the same account is limited to later years. The previous period column uses them when taking it from last year's closed statements is enabled in the closing settings.
mapping.subtitle: Company exceptions to the global balance sheet and income statement map

mapping.suggestions_other_tab: Further suggestions concern the other statement: {count}.
mapping.suggestions_source_filed: Compared with the filed return for {year}.

The accountant enters the tax base adjustment into the return manually — the system does not apply anything on its own. Add valuables manually.

aiGateway.bulk_hint: Other companies where you may change AI settings get the same provider, key, model, data region, EU residency and reasoning level. Extraction notes stay specific to each company. The key is tested only once, on this company. A company that requires EU data residency never receives a setup that is not EU capable.
aiGateway.bulk_none: No other company to save to.
aiGateway.bulk_not_applied: The key test failed, nothing was saved to other companies.

aiGateway.bulk_skipped_forbidden: Skipped, you may not change AI settings: {n}

aiGateway.client_extraction_hint: Clients with permission to extract and enter purchase invoices can use this company’s AI. The active provider must be configured. Extraction creates a draft for the client to review and mark as received, just like manual entry.
aiGateway.client_extraction_limit_hint: The purchase document extraction limit is shared by all clients of this company. The default is 100 attempts per month; 0 blocks extraction.
aiGateway.client_extraction_limit_reached: The monthly client purchase document extraction limit has been reached. Enter further documents manually, wait for the next month or ask your accountant to increase the limit.
aiGateway.client_extraction_monthly_limit: Monthly client purchase document extraction limit

aiGateway.client_extraction_usage: Purchase document extraction for {period}: {used} of {limit} attempts, {remaining} remaining.
aiGateway.client_extraction_usage_hint: Each valid purchase document file submitted for processing uses one attempt, including errors, duplicates and ISDOC imports. Attempts are not refunded; usage resets each calendar month. AI billing depends on the provider.
aiGateway.credentials_hint: BYOK — paste your own API key. The key is write-only (never shown). Empty field = keep existing key.
aiGateway.effort_hint: More accurate means slower and more expensive. Models without the knob ignore it.
aiGateway.err_key_anthropic: The Anthropic API key must start with "sk-ant-".
aiGateway.err_key_openai: The OpenAI API key must start with "sk-".
aiGateway.key_link: Sign up and get an API key:
aiGateway.no_key_badge_title: This provider is selected for the company but has no stored API key. AI extraction is not running yet.
aiGateway.not_active_hint: Extraction runs through {active}. Saving switches it to {provider}.
aiGateway.not_active_hint_no_key: The selected provider {active} has no stored key, so extraction is not running yet. Saving switches it to {provider}.
aiGateway.not_configured_ask_admin: Only a company administrator can change the AI settings, ask them to add the key.
aiGateway.not_configured_body: The company has no stored API key for an AI provider, so an invoice PDF without ISDOC cannot be extracted. Create a key with a provider (e.g. Anthropic) and paste it in the AI settings. It takes a few minutes.
aiGateway.not_configured_title: AI extraction is not set up
aiGateway.notes_hint: Free text for the AI — what the model cannot know about your invoices. Never overrides extraction rules.
aiGateway.notes_placeholder: E.g.: Vendor ACME puts the variable symbol in the Reference field. Invoices from Ireland carry no VAT.
aiGateway.ollama_api_key_hint: Only if Ollama sits behind a reverse proxy with Bearer authentication. Changing the address deletes the saved key.
aiGateway.ollama_base_url_hint: Only http(s)://host:port, no path. From Docker usually http://host.docker.internal:11434. Host names with an underscore (_) are not accepted — use the IP address or a name without "_".
aiGateway.ollama_model_missing: The saved model {model} is no longer in Ollama.
aiGateway.ollama_models_empty: Ollama at this address has no models. Download one with ollama pull.
aiGateway.ollama_no_vision_warning: This model cannot read images — it only extracts PDFs with a text layer, not scans or photos.
aiGateway.ollama_onboarding_step1: Install Ollama and download a model that reads images with ollama pull.
aiGateway.ollama_onboarding_step2: Enter the address Ollama runs on and load the models.
aiGateway.ollama_onboarding_step3: Choose a model and save — a connection test runs.
aiGateway.onboarding_intro: The app can extract the vendor, amounts and line items from a PDF or photo of an invoice without ISDOC. It needs your own API key from an AI provider, whom you pay directly based on usage.
aiGateway.onboarding_step1: Create an account with {provider} and set up billing (top up credit or add a payment card). The key will not work without it.
aiGateway.onboarding_step2: Create a new API key and copy it. It is shown only once.
aiGateway.onboarding_step3: Paste the key into the field below and click Save. The key is tested right away.
aiGateway.onboarding_step4: Done, then upload PDF invoices in Purchase invoices via AI import.
aiGateway.onboarding_title: How to enable AI invoice extraction
aiGateway.openai_base_url_hint: For EU data residency set https://eu.api.openai.com (project data residency).
aiGateway.privacy_body: The uploaded PDF content (incl. line items, vendor VAT IDs and your own data) is sent over HTTPS to the selected AI provider's servers. When EU data residency is enforced, routing is restricted to EU-capable combinations. For sensitive documents consider ISDOC import (data stays local).
aiGateway.residency_conflict: The selected provider/config does not support EU residency — choose an EU-capable combination or add an EU endpoint.
aiGateway.warn_not_configured: The selected provider has no configured credentials — extraction will not work.

api_tokens.confirm_delete: Permanently delete the token "{name}"? It disappears from the list and its API log calls lose their attribution. This cannot be undone.
api_tokens.confirm_delete_active: The token "{name}" is active and probably in use. Deleting it cuts access immediately and leaves no record in the list — its API log calls lose their attribution. This cannot be undone. To only stop access, use Revoke instead. Really delete?
api_tokens.confirm_revoke: Really revoke the token "{name}"? Clients using it will stop working.
api_tokens.created_confirm: I've saved the token safely and understand I won't see it again.
api_tokens.created_warning: The plain-text token is shown only once. Save it to a password manager — you won't see it again.
api_tokens.delete_hint: Permanently removes the token from the list. Revoking instead keeps the record and the call history.
api_tokens.empty: You haven't created any API tokens yet.
api_tokens.expires_hint: Without a date the token is valid for 90 days (max 730 days).
api_tokens.intro: Tokens let you call MyÚčto.cz REST API without a browser. Endpoint reference:
api_tokens.invite_failed: The user was created, but the password link could NOT be sent. Check outgoing mail and resend the link from the user detail.
api_tokens.invite_sent: User created. We have emailed them a link to set their password.
api_tokens.ip_current: Your IP address as seen by the application:
api_tokens.ip_current_hint: This is the address of this browser. An integration or MCP client may connect from a different IP address.
api_tokens.ip_empty: No rules yet — the token works from anywhere.
api_tokens.ip_hint: Supports IPv4 and IPv6, a single address as well as a CIDR range — e.g. 203.0.113.7, 192.168.1.0/24, 2001:db8::1, 2001:db8::/32.
api_tokens.ip_intro: An empty list means no restriction — the token works from any address. Once you add the first rule, only calls from the listed addresses and ranges get through.
api_tokens.ip_private_warning: The application sees a private, local or shared IP address. This may be correct on an internal network. If you connect over the internet through a reverse proxy, check that the real client IP is forwarded; otherwise IP restrictions may only distinguish the proxy.
api_tokens.ip_proxy_docs: Configure client IP forwarding behind a proxy and in Docker
api_tokens.name_required: Give the token a name so you remember what it's for.
api_tokens.never_expires_hint: Not recommended. Only a superadmin can create a non-expiring token with write access.
api_tokens.passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use TOTP if configured for the account; a passkey-only account must use a supported browser or an administrator.
api_tokens.password_hint: Confirm it's really you — an active session alone isn't enough to issue an API token.
api_tokens.password_invite_hint: Leave empty and we will email the user a single-use link so they set the password themselves. You will not know it.
api_tokens.password_invite_placeholder: leave empty and we will send a link
api_tokens.password_link_sent: Link sent to the user’s e-mail.
api_tokens.password_required: Enter your current password to create a token.
api_tokens.payroll_docs_desc: Lets the token see data box delivery receipts, social security protocols and health insurer responses. It does not unlock health data, garnishments, insolvency or payslips — those stay browser-only.
api_tokens.scope_read_desc: Read-only (GET). Good for reporting, BI exports.
api_tokens.scope_read_write_desc: Full API — create invoices, clients, issue documents.
api_tokens.step_up_hint: Verify your identity again before creating the token.
api_tokens.step_up_required: Verify with a passkey or enter a valid TOTP code.
api_tokens.subtitle: Personal Access Tokens for automation and integrations (Make, Zapier, custom scripts).
api_tokens.supplier_all: All suppliers (token switches via X-Supplier-Id header)
api_tokens.supplier_hint: A token bound to a specific supplier can't access data from other companies. Recommended.
api_tokens.title: API tokens
api_tokens.totp_hint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app (step-up security).

analytics.explainer_body: Accounts are detected from statements and settings. Every bank account has its own 221xxx sub-account (221100, 221200 …) assigned automatically; you can override it, for example to map an account onto a sub-account you already keep in the chart. The journal, balance sheet and stocktaking then break cash down per account.
analytics.series_explainer: The document series numbers bank entries in the journal: the document number is the series plus the statement month (e.g. BCR-08 for the August statement). The number does not depend on whether the movement came from a daily statement, a monthly statement or a re-import. After changing the series, entries in open periods are renumbered; closed periods stay unchanged.

posting.unposted_hint: All actual bank transactions without an active journal entry, including transactions for which no posting suggestion was created.

bank.processing_failed_summary: Statements with unprocessed transactions: {count}. They are marked in the list, open them and use “Re-match statement”.
bank.processing_failed_text: The statement was saved, but for {count} transactions the takeover from e-mail notices, matching to documents and posting could not be completed after import. Uploading the file again will not process them. Use “Re-match statement”.

purchase_shortfall.intro: {amount} remains to be paid after matching. The document stays partially paid. You can leave the difference to be paid later, or settle it right away as a set-off against the chosen account (typically 648/548, 663/563 for a foreign currency).
purchase_shortfall.partial_info: The payment did not cover the whole invoice, {amount} remains to be paid. The document stays partially paid.

bank.rematch_confirm: Re-run automatic matching on all unmatched transactions of this statement? Useful when you've added purchase or sales invoices after the statement was imported.
bank.rematch_done: Re-matched: {matched} newly matched, {partial} partial, {remaining} still unmatched.
bank.rematch_superseded: Unmatched e-mail notices superseded by the official statement: {count}. You can find them among ignored transactions.
bank.scan_done: Scan complete: found {scanned}, imported {imported}, duplicates {duplicate}, errors {errors}

bank.split_hint_all: Combinations of one client’s invoices adding up to this payment (no date limit — for enforced or otherwise late settlements).
bank.split_none: No combination of a single client's invoices matches the payment amount.
bank.split_purchase_hint: Purchase invoice combinations for this payment, including invoices from different vendors (window ±{days} days).

bank.split_purchase_none: No purchase invoice combination matches the payment amount.
bank.split_reconcile_hint: Invoice is already paid — matching only links its existing payment to this transaction (no new payment is created).
bank.split_title: Combined payment (several invoices in one payment)

bank.statement_delete_evidence_confirm: Really delete this source statement including its transactions? Their postings will be reversed and the monthly statement recalculated.
bank.statement_delete_evidence_hint: Deletes this source statement of the monthly API statement together with its own transactions, for example a duplicate from a repeated download. Posted transactions are reversed and the monthly statement is recalculated.
bank.statement_delete_hint: Delete this e-mail-notice statement and its transactions. Allowed only when it has no matched items (the official GPC statement took the matches over).

bank.statement_delete_has_matches: The notice statement has matched items. You can delete it once the official statement takes them over or after you unmatch them.
bank.notice_superseded_hint: The same transaction is on the official bank statement, which carries the payment. The notice is resolved and is not matched automatically again.

bank_accounts.allow_forwarded_hint: If this mailbox receives forwarded notices (the sender is your own address, not the bank), the bank is detected from the e-mail body too. Leave off when notices arrive straight from the bank. Forwarding destroys the bank's original DKIM signature — only the forwarder below is verified, not the bank.
bank_accounts.balances_empty: No verifiable balances are available yet. Import a bank statement or complete the accounting migration.
bank_accounts.balances_missing_rates: No ČNB rate, could not convert to CZK: {codes}
bank_accounts.balances_monthly_subtitle: Closing balance per month in the account's currency (last 3 years).
bank_accounts.balances_source_api_hint: Balance as of the latest API statement, calculated from a bank balance and subsequent transactions when needed.
bank_accounts.balances_source_email_hint: Available balance from an e-mail bank notice (newer than the latest bank statement).
bank_accounts.balances_source_import_hint: Calculated from an opening balance checked against ABRA Flexi and imported bank movements. This is not a bank-confirmed statement.
bank_accounts.balances_subtitle: Latest balance from a statement, bank API, e-mail notice or accounting migration.
bank_accounts.balances_total_subtitle: Individual accounts and their total converted to CZK at the ČNB month-end rate.
bank_accounts.bank_lookup_pick: Pick another account from the register:

bank_accounts.currencies_subtitle: Supplier bank accounts used on documents and bank statements.
bank_accounts.default_for_currency: Default account for this currency (only one per code)
bank_accounts.delete_imap_confirm: Delete IMAP account {name}? Processed records will be kept.
bank_accounts.delete_message_confirm: Delete processing record #{id}? The transaction and invoice will not be deleted.
bank_accounts.distribute_owner: Distributes within the permissions of {name}, companies: {n}
bank_accounts.distribute_to_suppliers_hint: Statements and payment notices go to the company that owns the account number. Every PDF in the folder except statements, receipts included, goes to incoming documents. A document goes to the company matching the buyer's company ID or VAT ID; the rest stay in this company and you move them by hand. Applies to the companies you can write to.
bank_accounts.email_auth_serv_id_hint: Enter your receiving server's identifier from the first Authentication-Results header. The server must remove forged authentication results. With verification enabled, messages are rejected if this identifier is empty.
bank_accounts.email_notices_question: Do you want to load bank notices, PDF invoices and PDF statements from e-mail via IMAP? Click to expand the settings.
bank_accounts.email_notices_title: Bank notices and PDF documents from e-mail (IMAP)
bank_accounts.folders_none: Connection works but the server returned no folders.
bank_accounts.forwarded_from_hint: Restrict who may forward notices — enter an address (jan{'@'}firma.cz) or a domain (firma.cz). Only notices whose sender matches are processed. Empty = any forwarder.
bank_accounts.imap_enable: Enable processing of bank notices from this account
bank_accounts.imap_subtitle: Each bank may use its own mailbox. Polling uses a read-only fetch and does not mark messages as read.
bank_accounts.imap_title: Your settings for loading bank notices and PDFs from e-mail
bank_accounts.ingest_notices_hint: Reads the payment notification from the e-mail body and creates a bank transaction from it. Turn off if your bank also sends PDF statements and the notifications would duplicate the transactions - attachments are still processed per the switches below.
bank_accounts.ingest_pdf_invoices_hint: Supplier invoices often land in the same mailbox as bank notices. When enabled, PDF attachments of every message are inspected and those that look like a document addressed to your company are filed into Purchases → Incoming documents. The check requires a document keyword (invoice, tax document, receipt…) and a match on your company ID, VAT ID or company name (min. 70%). Nothing is posted — you process the document from the queue.
bank_accounts.ingest_pdf_statements_hint: Banks without an API e-mail their statements as PDF (KB even after every movement, separately per account currency). When enabled, PDF attachments are tried as a bank statement — only one that belongs to a bank account of your company is imported, and payment matching runs right away. Daily statements are merged into the account's monthly statement and stay attached to it as its document.
bank_accounts.load_config_failed: Failed to load bank notice configuration.
bank_accounts.mappings_empty: No bank accounts to map for the current supplier.
bank_accounts.mappings_subtitle: The bank account → IMAP account → parser link decides which notice is matched to a given account.
bank_accounts.messages_subtitle: Emergency deletion only removes the deduplication record, not the transaction or invoice.
bank_accounts.multi_account_hint: For multiple accounts in the same currency use “New bank account” and pick the same currency code.

bank_accounts.normalizer_invalid: Normalizer config must be a valid JSON object.
bank_accounts.parser_failed: Parser did not find payment details.

bank_accounts.require_email_auth_hint: Only e-mails the receiving server marked in the Authentication-Results header as dkim/dmarc=pass with the correct domain are processed. Others are rejected.
bank_accounts.scan_summary: Processed: {processed}, matched: {matched}, known: {known}, old: {old}, rejected (auth): {rejected}, errors: {errors}
