bank_connection.account_verification_hint: Verify and save checks that access matches the configured account and currency. Credentials must belong to this specific account.
bank_connection.archive_cancelled_confirm: Order #{id} was submitted to the bank and cannot be permanently deleted. I confirm that I cancelled the entire batch in internet banking and none of its payments will be executed. Archive the order and hide it from the list? Submission history and duplicate submission protection will be retained. The application has not verified cancellation with the bank; invoice status and payment-order markers remain unchanged.
bank_connection.archived_cancelled: The order was archived based on your confirmation of cancellation in the bank.
bank_connection.bank_unavailable: Direct connection is not available for this account yet.
bank_connection.certificate_unchanged: Leave all fields empty to retain stored credentials. To replace them, provide the Client ID, certificate and password together.
bank_connection.credentials_storage_hint: The administrator must configure a server encryption key. Credentials are stored encrypted and are not returned to the browser. For certificate connections, select a .p12/.pfx file including its private key and enter its password if protected.
bank_connection.csas_error: Česká spořitelna consent could not be completed. Check credentials, callback URL and account permissions, then restart the connection.
bank_connection.csas_hint: Register an application for Česká spořitelna on Erste Developer Portal, add Premium Accounts API and OAuth2 Authorization Code. Register the exact callback URL below, obtain production access approval and activate Premium API with the bank. Enter the production API key, Client ID and Client Secret. You will be redirected to the bank to consent to selected accounts. MyÚčto connects only the account matching this number and currency; connect additional accounts separately.
bank_connection.csas_logging: Administrator warning: the bank callback contains a short-lived authorization code. Disable logging of sensitive callback parameters in web server, proxy and application logs. This warning does not block connection.
bank_connection.csas_read_only: This connector imports booked transactions into the regular statement records and shared automatic synchronization. Informational and pending transactions are not posted. Payment submission, instant notifications and original statement file downloads are not implemented yet. KPC/PDF payment exports remain available.
bank_connection.csas_sandbox_hint: Use the sandbox WEB-API-key, Client ID and Client Secret from Erste Developer Portal. Add Accounts API v3, mark the siblings.accounts scope as required and register the callback URL below. Test in a separate test company with a sandbox account, not in real accounting records. The sandbox returns static data; reconnect the account after changing environments.
bank_connection.csas_server: The administrator must configure the bank credential encryption key.
bank_connection.csob_help_title: ČSOB CEB contract number and communication certificate
bank_connection.csob_hint: Activate Business Connector in ČSOB CEB and create a communication certificate. We import GPC statements and intraday BBF advices; enable their generation and download for the account in CEB. Enter the contract number, .p12/.pfx certificate and its password if protected. Verification checks contract access and does not require statements or transactions. Account number and currency are checked when each statement or advice is imported; connecting alone does not confirm access to the specific account.
bank_connection.csob_no_files: ČSOB provided no GPC statement or BBF advice for this account and period. Check file generation and certificate permissions in CEB. Today's payment can be imported once the bank makes it available in an advice or statement.
bank_connection.csob_sync_hint: GPC statements and intraday BBF advices are imported for this account. Enable advice downloads and generation in BBF format in ČSOB CEB. Daily statements are usually available the following morning; today's transactions can be imported once the bank prepares an advice. Dates refer to file creation in ČSOB. Leave From empty for automatic continuation, or set both dates for up to 31 days. Pending files do not advance synchronization.
bank_connection.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this account and delete its stored token? Previously imported transactions and payment submission history will be retained.
bank_connection.error_account: The account does not match the connection or its settings have changed. Check the account number, bank and currency, then verify the connection again.
bank_connection.error_account_inactive: The bank account is inactive in MyÚčto. Edit it under Currencies and accounts, enable Active account and save. Then verify the connection again. The bank has not been contacted yet.
bank_connection.error_bank_http: The bank server returned an unsuccessful HTTP response. Check credentials, service activation and bank availability.
bank_connection.error_bank_response: The bank returned a response that the connector could not safely process. Response format compatibility must be checked; this step did not verify the account.
bank_connection.error_busy: Another bank operation is running for this account. Wait for it to finish.
bank_connection.error_ca_configuration: The server cannot load the trusted CA certificate store. The administrator must check PHP/cURL CA configuration and file permissions.
bank_connection.error_certificate: Check the Client ID, valid PKCS#12 certificate and its password. The maximum file size is 24 kB.
bank_connection.error_certificate_runtime: The server requires PHP cURL with in-memory client certificate and key support, and the OpenSSL extension.
bank_connection.error_client_certificate: The server could not use the client certificate or private key for TLS. The administrator must check the PKCS#12 export and cURL/OpenSSL configuration.
bank_connection.error_connect: The server cannot connect to the bank. Check bank availability, firewall and proxy settings.
bank_connection.error_cooldown: The connection or bank has limited request frequency. Wait at least 30 seconds and try again.
bank_connection.error_csob_evidence: No verifiable GPC statement with a transaction for this account and currency was found in the contract within the last 45 days. Check statement formats and certificate permissions in ČSOB CEB.
bank_connection.error_csob_pending: ČSOB has not prepared all files or their download is incomplete. Synchronization was not advanced. Try again later or check statements in CEB.
bank_connection.error_csob_rejected: ČSOB rejected the Business Connector request. Check service activation, the contract number and communication certificate permissions in CEB.
bank_connection.error_date: The payment date is in the past. Prepare a new order with a current payment date.
bank_connection.error_dns: The server could not resolve the bank address (DNS). The administrator must check server network settings.
bank_connection.error_encryption: The administrator must check MYINVOICE_SECRET_KEY and the availability of the key used to store the token.
bank_connection.error_history: History is unavailable or synchronization has a gap. Check the bank's history limit and import missing periods manually. Fio may require unlocking older history.
bank_connection.error_history_kb_plus: History is unavailable or the import has a gap. Fill in the missing period manually in ranges of at most 31 days.
bank_connection.error_history_moneta: History is unavailable or the import has a gap. MONETA returns transactions at most 2 years back and older periods may require two-factor verification in Internet Banking. Fill in the missing period manually in ranges of at most 31 days.
bank_connection.error_kb_plus_statement_pending: KB is still preparing the statement and the server cannot wait any longer. Synchronization was not advanced. The automatic import will fetch it (within 24 hours for the Basic variant), or you can try again manually later. With the Basic variant every attempt counts towards the limit of 50 downloads per month.
bank_connection.error_kb_plus_statements: The Basic variant downloads statements via STATDA, but the consent granted at KB does not include this permission. In the KB+ connection choose Enter keys again, or Start new verification in KB+.
bank_connection.error_network: No response arrived from the server (the request timed out or the connection dropped). Reload the page and check whether the transactions were imported before trying again.
bank_connection.error_payable: Documents have changed or been settled since the order was prepared. Check their outstanding amounts and prepare an up-to-date order.
bank_connection.error_payment_unavailable: This bank connection cannot send payment orders. The KB+ connection uses the Basic variant or its consent does not include payment batches; upload the order to the bank manually.
bank_connection.error_period: Choose a shorter period with both dates, at most 31 days. The period cannot end in the future.
bank_connection.error_reconciliation: The import stopped because more than one previously imported record matches the same transaction and the application cannot safely decide which one to keep. Review overlapping bank statements and duplicate transactions, reconcile them manually, then run synchronization again.
bank_connection.error_server: The server did not finish the import and returned no usable response. Synchronization was not advanced; try again in a few minutes. If the error persists, give the administrator the exact time of the attempt.
bank_connection.error_server_certificate: The server does not trust the bank server certificate. The administrator must fix the trusted CA certificates; do not disable TLS verification.
bank_connection.error_server_kb_plus: The server did not finish the import from KB. With the Basic variant KB prepares the statement first, which can take longer than the server can wait. Synchronization was not advanced; the automatic import will fetch it, or you can try again manually later. If the error persists, give the administrator the exact time of the attempt.
bank_connection.error_timeout: The bank request timed out. Check bank availability and try again later.
bank_connection.error_tls_handshake: The secure connection to the bank failed (TLS). This may be caused by a rejected client certificate or incompatible TLS; check the communication certificate issued and enabled in ČSOB CEB.
bank_connection.error_token: Check the Fio API token, its activation, permissions and expiry date.
bank_connection.error_token_kb_plus: KB denied access to the account (HTTP 401/403). The consent granted in KB+ may have expired or been revoked, or the request exceeded the contracted API Business variant. Check the selected variant (Basic or Plus), the consent in KB+ under Third-party access and, if needed, start a new verification in KB+.
bank_connection.error_token_moneta: MONETA rejected the token (HTTP 401/403). The token may have expired or been revoked. In Internet Banking open Settings / Other / API token management, create a new token and paste it here.
bank_connection.error_transport: The connection to the bank could not be established or completed. The administrator must check availability, TLS and the client certificate. This does not necessarily mean an incorrect password.
bank_connection.fio_help_title: API token for a specific account
bank_connection.intro: Import transactions and submit payment orders directly to your bank. Available features depend on the bank.
bank_connection.invalid_period: Enter both valid dates covering no more than 31 days inclusive, with From no later than To and To no later than today.
bank_connection.kb_plus_sync_hint: An empty From date continues automatically from the last import; the To date is ignored. For a manual import fill in both dates, at most 31 days inclusive. With the Basic variant KB only provides statements up to the previous business day and at most 50 downloads per month; with Plus you can download once per 61 minutes.
bank_connection.kb_plus_sync_progress: Importing from KB for {seconds} s. With the Basic variant the bank prepares the statement first, which can take up to a minute. Keep this page open.
bank_connection.key_hint: The token is stored encrypted. The installation administrator must configure a dedicated server encryption key first.
bank_connection.last_failed: The last import failed. Check the token validity and try importing transactions again.
bank_connection.last_failed_kb_plus: The last import failed. Check the selected API Business variant and the consent in KB+, then try importing again.
bank_connection.moneta_hint: Create the token in MONETA Internet Banking under Settings / Other / API token management / Create token and confirm it in Smart Banka. The token covers all your MONETA accounts; the application uses it only for this account. Its validity is limited, so enable automatic renewal when creating it, otherwise replace the token here after it expires. Bulk payment orders sent from the application appear in Internet Banking under Messages and notifications, where they still have to be signed.
bank_connection.no_accounts: Create a bank account in the list above first.
bank_connection.no_supported_accounts: None of your accounts currently supports a direct connection.
bank_connection.payment_confirm: Submit order #{id} with {count} items totaling {amount} from account {account} to the bank? This step does not pay invoices. Review and authorize the order in internet banking.
bank_connection.payment_czk_only: Direct submission is available only for domestic CZK payment orders.
bank_connection.payment_help_hint: Enable the required permission in the bank to submit payment orders. Submission does not replace authorization in online banking or confirm settlement. Direct submission supports domestic CZK orders only.
bank_connection.payment_hint: Submission only sends the order to the bank for authorization. Review and authorize it in internet banking. This step does not mark invoices as paid.
bank_connection.payment_marked_paid: This order already marked invoices as paid when created. Verify payments in internet banking before making another payment.
bank_connection.payment_no_connection: No active verified connection supporting payment orders is available for this payer account. Configure it in Bank accounts.
bank_connection.payment_permissions: Submission requires write access to both bank accounts and payment orders.
bank_connection.payment_status_accepted_awaiting_authori: The bank accepted the order for authorization. Authorize it in internet banking. Acceptance does not confirm payment.
bank_connection.payment_status_import_started: The bank received the file and is processing the import. Check validation results and authorize the orders in internet banking. In CREDITAS, find the batch under Transakce → Zadané → Hromadné (Transactions → Submitted → Bulk). No payment has been executed by this step.
bank_connection.payment_status_rejected: The bank rejected the order. Check the reason with the bank. This order cannot be submitted again.
bank_connection.payment_status_required: Load the saved submission status first.
bank_connection.payment_status_unknown: The bank submission result is unknown. Check the order in internet banking. This order cannot be submitted again.
bank_connection.payment_title: Submit a payment order to the bank
bank_connection.payment_unknown: The submission result is unconfirmed. Check the order in internet banking before proceeding. Automatic retry is blocked.
bank_connection.rb_help_title: Application Client ID and Premium API certificate
bank_connection.rb_hint: First contact your RB banker to confirm Premium API activation and batch payment import/statement download permissions for this account. The service may incur tariff charges. Developers.rb.cz only provides the application Client ID, not account access. After activation, create a Premium API certificate in internet banking, assign accounts and allowed operations, and download the .p12 file. If the option is missing, check availability and permissions with your banker. Payments are authorized in the bank; the certificate requires periodic unblocking.
bank_connection.reconciliation_intro: Compare each new transaction with the previously imported record. Confirming marks them as the same payment, so another duplicate record will not be created.
bank_connection.reconciliation_wait: Confirmation will be available in {seconds} seconds due to the bank connection safety limit.
bank_connection.sync_hint: An empty From date automatically continues the previous import; To is ignored in this mode. For a manual import, enter both dates covering no more than 31 days inclusive. Overlapping periods can be imported again. Older history may need to be unlocked for the token in internet banking.
bank_connection.synced: Import complete. New transactions: {imported}, matched: {matched}, skipped duplicates: {skipped}.
bank_connection.title: Direct bank connection
bank_connection.token_hint: Create a Fio token in internet banking for this specific account. Read access is sufficient for importing transactions; payment orders also require permission to import payments. Tokens expire according to their bank settings; replace the token here when it expires.
bank_connection.token_required: Enter an account token to establish the first connection.
bank_connection.token_unchanged: Leave blank to retain the stored token

bank_template_admin.empty: No bank templates have been created yet.

cash.book_filtered_note: The listed rows are narrowed by the filter. Opening and closing balance and turnovers still cover the whole period.
cash.book_truncated_note: Only a limited number of movements can be filtered, so the selection is incomplete — please narrow the period. Balances and turnovers still cover the whole period.

delete.draft_warning: A draft has no series number and no postings — deleting it leaves nothing behind and creates no gap in the number series.
delete.hint: For documents already covered by a filed return, prefer a reversal. Deletion is only possible in an open and unlocked period.
delete.title: Delete document permanently
delete.warning: The document and its postings (including any reversing entry) will be deleted irreversibly. Unlike a reversal, no trace remains in the books.

error.account_invalid: The cash account must be an active 211 analytical account.
error.account_locked: The analytical account cannot be changed — a posted document exists.
error.account_taken: The analytical account is already used by another cash register (incl. inactive).
error.amount_exceeds_remaining: The amount exceeds the invoice's remaining balance.
error.counter_account_invalid: Invalid counter account or posting rule.
error.currency_unsupported: Foreign-currency cash registers are available only in double-entry bookkeeping, not in tax records.
error.date_locked: The document date falls into a period closed by the tax lock.
error.ddkp_not_payable: A tax document for a received payment (§ 28) is not paid in cash — pay the advance invoice it originates from.
error.doc_not_draft: Only a draft document can be edited.
error.doc_not_posted: Only a posted document can be reversed.
error.followup_document_exists: A follow-up document was already created from this advance payment — cancel it first, then the cash document.
error.foreign_currency_invoice: Paying a foreign-currency invoice from the cash register is not supported yet.
error.foreign_register_purpose_unsupported: A foreign-currency register currently supports only sale, purchase and other movements — keep invoice payments and transfers in a CZK register.
error.fx_rate_unavailable: The CNB rate for the register currency at the document date is unavailable — please add the rate.
error.has_dependencies: The document is linked to other records and cannot be deleted — remove the link first.
error.invalid_purpose_type: Invalid document type and purpose combination.
error.invoice_invalid_status: An invoice in this status cannot be paid in cash.
error.nothing_to_refund: There is nothing to refund on this received invoice — no payment is posted to it yet.
error.nothing_to_settle: The received invoice is already settled (by an advance or another payment) — nothing is left to pay.
error.partial_purchase_payment: A received invoice can only be paid in cash in the full remaining amount.
error.partial_purchase_payment_detail: A received invoice can only be paid in cash in the full remaining amount ({remaining}).
error.partial_refund: A document can only be paid out in cash in the full amount.
error.partial_refund_detail: A document can only be paid out in cash in the full amount ({remaining}).
error.period_not_open: The document's accounting period is not open — only documents in an open period can be changed or deleted.
error.purchase_vat_over_10k: Record a taxable purchase above CZK 10,000 as a received invoice.
error.reason_required: A reversal reason is required (min. 3 characters).
error.refund_exceeds_paid: The refund cannot exceed the amount already paid.
error.refund_not_enabled: Enable cash payouts in Settings with the option “Allow settlements with an amount to refund”.
error.register_has_documents: A cash register with documents cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead.

mode_help.clearing: A purchase is posted on the bank booking date to the clearing account against the 231 loan. A document later settles it from the clearing account; without a document you close it as a deductible or non-deductible expense or charge it to the holder. The 231 balance thus always matches the statement.
mode_help.direct: A purchase is posted only when matched with a document, by a rule or manually. Until then the 231 balance does not match the statement.

credit_cards.opening_failed: The opening debt could not be posted.

settings.description: The debt to the bank is posted to the 231 analytic account of each loan account. Card purchases go through clearing or wait for a document, depending on the mode; interest, fees and repayments are recognized from the statement. A change applies to new entries only.
settings.help_cash: A card cash withdrawal goes through cash in transit; the cash receipt document moves it to the cash desk.
settings.help_fee: Account, statement, direct debit or currency conversion fees.
settings.help_interest: Interest the bank charges to the loan account.
settings.help_opening: Where to post the debt the first imported statement starts with. It is offered in the loan account detail, where you confirm it.
settings.help_private: Private purchase with a company card: receivable from an employee (335) or shareholder (355). Empty = payment card settings.
settings.help_purchase_mode: Each loan account can override the mode in its detail.
settings.help_repayment: Counter account of a repayment whose statement line does not show the source account. A repayment from your own account is matched as a 261 transfer automatically.
settings.help_reward: A reward or cashback credited directly to the loan account.
settings.help_writeoff_nontax: Closes a purchase without a document as a non-deductible expense. Empty = payment card settings.
settings.help_writeoff_tax: Closes a purchase without a document as a tax-deductible expense (no VAT deduction). Only with other conclusive evidence, such as a merchant confirmation.
settings.scheme_note: The entry date is the bank booking date, so the 231 balance matches the statement. The transaction date and the original currency stay in the transaction description.
settings.scheme_opening: Opening debt from the first statement
settings.scheme_purchase: Card purchase matched with a received document
settings.scheme_purchase_card: Card purchase (posted to clearing right away)
settings.scheme_purchase_rule: Purchase without a document by rule or manually

creditas_bank.error_account: The account or currency returned by the bank does not match this MyÚčto account. Check Account ID, account type and token permissions.
creditas_bank.error_account_id: Account ID must contain 1 to 40 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Use the identifier from API key details.
creditas_bank.error_busy: Another operation is running for this account. Try again shortly.
creditas_bank.error_certificate: The selected certificate could not be read or is invalid. Use a .p12/.pfx file up to 24 KiB and check its password.
creditas_bank.error_certificate_runtime: The server lacks required client certificate support. The administrator must check PHP, cURL and OpenSSL.
creditas_bank.error_cooldown: The request limit has been reached. Wait before trying again.
creditas_bank.error_credentials: Credentials are incomplete or invalid. Check the 64-character token, Account ID and account type. If you use a certificate, also check its validity and password.
creditas_bank.error_encryption: The administrator must configure a valid server encryption key to securely store credentials.
creditas_bank.error_generic: The CREDITAS connection could not be completed. Check credentials and server readiness.
creditas_bank.error_inactive: This account is inactive in MyÚčto. Activate it in Currencies and accounts first.
creditas_bank.error_remote: The connection to CREDITAS could not be completed. Check bank availability and token permissions; if your access uses mTLS, also check the client certificate.
creditas_bank.error_response: The CREDITAS response does not match the expected format. Give your administrator the time of the attempt so the server-side cause can be checked.
creditas_bank.error_token_rejected: The bank denied access (HTTP 401/403). Check key validity, allowed operations and any access restrictions in CREDITAS. A certificate is not mandatory for token-only access.
creditas_bank.invalid_token: The security key must contain exactly 64 letters and digits.
creditas_bank.mtls_hint: Enter your security token and Account ID to connect. The client certificate is optional; attach it only if your specific bank access requires mutual TLS authentication (mTLS).
creditas_bank.payment_hint: Submitting payment files requires the key's extended payment-entry permission. File submission does not replace bank authorization or confirm settlement; statements confirm payment.

creditas_bank.token_hint: Create a security key for the selected account in CREDITAS online banking and grant the required permissions. The key contains exactly 64 letters and digits.
creditas_bank.unchanged: Stored credentials remain hidden and unchanged. You do not need to enter them again to pause or re-enable the connection.

cron_jobs.all_ok: All scheduled jobs are running on time.
cron_jobs.inactive_hint: These jobs have nothing to do on this installation, so their runs are not watched. Once they get work, they appear in the table.
cron_jobs.mode_confirm: Switch scheduling mode to “{mode}”? Switching alone does not change the schedule — the crontab / Task Scheduler has to be regenerated (restart the container on Docker).
cron_jobs.mode_dispatcher_desc: A single entry is scheduled ({script}, every minute) that works out what is due, skips jobs with nothing to do and launches the rest as separate processes. One entry instead of {count} — the trade-off is that its failure stops every job.
cron_jobs.mode_individual_desc: Every job is its own crontab / Task Scheduler entry ({count} entries). Transparent and debuggable one job at a time — a failure of one does not affect the others.
cron_jobs.mode_managed: Job scheduling is run by us — the mode cannot be switched on a managed installation. If jobs stop running, please contact support.
cron_jobs.mode_subtitle: Controls who launches the jobs. What the individual jobs do does not change — only how many entries have to be scheduled.
cron_jobs.run_now_confirm: Really run script {script} now? It will run in the background and the result will appear in the table when it finishes.
cron_jobs.run_now_started: Script {script} has been started in the background.
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_dispatcher_down: The {script} scheduler has stopped running, so no job runs. Check that it is scheduled every minute and that its log does not end with an error; the stale jobs in the table are only the consequence.
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_nothing_runs: No job ran within its interval, so cron on the server is not running. Check the cron service or Task Scheduler; the stale jobs in the table are only the consequence.
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_title: The job scheduler is not running
cron_jobs.setup_foreign_platform: This server runs on a different platform — the paths below are examples, adjust them for the target machine.
cron_jobs.setup_hint: Cron setup: see {link} in the manual.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_docker: In the Docker image cron is generated from the catalog at build time — nothing is scheduled by hand, only verified.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_linux: Add to the crontab of a user allowed to write into log/ and storage/. The .sh wrappers locate the project root themselves and redirect output to a daily log.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_windows: Run from an elevated command prompt. Change /ru SYSTEM if the tasks must run under a service account with access to network drives.
cron_jobs.setup_note: Frequencies come from the job catalog (CronCatalog) — the same ones shown on the cards above. After scheduling, verify that the log directory is being written to and watch the status on this page.
cron_jobs.setup_paths_hint: this server's paths — ready to copy
cron_jobs.subtitle: What should run automatically and when it last ran. The app cannot read crontab / Task Scheduler directly — every cron script writes its own heartbeat, and if the last successful run is missing or too old, you'll see a warning.
cron_jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
cron_jobs.tooltip_disabled: The installation's configuration (cron.disabled_jobs) disabled this job — it won't run until the admin/operator re-enables it. Not a malfunction.
cron_jobs.tooltip_failing: The last run ended with an error.
cron_jobs.tooltip_idle: This job only runs when there is work to do, and right now there isn't — that's why the last run is ageing. {script} is what proves scheduling still works.
cron_jobs.tooltip_never_ran: Script never ran — most likely it isn't scheduled in crontab / Task Scheduler.
cron_jobs.tooltip_overdue: Last successful run is older than {hours} h.
cron_jobs.tooltip_pending: The installation is new and this job hasn't had a full period ({hours} h) yet — not a problem for now.

access.certificateDescription: The stored system certificate is used for direct server operations on this company's data box, especially manually requested collection of incoming messages.
access.certificateOnly: This setting applies only to the currently selected company. Interactive sign-in for dispatch takes place separately in ISDS.
access.certificateRecommendedByIsds: The ISDS operating rules recommend this method for third-party applications. The certificate and its password are stored encrypted.
access.certificateSource: Where to take the certificate from
access.certificateSourceHint: Certificates live in one place (System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures). Picking from the vault means the same key is not uploaded twice and its expiry is tracked in a single place.
access.credentialDeleteFailed: The data box access could not be deleted.
access.credentialDeleted: The data box access was deleted.
access.deleteCredentialConfirm: Really delete the stored access to data box {box}? The uploaded certificate will be removed and you will have to set it up again.
access.gatewayAvailable: The sending gateway is ready for the selected environment.
access.gatewayBoundary: MyÚčto never sees or stores any username, password, security code or mobile key. Whichever route you pick, the same things leave through it: health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the monthly ČSSZ report (JMHZ) as an alternative to VREP, and enforcement cooperation. Sent messages are on the Outgoing submissions tab, authority replies on the Incoming messages tab.
access.gatewayDescription: The route for when you do not want to sign in from the app. On dispatch MyÚčto redirects you to the official ISDS sign-in page and you pick the method there, according to what your account allows — nothing can be configured here. The gateway is registered by the service operator and is shared by the whole installation, so you do not switch it on yourself.
access.gatewayUnavailable: The sending gateway is a separate outgoing-only service and the operator has not activated it for this environment yet. Incoming messages can be fetched independently on the Incoming messages tab.
access.inboxCertificate: System certificate: encrypted and stored for the currently selected company.
access.inboxLoginBoundary: A regular password is not stored in a profile. During the SMS step it remains for at most a few minutes in a one-time encrypted flow; it is erased after use and cannot be used after expiry. The SMS code is not stored. At your request, the Mobile Key username and communication code can be stored encrypted only for the company + user combination. The mailbox is never fetched automatically.
access.inboxLoginDescription: Choose an access method when you manually fetch messages. The sending gateway is unrelated to this operation.
access.inboxMobileKey: Mobile Key: username + communication code (app password), followed by confirmation of each session in the key. This personal access can be stored encrypted for you and the selected company.
access.inboxPassword: Username + password: used once for a single request; if SMS authentication is enabled on the account, you enter the code in the second step.
access.label: Label
access.loginBoundary: An ordinary password is never stored in the profile. During the SMS step it stays for a few minutes at most in a single-use encrypted flow; it is deleted after use and cannot be reused once expired. The SMS code is not stored. The Mobile Key username and communication code can, at your request, be stored encrypted only for the company + user pair. The box is never fetched automatically.
access.loginCertificateText: Reading and machine operations only. It cannot send — nobody would be present at the dispatch.
access.loginDescription: One sign-in for both directions: sending submissions and manually fetching delivered messages. You set it up here once and only confirm it at each action.
access.loginMobileKeyText: Username and communication code, each session confirmed on your phone. Works for sending as well as reading and can be remembered encrypted.
access.loginPasswordText: Used once for a single action. With SMS authentication enabled you enter the code in a second step. Not stored.
access.loginTitle: Signing in to the data box

delivery.explain: The recalculation does not touch the data box — it only re-evaluates messages already downloaded. If nobody logs in within ten days of arrival, the message counts as delivered on the last day of that period (Section 17(4) of Act 300/2008 Coll.), and that happens purely with the passage of time.
delivery.fictionDueOn: Delivery by legal fiction falls on {date}
delivery.notApplicable: Receipt for our own filing — the delivery fiction does not apply to it.
delivery.refreshed: Messages checked: {checked}, delivered by legal fiction: {fiction}.

gateway.credentialsStayInIsds: You enter credentials only on the Czech Data Box Information System page. MyÚčto neither sees nor stores them.
gateway.expiresAt: This pending step remains valid until {value}.
gateway.methodsByIsds: The ISDS sign-in page and your account settings determine the available methods — for example username and password, an application password with the eGovernment security key, or the Mobile eGovernment Key.

gateway.receiptManual: Upload the delivery receipt for this message manually — the sending gateway cannot download it.

registrations.activateHint: Users will start being offered draft preparation in the data box for ready filings. Enable it only after verifying it against the registered gateway.
registrations.atsIdHint: You will find it in the data box portal under Settings → External applications → Sending gateway.
registrations.certificateHint: Must include the private key — it is used as a TLS client certificate. It has to be the same certificate stored in the gateway registration in the data box.
registrations.certificatePasswordHint: Stored encrypted and never handed back by the application.
registrations.copyFailed: The browser refused to copy — retype the value from the box next to it.
registrations.deactivateHint: Draft preparation in the data box will no longer be offered. The manual route stays available, so nobody loses the ability to file.
registrations.deleteHint: The stored certificate is deleted with it. The registration will have to be created again, including uploading the file.
registrations.empty: No sending gateway registration has been stored yet.
registrations.errorUrlHint: Where the data box sends the user when the dispatch fails. Must use HTTPS as well.
registrations.expired: The certificate has expired. Upload a new one — the gateway cannot be enabled with an expired certificate.
registrations.formHint: The values must match the registration in the data box portal. The certificate has to be uploaded again even when editing — it is never handed back by the application.
registrations.intro: The sending gateway prepares the filing as a draft message directly in your data box. You then send it by approving the draft in the data box system — the application never sends it for you.
registrations.label: Name
registrations.operatorOnly: The registration belongs to the service operator. The commercial certificate is shared by the whole service and customers configure nothing to send through the gateway.

policies.invite_failed: The user was created, but the password link could NOT be sent. Check outgoing mail and resend the link from the user detail.
policies.invite_sent: User created. We have emailed them a link to set their password.
policies.password_invite_hint: Leave empty and we will email the user a single-use link so they set the password themselves. You will not know it.
policies.password_invite_placeholder: leave empty and we will send a link
policies.password_link_sent: Link sent to the user’s e-mail.
policies.portal_sso_or_password: An active portal session is enough

registrations.policy: How users sign in to the gateway
registrations.policyHint: The application does not behave differently based on this value — it only decides what we tell the user before sending them to the data box.
registrations.policyUnknownHint: The behaviour of the gateway sign-in page has not been verified by a live attempt yet. We therefore tell users to expect a username and password, while noting that an active portal session may let them through without one.
registrations.returnUrlField: Must use HTTPS — the session identifier travels through it.
registrations.returnUrlHint: Enter this exact value in the data box portal under Settings → External applications → Sending gateway as the return address. The user's browser returns to it, so it must point at this page, not at the API.
registrations.returnUrlTitle: Return address for the data box portal
registrations.saved: Registration saved. It is disabled for now — enable it once verified.
registrations.savedInactiveHint: After saving, the registration is always disabled. Enable it separately once you have verified dispatch against the registered gateway.
registrations.title: Sending gateway registration
registrations.ttlHint: Between 60 and 7200 seconds. Set the same value in the gateway registration in the data box portal.

gateway.settingsCompanyLink: A particular company's sign-in — for sending as well as for reading incoming messages — is configured on its own page, not here.
gateway.settingsReadOnly: The gateway can only send, not read. That is a property of the chosen setup, not an omission: the filing is prepared as a draft in your data box and the final click — the approval — is made by a person, so the customer needs no system certificate of their own. The price is that the delivery note of a sent message has to be uploaded manually.
gateway.settingsStep_redirect: On dispatch MyÚčto redirects the user to the official ISDS sign-in page.
gateway.settingsStep_return: The data box returns them to the return address and MyÚčto records the outcome. Health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the monthly ČSSZ report (JMHZ) as an alternative to VREP, and enforcement cooperation leave this way.
gateway.settingsStep_signIn: They sign in there. Their account decides the method — username and password, a security key, or the eGovernment Mobile Key. MyÚčto never sees any credentials.
gateway.settingsSubtitle: Global technical registration of the service operator — one for the whole installation, not created per company. It is an alternative route for sending: whoever signs in directly in the app with the Mobile Key sends without a redirect and needs no gateway.

inbox.authIntro: You start every fetch manually. Mobile Key access can be remembered personally for this company; a regular password and SMS code remain one-time credentials.
inbox.authTitle: How do you want to sign in for this fetch?
inbox.certificateMissing: No system certificate is stored for this company and environment.
inbox.communicationCodeHint: A separate code configured for external application access; you then confirm this session in Mobile Key.
inbox.manualOnly: The mailbox is never collected automatically. You must start and confirm every fetch.
inbox.mobileCredentialDeleted: The stored personal Mobile Key access was removed.
inbox.pollConfirm: Fetch new messages from the data box now? Fetching may count as delivery and start statutory deadlines.
inbox.polledWithErrors: Messages downloaded: {stored}. Downloading or storing failed for {failed} messages; the fetch is incomplete and must be repeated.

privacy.description: You can hide an unrelated unclassified message and permanently delete its local copy from Documents. Only a technical message header remains to prevent repeated downloads and preserve the audit trail; MyÚčto cannot restore the content. A copy may remain in server backups according to the administrator's retention policy.
privacy.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete the downloaded ZFO and all of its attachments from Documents? The technical message header remains for audit and duplicate-download prevention.
privacy.purgePending: The database copy was removed, but physical-file deletion has not yet been verified. Retry the action.
privacy.purged: The local message copy and its attachments were deleted.
privacy.restored: The message was restored to active messages.
privacy.title: Downloaded-message privacy

inbox.rememberMobileCredential: Store encrypted for this company and my user account
inbox.reprocessAlreadyDone: This protocol is already processed. An accepted document is never overwritten, so nothing about the submission changes.
inbox.reprocessHint: Re-classifies the message and reads its attachment from the stored original. The data box is not polled again.
inbox.reprocessManual: The message could not be linked automatically ({code}). It stays for manual review.
inbox.reprocessNotApplicable: There is no automatic processing for this message.
inbox.reprocessed: The message was processed and linked to a submission.
inbox.savedCommunicationCodePlaceholder: The saved code will be used; a new one replaces it
inbox.smsCodeRequired: Enter the one-time code from SMS.
inbox.subject: Subject

notices.answerDateRequired: Fill in the day you remedied the defect — meeting the deadline is counted in days.
notices.deadlineHint: The application does not invent the period — the law sets no length, the tax authority states it in the notice. Copy either the date or the number of days. Without it the notice stays in the "deadline unknown" state and will never look settled.
notices.duplicate: A notice for this message already exists; nothing changed.

grounds.a_not_processable: (a) the filing cannot be dealt with
grounds.b_no_effects: (b) the filing cannot have its intended effects
grounds.c_wrong_way: (c) the filing was not made in the prescribed manner
grounds.d_wrong_format: (d) the filing was not in the prescribed format or structure
grounds.unknown: We do not know which letter the notice cites

notices.intro: A defective filing is handled by the tax authority through a notice under Section 74 of the Tax Procedure Code. Remedy the defect within the stated period and the filing is treated as if it had been made properly and on time. Fail to remedy a defect under Section 74(1)(a) or (b) and the filing becomes ineffective once the period expires.
notices.periodDays: Or the number of days stated in the notice
notices.respondBy: Respond by (date stated in the notice)
notices.shifted: The last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so it moved to the next working day (Section 33(4) of the Tax Procedure Code).
notices.shortPeriod: The period is shorter than eight days. The law allows that only quite exceptionally (Section 32(2) of the Tax Procedure Code) — check that it is copied correctly.
notices.title: Notices to remedy defects in a filing

outbox.cancelledStillPending: You cancelled the outgoing message, not the filing itself: {agenda} for {period} is still not filed and is waiting to be sent.

certificateSend.failed: The message could not be sent with the certificate.

deleteBlocked.attempt: A send attempt is recorded for this message and the audit trail is never deleted.
deleteBlocked.decided: The authority has already decided on this filing, so the record stays.

deleteBlocked.linked: Another record follows on from this message — a defect notice or a follow-up filing.

outbox.deliveredNotProcessed: The delivery receipt confirms the message reached the authority’s mailbox. It does not mean the authority has processed and accepted the filing — any defects will be notified in a separate message.

mobileKey.sent: The submission was sent through the data box.

outbox.uncertainHint: It is not certain whether the message was sent. Do not resend it manually, that could create a duplicate filing — let it be looked up with the button below.
outbox.validationFailed: The submitted file failed validation against the XSD schema. The authority may return it as a defective filing under § 74 of the Tax Code — fix it and file again.

databox.subtitle: This company's data box: sending filings and reading incoming messages. Tax filings (VAT, control and recapitulative statements, corporate and personal income tax) can be sent here from Taxes → EPO filings and archive. What the application sends this way: health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the employer's monthly report to the social security administration (JMHZ) as an alternative to the direct VREP channel, and enforcement cooperation replies.
databox.taxNote: VAT returns, control and recapitulative statements and income tax returns go through EPO or, optionally, through the data box from Taxes → EPO filings and archive. The data box returns no confirmation with a filing number, only a delivery receipt; the tax office reports defects in a separate message.
databox.title: Data box

app_debug.impact: In production error details could end up in the server response.
app_debug.label: Debug mode

app_url.fix: Set app.url to the exact HTTP(S) origin without credentials, path, query or fragment. Its hostname must not also be a company custom domain. For passkeys use an HTTPS DNS hostname; http://localhost is the exception.
app_url.impact: A missing, invalid or custom-domain-conflicting origin breaks canonical routing, links and custom domains. HTTP and LAN IP addresses remain usable for the regular UI, but not for passkeys.
app_url.label: Canonical application address (app.url)

values.app_url_detected_during_setup: will be detected from the setup wizard address
values.app_url_hostname_conflict: hostname conflicts with a company custom domain

app_version.fix: Check the Updates section to see what the new version brings.
app_version.impact: A newer version is available — the problem you are chasing may already be fixed.
app_version.label: Application version

cron_health.fix: Check the schedule and the last run on the Scheduled jobs page.
cron_health.impact: Without cron there are no backups, no reminders go out and exchange rates are not fetched.
cron_health.info_label: Inactive jobs (not configured, turned off or with nothing to do)
cron_health.label: Scheduled jobs

values.dispatcher_down: the cron-dispatch scheduler is not running

dispatcher_down.fix: Check that cron-dispatch is scheduled every minute in crontab or Task Scheduler and that its log in log/cron does not end with an error. Run it by hand with php api/bin/cron-dispatch.php. On Docker check that cron is running inside the container.
dispatcher_down.impact: The installation uses a single dispatcher and it has stopped running. No job is launched: no backups are made, no reminders go out, no ČNB rates are fetched. The jobs themselves are fine, nobody starts them.
dispatcher_down.label: The job scheduler is not running

nothing_runs.fix: Check that the cron service (Linux) or Task Scheduler (Windows) is running and that the jobs run under an account allowed to write into log/ and storage/. The Scheduled jobs page has instructions with this server's paths.
nothing_runs.impact: No scheduled job ran within its interval, so it is cron on the server that stopped, not individual jobs. No backups are made, no reminders go out, no ČNB rates are fetched.
nothing_runs.label: The job scheduler is not running

date_timezone.fix: Set date.timezone in php.ini to the same value the application uses.
date_timezone.impact: Without a time zone document dates can shift by a day, which carries over into VAT periods.
date_timezone.label: PHP time zone

db_charset.impact: Outside utf8mb4 accented characters and emoji in names and notes get corrupted.
db_charset.label: Database character set

db_max_allowed_packet.fix: Raise max_allowed_packet in the MariaDB configuration and restart the server.
db_max_allowed_packet.impact: A low value breaks the database backup and the storage of larger attachments.
db_max_allowed_packet.label: max_allowed_packet

db_sql_mode.fix: The application sets strict mode per connection itself. Align the global value for backups and manual work.
db_sql_mode.impact: Without strict mode the database silently truncates oversized values instead of reporting an error.
db_sql_mode.label: Database strict mode

db_version.impact: Migrations use constructs an older server or MySQL does not support — the database update will fail.
db_version.label: Database version

disk_space.fix: Free up space, or grow the data volume.
disk_space.impact: Once the disk fills up, backups, PDFs and uploaded documents silently stop being created.
disk_space.label: Free disk space

global_codebooks.fix: Run php api/bin/restore-global-seeds.php --apply (Windows cmd\restore-global-seeds.ps1). The script adds the missing rows from the migration seeds and deletes nothing.
global_codebooks.impact: An empty global code list (public holidays, rates, statements, filing recipients…) is not restored by migrations. Deadlines, statements or filings are then computed without it or fail.
global_codebooks.label: Global code lists

log_size.fix: Clean up old logs; php-errors.log does not rotate and has to be trimmed manually.
log_size.impact: Oversized logs take up the space needed for backups and documents.
log_size.label: Log directory size

logging_level.fix: Use info or higher in production.
logging_level.impact: At debug level the log also records SMTP traffic including the credentials.
logging_level.label: Log level

memory_limit.fix: Set memory_limit in php.ini to at least 256M.
memory_limit.impact: PDF generation, exports and closing reports abort mid-way when the limit is too low.
memory_limit.label: PHP memory limit

migrations_pending.impact: A migration that never ran is the most common cause of missing table or column errors.
migrations_pending.label: Database migrations

opcache.fix: Enable opcache.enable in php.ini and restart PHP.
opcache.impact: Without OPcache every request recompiles the code — the application is markedly slower.
opcache.label: OPcache

opcache_validate_timestamps.fix: Either enable opcache.validate_timestamps, or restart PHP-FPM or IIS after every update.
opcache_validate_timestamps.impact: With timestamp validation off the old code keeps running after an update until PHP is restarted.
opcache_validate_timestamps.label: OPcache refresh after an update

payroll_archive_encryption.fix: Run Encrypt archive in the panel above.
payroll_archive_encryption.impact: Payslips and payroll sheets from before encryption was introduced are readable on disk and in backups.
payroll_archive_encryption.label: Unencrypted payroll documents

payroll_key_rotation.fix: Run Re-wrap to the new key in the panel above.
payroll_key_rotation.impact: Some payroll data is encrypted with the old key, which therefore has to stay in the configuration.
payroll_key_rotation.label: Encryption key rotation

retire_old_key.fix: Remove the old key from app.secret_encryption_previous_keys. First make sure no other part of the application needs it (TOTP, bank connections, certificates).
retire_old_key.impact: All payroll data is now encrypted with the new key; keeping the old key in the configuration is an unnecessary risk.
retire_old_key.label: The old encryption key can be removed

unknown_key.fix: Put the original key back into app.secret_encryption_previous_keys, then run Re-wrap to the new key.
unknown_key.impact: Data encrypted with a key that is not in the configuration cannot be read or converted.
unknown_key.label: Payroll data encrypted with an unknown key

php_extensions.fix: Install the missing extensions and restart PHP.
php_extensions.impact: Without a required extension whole areas stop working — backups, exports, PDFs or price calculations.
php_extensions.label: Required PHP extensions

php_extensions_optional.fix: Install the extension if you want full performance and no fallbacks.
php_extensions_optional.impact: A missing optional extension will not stop the application, it only falls back to a slower or more limited path.
php_extensions_optional.label: Optional PHP extensions

php_version.impact: The application uses language features older PHP does not support — some pages will fail.
php_version.label: PHP version

redis.fix: Start Redis, or disable it in the configuration.
redis.impact: Redis that is enabled but unreachable slows down every request while it waits for a connection.
redis.label: Redis

schema_integrity.fix: Run php api/bin/check-schema.php for the full list. Missing objects are created by the migration that should have brought them, or by restoring a backup taken with this application version.
schema_integrity.impact: The database differs from the structure the migrations create. A missing table, column or index causes errors on save; a missing trigger or audit history silently switches off data protection.
schema_integrity.label: Database structure

values.snapshot_outdated: snapshot does not match the migrations of this version

timezone_alignment.fix: Use the same time zone for the system, PHP and the application.
timezone_alignment.impact: Different server and application zones push documents near midnight into another period.
timezone_alignment.label: Time zone alignment

upload_limits.fix: Align upload_max_filesize and post_max_size in php.ini with the document size limit.
upload_limits.impact: The application offers larger files than the server accepts — uploads fail without a clear message.
upload_limits.label: Upload limits

writable_paths.fix: Grant write access to the user the web server runs as.
writable_paths.impact: Without write access no documents, backups or caches are created — this usually shows up only as a save error.
writable_paths.label: Write permissions

diagnostics.checks_hint: Problems and warnings come first. Each one lists its impact, the fix and a link to the manual.

cron_inactive.feature_off: the feature the job serves is not enabled for any company
cron_inactive.not_configured: the directory the job works with is not configured

diagnostics.no_admin: Diagnostics is available to administrators only.

payroll_archive.cli_hint: The same without a run time limit: php api/bin/payroll-archive-reencrypt.php (manual 999.9.4).
payroll_archive.dialog_intro: Each document is encrypted with the key of the person it belongs to. The written copy is verified against the fingerprint of the original, and the original is deleted only after they match. Documents can still be downloaded as before.
payroll_archive.done: Done. The checks have been reloaded.
payroll_archive.failed: The action could not be completed.
payroll_archive.legacy_intro: {count} payroll documents from before encryption was introduced are stored on disk in readable form. Anyone with access to the server or a backup can read them.
payroll_archive.measure_hint: Reads every encrypted payroll value and export and verifies the configuration can decrypt them. On a large database it may take several minutes.
payroll_archive.measured_at: The full measurement of payroll data keys ran at {at}. Between measurements Diagnostics checks only the oldest and newest encrypted records.
payroll_archive.measured_never: The payroll data keys have not been fully measured yet. Diagnostics checks only the oldest and newest encrypted records.
payroll_archive.orphans_hint: They are encrypted with the company key; nothing is deleted. Without this option they stay readable and the check keeps reporting them.
payroll_archive.orphans_label: Also encrypt files not linked to any payroll document
payroll_archive.preview_partial: The preview shows the first batch; {count} more files will be processed in further batches.
payroll_archive.purge_ack: I understand the deletion is irreversible and the documents cannot be restored.
payroll_archive.purge_ack_required: To delete documents of erased persons, first confirm that the deletion is irreversible.
payroll_archive.purge_hint: The key of an erased person no longer exists, so the document cannot be encrypted. The erasure means its content must not stay readable.
payroll_archive.purge_label: Delete unencrypted documents of erased persons
payroll_archive.rewrap_dialog: Converts {count} payroll values, document data keys and exports from the old key to the current one. The content does not change, only the key it is encrypted with.
payroll_archive.rewrap_done: Nothing is encrypted with the old key any more. Ask the server administrator to remove the old key from app.secret_encryption_previous_keys.
payroll_archive.rewrap_intro: After the encryption key was replaced, {count} payroll values are still encrypted with the old key. The old key cannot be removed from the configuration until they are converted.
payroll_archive.rewrap_title: Re-wrap payroll data to the new key

status.integrity_mismatch: Content does not match its fingerprint, needs manual review
status.orphan_skipped: Not linked to a payroll document, kept

payroll_archive.stopped: Processing stopped with {count} files remaining. Review the files below and run it again.
payroll_archive.title: Payroll archive encryption
payroll_archive.unknown_key: {count} values are encrypted with a key that is not in the configuration. They cannot be read or converted without the original key. The server administrator must put it back into app.secret_encryption_previous_keys.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

dimensions.account_map_after_create: Analytic accounts can be set once the value is saved.
dimensions.account_map_empty: No mapping yet, postings stay on the synthetic account.
dimensions.account_map_hint: A document posted to the synthetic account with this dimension value goes to the selected analytic account. The analytic account must sit under the synthetic one and have the same tax deductibility. The mapping applies to this company.
dimensions.analytics_change: Year over year change in selected metric
dimensions.analytics_company_local: A company dimension applies to this company only.
dimensions.analytics_cumulative: Cumulative profit / loss versus previous year
dimensions.analytics_method: Amounts come from posted journal entries on revenue and expense accounts, excluding VAT. Splits across values are allocated to the cent. Totals also include entries without a dimension value. Non-deductible costs follow the corporate and personal income tax return rule: a non-deductible account or purchase invoice. Income tax on 59x accounts is shown separately.
dimensions.analytics_no_values_hint: The statistics need at least one dimension value, such as a project or cost centre. Add it under Company → Dimensions and assign it to documents.
dimensions.analytics_previous_total_only: Previous year comparison is available for the whole dimension.
dimensions.analytics_subtitle: Revenue, costs and profit by project, cost centre or another dimension. Compare values, follow monthly trends and, for a global dimension, compare companies in the group.
dimensions.analytics_top_twelve: The chart shows the first 12 values. The table includes all values.
dimensions.approval_on_toast: Approval is on. Only documents with values that have an approver will need approval.
dimensions.approval_threshold_hint: Empty or 0 = always approved. A document under the limit needs no approval.
dimensions.approver_hint: Documents with this value are approved by the selected person. Without an approver, documents of this value are not approved.
dimensions.balance_filter_note: The balance sheet is filtered by a dimension: it contains only lines with this value (a split line by its share). It balances only when both sides of the entries carry the value; a payment without the dimension leaves the receivable or payable of the value open.
dimensions.balance_range_adjusted: The balance sheet shows a position on one date. The linked range spanned multiple accounting periods, so the period containing the end date was selected.
dimensions.builtin_hint: Builtin meanings cannot be renamed, moved, retired or deleted. You can edit responsibility and notes.
dimensions.cf_cash_movement: Movement on cash accounts in the selection
dimensions.cf_financing: C. Cash flow from financing activities
dimensions.cf_investing: B. Cash flow from investing activities
dimensions.cf_method_note: Indirect method: profit adjusted for non-cash items and changes of balance sheet accounts on lines carrying the value (a split line by its share). Without a value it covers the whole company. The official cash flow statement for the financial statements is under Cash flows & equity.
dimensions.cf_no_activity: There is no cash flow for this selection in the chosen period.
dimensions.cf_operating: A. Cash flow from operating activities
dimensions.cf_unbalanced_hint: The computed flow does not match the cash movement. Check unbalanced entries or cash accounts outside 211, 213, 221 and 261.
dimensions.cf_untagged_hint: The difference is cash that does not carry the dimension value, typically a bank payment of a project invoice without the project. The project receivable or payable then stays open in the report.
dimensions.code_immutable: The code cannot be changed after creation.

defaults.autofilled: Prefilled from the default dimensions of the client, project or paid document.
defaults.hint_category: Applies to products of this category and its subcategories that have no value of the type themselves.
defaults.hint_client: Prefilled into the header of issued and received invoices and cash documents of this client. A document without a dimension of that type gets it when posted. Project defaults take precedence.

group_stats.forecast_method_note: Revenue is the median of run-rate, short-term growth and long-term trend. Costs use last year's seasonality adjusted by the current-to-previous-year ratio. The profit range reflects only the revenue model range with one cost estimate; it is not a confidence interval. Posted and draft volumes are supplementary figures and are not added twice.
group_stats.forecast_sources_note: Invoice models use current-year documents, including any future document dates. The known result impact of other items is added separately. These amounts are neither actual YTD results nor financial statements.

restore.note: Restoration preserves IDs and relationships, so the target database and data directory must be empty. Without --documents, data and attachments are restored but invoice PDFs are not written into the application. Users are restored disabled, without passwords or MFA. For payroll, also securely retain the original encryption and hashing keys from configuration; the ZIP does not contain them. See the manual for the full procedure.

restore.step_extract: Include the Restorable accounting archive part and prepare an empty database migrated by the target MyÚčto version.
restore.step_restore: Only after validation succeeds, run the same command with the --restore parameter. The optional --documents parameter also restores received and issued invoice PDFs into the application and reconnects them to their records.

invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED invoice {varsymbol}

Deletes both the original invoice AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both invoice {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• If paid, bank transaction loses its pair
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?
invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED credit note {varsymbol}

Deletes both the credit note AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both credit note {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?
invoice.delete_force_title: Force-delete: removes the accounting document with all linked cancellations/credit notes
invoice.delete_issued_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED invoice {varsymbol}

This is a valid accounting record — has a generated invoice number, supplier and client snapshots, and may already be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE instead of deleting. Continue?
invoice.delete_issued_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED credit note {varsymbol}

A credit note is a valid accounting record — has a generated number and may be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice is NOT affected — it stays in its current status (typically cancelled)
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Continue?
invoice.delete_paid_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting PAID invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice is issued, sent, paid by the client, and the money is in your bank account. You're deleting an accounting record that corresponds to a real payment.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair (find it again in unmatched)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Revenue / KPIs on dashboard and client/project pages are recomputed
• Action is audited

Recommended: if accidentally marked paid, use Unpay (admin). If returning money, issue a CREDIT NOTE. Really delete?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice was already emailed to the client. They have it in their inbox / may have it in their accounting. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE and explain to the client. Really continue?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT credit note {varsymbol}

This credit note was already emailed to the client. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

Really continue?
invoice.download_pdf_tooltip_signed: Downloads the current invoice PDF. After any edit it is automatically regenerated from current data and electronically signed (PAdES).
invoice.edit_issued_body: You are editing invoice {varsymbol} in status {status}. Changes will overwrite snapshots and may desynchronize the document with the client's records. The action is audited. For the client, we recommend issuing a credit note instead.
invoice.edit_issued_confirm:
⚠ WARNING — editing an ISSUED invoice

Invoice {varsymbol} has already been issued{sent}.

Editing will:
• change the content of a document the client may already have in their books
• overwrite JSON snapshots (immutability is broken)
• keep the original varsymbol (no new one is generated)
• be audited in ActivityLog

Recommended: issue a credit note instead. Continue to the editor anyway?
