Issue the final tax document for paid proforma {varsymbol}?

A draft invoice will be created with items copied from the proforma and the advance payment deducted. You'll be redirected to the editor afterwards.
invoice.issue_final_failed: Failed to issue the final tax document
invoice.issue_no_items: Invoice must contain at least one item.

item_account.hint: Revenue account of individual lines. Empty = product account, its category, otherwise the invoice posting template.
item_account.label: Revenue account

items_table.gross_edit_hint: You can overwrite with the gross (incl. VAT) amount — the net unit price is back-calculated.

line_discount.title: List price of the stock card before discount. A manual price change keeps it and the discount is recalculated. The PDF itemises it when the option in Settings is on.

modals.cancel_credit_desc: For the client — creates a draft with negative values, you'll review the editor and issue.
modals.cancel_delete_desc: Permanently removes the accounting record from the database, including cached PDF, archive of sent versions, and user attachments. Any linked cancellation/credit-note will be deleted TOGETHER. After confirmation you will see a detailed warning based on the current status (issued / sent / paid / cancelled). Recommended only as a last resort.
modals.cancel_delete_desc_cn: Permanently removes the credit note from the database, including cached PDF, archive of sent versions, and user attachments. Any linked cancellation document will be deleted TOGETHER. The original invoice is NOT affected — it stays in its current status. If it frees the last number in the credit-note sequence, that number is released. Recommended only as a last resort.
modals.cancel_internal_desc: For incorrectly issued invoices, the client doesn't receive any document.
modals.cancel_internal_desc_cn: For incorrectly issued credit notes, the client doesn't receive any document.
modals.partial_payment_remaining: {remaining} remaining. Covering the full amount marks the document as paid automatically.
modals.reminder_body: Client will receive an email reminder with the invoice PDF. Status will change to "Reminded" and the reminder count will be incremented.
modals.reminder_default_hint: Pre-filled from client contacts (Reminders purpose, otherwise Documents), project billing emails and the main email. You can add more recipients, e.g. the person who approves the payment. Client contacts and the invoice stay unchanged.
modals.send_default_hint: Pre-filled from client contacts (Documents purpose), project billing emails and the main email; duplicates merged. Edit the list freely.
modals.send_note_hint: The note is added only to the email, NOT to the invoice PDF.
modals.send_note_placeholder: Added to the email body above the invoice details. Each new line = new paragraph.

invoice.negative_item_hint: Enter a discount as a negative quantity or a negative unit price. The final amount due must stay positive.

oss.clause_countries_unknown: Member State of consumption not stated
oss.clause_hint: VAT is declared and paid in the Member State of consumption under the OSS scheme; the document carries the clause in the PDF and in the public preview.
oss.needs_review_hint: The system could not determine the place of supply for this line — check the country of consumption and the rate type. Use the cross to clear the flag.
oss.rate_type_missing_hint: Without a rate type the line will not reach the OSS return. Set it according to the rate applicable in the Member State of consumption.

oss_review_badge.domestic_hint: The line stayed out of OSS and awaits review — it enters the Czech VAT return on lines 1 and 2, check whether it belongs there.
oss_review_badge.oss_hint: The line went into the OSS return but awaits review — check the country of consumption and the rate type, or move it back to the domestic return.

invoice.oss_review_only_hint: Documents with a line whose place of supply the system is unsure about. Some ended up in the OSS return (check the country and rate type), some stayed in the Czech VAT return on lines 1 and 2 (check whether they belong there).

pay_cash.no_register: You have no active cash register.
pay_cash.title: Cash payment

error.account_inactive: The selected counter account is inactive in the chart of accounts.
error.account_same_as_document: The counter account cannot be the account the document sits on.
error.amount_over_remaining: The amount exceeds the remaining balance.
error.date_locked: The payment date falls into a locked part of the books.
error.doc_not_payable: The document is not in a payable state.
error.foreign_currency: This payment method currently supports CZK documents only.
error.partial_not_supported: A purchase invoice can only be paid in full.
error.period_not_open: The accounting period is not open.

pay_common.full_amount_only: A purchase invoice can only be paid in full — partial payments are not tracked for purchase invoices.

pay_method.cash_hint: Creates a cash document and posts the payment right away.
pay_method.label: Payment method
pay_method.plain_hint: Only marks the invoice as paid. Nothing is posted to the journal.
pay_method.settlement_hint: Posts the payment against a chosen account (typically a receivable from a shareholder).

pay_settlement.partial_hint: A set-off may cover part of the document; the remainder stays open.
pay_settlement.title: Payment by set-off

invoice.payment_calendar_hint: A calendar is a tax document only with a schedule of payments for a predetermined period (§ 31 and § 31a of the Czech VAT Act). Individual documents are then not issued for each instalment.
invoice.payment_schedule_mismatch: The schedule total ({total}) does not match the document total ({invoice}). Issuing will be rejected.
invoice.payment_schedule_required: Without a payment schedule the calendar cannot be issued — it would not be a tax document.
invoice.payment_thanks_failed: Marked as paid, but the thank-you e-mail could not be sent.
invoice.payment_thanks_no_recipient: Marked as paid; thank-you not sent (no recipient e-mail).
invoice.payment_variable_symbol_hint: Fill in only if the client should pay under a variable symbol other than the document number. It does not have to be unique.
invoice.payment_variable_symbol_invalid: The payment variable symbol may contain digits only, up to 10.

payments.bank_transactions_hint: The transaction is directly matched to the invoice but is not counted separately in the payment ledger. The displayed details come from the original bank record.
payments.create_tax_doc_checkbox: Issue tax document for payment received
payments.create_tax_doc_hint: Draft with the tax point date (DUZP) set to the payment date; VAT computed top-down by coefficient.
payments.imported_without_details: The document is recorded as paid on {date}, but payment details are unavailable.
payments.locked_bank: Payment from bank matching — remove it via “Unmatch” in the statement detail.
payments.recorded_paid: Payment recorded — the document is fully paid.
payments.title: Payments

penalty.continues_from: Continues from an earlier penalty invoice — only the period since {date} is charged (no double-billing).
penalty.modal_body: Statutory late-payment interest per Government Regulation No. 351/2013 Coll. (CNB repo rate + 8 pp). Interest is outside the scope of VAT and posts to account 644.
penalty.tooltip: Create a late-payment interest invoice ({days} days overdue)

price_level.hint: Reprices stock lines with an automatically filled price. Manually edited prices and prices of an already saved document stay.
price_level.label: Document price level
price_level.stale: The document price level is no longer active. The document is priced by the customer's level; saving removes the level from the document.

invoice.price_list_added: The price list item was inserted into the document.
invoice.price_list_requires_context: Select a customer and document currency before inserting a price list item.
invoice.prices_include_vat_hint: Item prices are gross (incl. VAT); VAT is calculated top-down so the total matches to the cent.
invoice.print_failed: Could not prepare the PDF for printing.
invoice.proforma_no_tax_point: Proforma has no tax point. The tax document is issued after payment.

public_link.btn_title: Permanent public link to the invoice for the client
public_link.copy_failed: Copy failed — please copy the link manually
public_link.email_note: The link is automatically included in the email when the invoice is sent to the client.
public_link.load_failed: Failed to load the web invoice
public_link.modal_hint: Permanent public link — the client can view the invoice in a browser and download the PDF without signing in.
public_link.not_viewed: Client has not viewed the invoice yet
public_link.regenerate_confirm: Generate a new link? The current link will stop working immediately (useful e.g. when the URL leaked to a wrong recipient).
public_link.regenerate_failed: Failed to generate a new link
public_link.regenerate_title: The current link will stop working
public_link.regenerated: New link generated — the previous one no longer works

invoice.quantity_decimals_blocked: Some quantities have more decimal places than their unit allows. Correct the highlighted rows.
invoice.quantity_decimals_warning: Unit {unit} allows at most this many decimal places: {n}. Correct the quantity, nothing is rounded.
invoice.rebuild_snapshots_confirm: Overwrite supplier, customer and bank details on this document with their current values? Amounts, status and document number stay unchanged. The generated PDF is invalidated and the new one may differ from the one the customer received.
invoice.reminder_confirm: Send reminder to client? Invoice is {days} days overdue.
invoice.revenue_category_filter_hint: Pick revenue categories and switch whether you want to see only them, or hide them instead — e.g. small subscription invoices. The "No category" option targets documents with no category set.
invoice.reverse_charge_io_hint: You invoice without VAT — the amounts shown are the tax base. The customer self-assesses VAT at their country's rate; no Czech VAT rate appears on the document. The supply is included in the EC Sales List.

rounding.hint: The amount due after deducting advances is rounded to the nearest crown. The tax base and VAT stay unchanged. Round cash on delivery only when paid in cash.
rounding.label: Rounding
rounding.unavailable: Rounding is available for invoices and credit notes in CZK except card payments.

invoice.search_placeholder: Search by number, VS, order no. or client…
invoice.send_payment_thanks: Send the customer a payment thank-you
invoice.send_payment_thanks_no_recipient: The invoice has no recipient e-mail.
invoice.send_test_reminder_done: Test reminder sent ({days} days overdue) to {recipients}

signing.hint: This setting applies only to this document and overrides the system output mapping. Saving the invoice setting invalidates the cached PDF.
signing.title: Electronic signature

invoice.simplified_blocked_eu: A simplified document cannot be issued for goods supplied to another member state (§ 30(2)) — without identifying the customer the supply cannot be reported in the EC sales list.
invoice.simplified_blocked_limit: Above the {limit} limit — the document totals {total} including VAT. A simplified document cannot be issued (§ 30(1) VAT Act).
invoice.simplified_blocked_reverse_charge: A simplified document cannot be issued under the reverse charge regime (§ 30(2)) — the customer needs their VAT ID on the document, otherwise the supply drops out of the control statement.
invoice.simplified_document_hint: Up to CZK 10,000 including VAT; need not state the customer, the tax base or the tax amount (§ 30a).
invoice.simplified_document_walk_in_hint: No customer: the document is issued to an end customer and no customer is printed on it.

smtp_log.hint: What the mail server did with this sent invoice — on the send day and the next day, for this invoice's recipients.
smtp_log.no_events: Nothing found in the server log for these recipients on that day.
smtp_log.not_sent: This invoice has not been e-mailed yet.
smtp_log.title: SMTP analysis

stock_pricing.source_hint: Price filled in automatically from the customer, currency and document date. A manually entered price is kept when the customer changes.

invoice.subtitle_grouping: Grouped by tax point (or issue date for proformas)
invoice.supplier_order_number_hint: Optional order reference used to match the document to a payment automatically.
invoice.text_row_hint: Text on the document only, not included in amounts or VAT.
invoice.text_row_placeholder: Text between items, e.g. a section heading or a note
invoice.title: Issued invoices

tracking.empty: There are no units of this item in the selected warehouse.
tracking.empty_return: The original invoice issued no units of this item that could be returned.
tracking.free_hint: Return without an original invoice: enter the unit manually, it is received back into stock.
tracking.free_invalid: Enter a serial number, or a lot and quantity (up to 3 decimals). The same unit cannot be added twice.
tracking.free_serial: Serial number of the returned unit
tracking.load_failed: Units in stock could not be loaded.
tracking.required_on_issue: The full line quantity must be selected before issuing.
tracking.required_toast: Select serial numbers or lots for the full line quantity:

invoice.type_change_renumber: ⚠ Changing the type renumbers the document — the current number {varsymbol} is released back to its series and a new number from the target type's series is assigned.
invoice.uncancel_confirm: Undo the cancellation of invoice {varsymbol}? The invoice returns to its state before cancellation and the cancellation document is deleted. If the cancellation was posted, its journal entries are deleted too.
invoice.uncancel_done: Cancellation undone, the invoice is valid again.
invoice.unmark_paid_confirm: Revert invoice {varsymbol} from paid back to issued? The payment date will be cleared.
invoice.unmark_paid_done: Invoice reverted from paid back to its previous state.
invoice.unpaid_as_of_hint: Shows documents issued by the selected date that were not fully paid as of that day — regardless of today's status. Same definition as in the Balance report (Saldokonto).
invoice.varsymbol_hint: Optional manual override. Empty → generated on Issue per Supplier settings → Invoice numbering.
invoice.varsymbol_manual_warning: A manual number bypasses the automatic series — the counter won't advance and you're responsible for its uniqueness and continuity. Leave empty to auto-generate.
invoice.varsymbol_no_template: No format set — go to Settings → Invoice numbering, or fill in manually.

warning.credit_note_positive_total: The credit note has a positive total — in the VAT return and control statement the supply will be ADDED instead of deducted, while the journal reverses it. Flip the sign: negative quantity or negative price (one is enough).
warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the tax date by {diff} %. Please check the rate.
warning.oss_derived_notes: The document arrived through the API without OSS data, so we derived the scheme ourselves. Per-line details are in the API response (`_warning_meta.oss_derived_notes`); lines whose place of supply could not be determined are flagged for manual review.
warning.oss_document_contradiction: The document contradicts itself: some lines are in the OSS scheme and some stayed taxed domestically, so one invoice sits in two different returns. We saved it — a single invoice may legitimately do both — but the affected lines are flagged for manual review. Check the rates: if the domestic lines belong to OSS too, they must carry the rate of the country of consumption.

invoice.wr_hint: The work report prints on a second page of the invoice PDF. If filled, set the invoice item manually (e.g. "Extra work {title} — total {hours}h × {rate} {currency}").
invoice.wr_material_not_in_items_confirm:
Material report “{description}” for {amount} {ccy} is not entered as an invoice item.

Continue without transferring the material to the invoice?
invoice.wr_material_price_incl: Enter material prices including VAT (document is in VAT-inclusive mode).
invoice.wr_not_in_items_confirm:
Work report "{description}" has {hours}h for {amount} {ccy}, but is not listed as an invoice item.

Continue without transferring the work report to the invoice?
invoice.wr_saved_and_synced: Work report saved and invoice item synced
invoice.wr_sync_note: On save, the work report is stored and its total is written as one invoice item (qty=1, price=total). If an item with the same description exists, it's updated.

payment_thanks_reasons.stale_payment: payment is older than the configured limit
payment_thanks_reasons.suppressed_after_release: payment was already known before the statement was deleted
payment_thanks_reasons.rate_limit: held back by the sending limit

invoice_default_note.enabled_hint: While this is off, nothing is pre-filled.
invoice_default_note.hint: Text pre-filled into the note below items on every newly created document. You can rewrite or delete it in the document at any time; already issued documents are left untouched.
invoice_default_note.language_hint: The variant follows the document language, not the currency. When the text for the document language is missing, the note stays empty.
invoice_default_note.placeholder: E.g. retention of title and the late payment interest rate.
invoice_default_note.title: Default note below items

jointAllocations.cancelHelp: Cancellation posts an exact mirror in an open period and releases the original sources for a new allocation. History remains available.
jointAllocations.evidence: Evidence supporting amounts and their relationship in both currencies
jointAllocations.exactHelp: Enter decimal amounts using a dot, separately in CZK and the source currency. Totals and all retained dimensions must match. The original currency and exchange rate are preserved. Red reversal signs remain on the lines.
jointAllocations.fullTupleHelp: Each cell declares one complete combination. Include every other dimension split on the source. Percentages of independent axes are not multiplied.
jointAllocations.immutableKey: A saved version is immutable. Versions of the same key must have non-overlapping effective dates; create a new key to correct the same interval.
jointAllocations.intro: Documented reclassification of profit and loss lines by activity, activity kind and provisional tax treatment. Source entries remain unchanged.
jointAllocations.keyDateRequired: Select a version effective on the reclassification date.
jointAllocations.name: Name
jointAllocations.noHistory: No allocations have been posted yet.
jointAllocations.noSources: Find effective profit and loss lines under framework 504. Sources with active allocations and allocation entries are excluded.
jointAllocations.previewHelp: The preview includes a compensation line for the original assignment and separate target lines. Posting rechecks the current source, key and open destination period.
jointAllocations.requestFailed: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
jointAllocations.resolveWithKey: Complete the joint cells in a new key

revenueProposal.applyNeedsWeighted: The proposal can only be applied with the "Weights of full combinations" allocation mode.
revenueProposal.applyNoAdditionalAxes: The proposal contains only the three joint axes. Clear the other retained dimensions before applying it.

errors.failed: The proposal could not be loaded. Please try again.
errors.rejected: A proposal cannot be built for the entered period or accounting framework. Check the date range.

revenueProposal.help: The proposal is based only on posted revenue in the chosen period of source entries. It is an aid for your decision, not a tax or legal validation of the allocation. Loading a proposal changes and saves nothing.
revenueProposal.invalidRange: Enter valid from and to dates; the from date must not be later than the to date.
revenueProposal.manualReview: Applying only overwrites the cells in the form above and sets the Revenue basis. Review the proposal manually and only then save it with Save immutable version.

reasons.negative_cell: A cell would have a negative value, so the proposal cannot be used.
reasons.no_revenue: There is no posted revenue in the period.
reasons.split_dimensions: Some revenue is split across several dimension values, so a proposal cannot be built.
reasons.system_dimensions_missing: System dimensions (activity, activity kind or tax treatment) are missing.
reasons.too_many_cells: The proposal would have too many cells.
reasons.unclassified_revenue: Part of the revenue does not have all three joint axes filled in.
reasons.unknown: The proposal cannot be used for an unknown reason.

revenueProposal.title: Weight proposal from revenue (advisory)

kb_plus.authorization_hint: Access consent or submitting a payment file does not mean payment was made. Authorize payments in online banking when required; statements confirm actual settlement.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable: Sending payment orders to KB is currently not active and the application cannot verify why. Transactions import normally. Refresh the connection status; if the notice remains, verify the connection again.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_authorization: The application is registered at KB for payment batches, but the granted account consent does not include the bpisp permission yet. Transactions import normally. Choose Start new verification in KB+ and grant a new consent; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_plan_basic: Sending payment orders to KB is unavailable because the Basic variant is selected, which only provides statements. After switching to Plus in KB+, change the variant above and start a new verification for payment batches.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_registration: Sending payment orders to KB is not active because the application is registered at KB for reading transactions only, without the bpisp permission. Transactions import normally. For payment batches, choose Enter keys again, select I also want payment batches and complete the registration and consent at KB.
kb_plus.connected: The bank confirmed access to the correct account and currency. You can now import statements using synchronization.
kb_plus.credentials_hint: Credentials are sent only to the application server and are not stored in browser storage. Fields are cleared after a registration attempt. The certificate must not exceed 24 KiB.
kb_plus.error_account_ambiguous: The bank returned multiple possible accounts. The connection was not saved for safety; ask your administrator to check account identification.
kb_plus.error_account_not_found: The bank did not grant access to this account and currency. Check the account and consent scope granted at KB.
kb_plus.error_app_url: The administrator must configure the public HTTPS application address and matching KB callbacks.
kb_plus.error_busy: Another operation is running for this account. Wait and refresh the status.
kb_plus.error_callback_redaction: The administrator must ensure that web server, proxy and application logs do not retain sensitive bank callback parameters.
kb_plus.error_certificate: The certificate could not be read or is invalid. Select a qualified .p12/.pfx file up to 24 KiB and check its password.
kb_plus.error_certificate_runtime: The server lacks required client certificate support. The administrator must check PHP, cURL and OpenSSL configuration.
kb_plus.error_contact: The administrator must configure a valid application contact email (at most 43 characters).
kb_plus.error_cooldown: The request limit has been reached. Wait before refreshing the connection status.
kb_plus.error_credentials_rejected: KB rejected the API key or certificate. Check that the keys come from production services (not Sandbox) and belong to the right service, and that the certificate is qualified and contains the organization name and company ID.
kb_plus.error_encryption: The administrator must configure a valid server encryption key to securely store bank credentials.
kb_plus.error_expired: The verification link expired. Start a new verification.
kb_plus.error_generic: The KB+ connection could not be completed. Refresh the status and check server readiness and bank registration.
kb_plus.error_plan: The API Business variant could not be saved. Refresh the connection status and try again.
kb_plus.error_redirect: The server returned a disallowed redirect destination. The link was not opened for safety. Reload the page and contact the administrator.
kb_plus.error_registration_invalid: KB did not complete registration or returned invalid registration details. Check API keys, the certificate and bank application settings.
kb_plus.error_registration_plan: The application registration at KB does not include the service the selected variant needs (Basic downloads statements via STATDA, Plus reads transactions via ADAA). Choose Enter keys again and register again.
kb_plus.error_remote: The connection to KB could not be completed. Refresh the status; if the issue persists, check bank availability and server settings.
kb_plus.error_used: This verification link has already been used or replaced. Refresh the status and start again if needed.
kb_plus.existing_client_hint: The application is already registered for this company. Continue to KB to grant or renew access to this account; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.field_batchda_api_key: BatchDA API key (optional, only if KB issued one to you)
kb_plus.intro: KB+ is the banking application; this connection uses the Extra service API Business. It is not the legacy KB Business API for MojeBanka. With the Plus variant the connector reads transactions via ADAA and sends payment batches via BATCHDA; with the Basic variant it downloads KM statements via STATDA.
kb_plus.logging_warning: Notice: KB callback URLs may contain sensitive registration data or authorization codes. Web server, proxy or application logs may retain them. We recommend disabling or redacting these parameters in logs. This notice does not block connection.
kb_plus.official_faq: Activation and consent management in KB+
kb_plus.official_service: KB API Business terms and variants
kb_plus.payment_batches_hint: The KB registration also requests the bpisp permission for sending payment batches. Select it only if your Extra service API Business variant includes batches; otherwise KB rejects the registration.
kb_plus.pending_hint: Verification is not complete. Finish the open KB step and refresh the status. Starting again invalidates the previous unfinished link.
kb_plus.plan_basic_hint: KM statements (STATDA) for previous business days only, downloaded automatically once a day (KB allows at most 50 downloads per month). Read-only, payment orders cannot be sent. Switching from Plus requires a registration and consent with the statda permission.
kb_plus.plan_intro: Select the variant contracted with KB. It determines how often transactions are downloaded and whether payment orders can be sent.
kb_plus.plan_plus_hint: Transactions including today, downloaded automatically at most once per 61 minutes. Also supports payment batches (BATCHDA) if the consent includes the bpisp permission. Select it for the Pro variant too.
kb_plus.plan_saved: The API Business variant has been saved.
kb_plus.prerequisite_activation: First select an Extra service API Business variant in KB+ and conclude the agreement. Then connect in MyÚčto. Manage existing consents in KB+: Settings → Service settings → Account access → Third-party access. Contact kbplus{'@'}kb.cz if options or permissions are missing.
kb_plus.prerequisite_bank: Business accounts require KB+ with a paid Standard Business, Komfort Business or Exclusive Business tariff and a separately activated Extra service API Business. KB+ alone or the free Start Business tariff is not sufficient. KB's FAQ also permits private individuals with an active Premium service; confirm eligibility for your account with KB.
kb_plus.prerequisite_certificate: A qualified client certificate supported by KB, in .p12/.pfx format including its private key. A regular communication certificate from another bank is not a replacement.
kb_plus.prerequisite_plan: The Business banking tariff and API Business service variant are separate products. Basic is free and only provides statements for previous business days (STATDA service), at most 50 downloads per month. Plus reads transactions (ADAA service) at most once per 61 minutes and includes payment batches, Pro once per 10 minutes. Set your contracted variant below. Confirm current pricing, scope and limits with the bank.
kb_plus.prerequisite_server: A public HTTPS application address, a server encryption key and an application contact email. The server checks readiness.
kb_plus.prerequisite_subscriptions: Technical application registration is a separate administrator step: subscribe to the Client Registration, OAuth and ADAA APIs at developers.kb.cz; each has its own key. For the Basic variant also subscribe to the Statements Direct API (STATDA); its key is not entered in the form, statements are authorised by the consent with the statda permission. Payment batches (BATCHDA) do not need a separate key. Select I also want payment batches during registration and the application is registered at KB with the bpisp permission as well. Fill in the BatchDA key only if KB issued one to you. These keys do not replace the bank service agreement or the account owner's consent.
kb_plus.redirecting: Registration has started. Redirecting to the secure KB page.
kb_plus.restart_confirm: Start new verification with KB? This invalidates the previous unfinished verification link.
kb_plus.server_not_ready: Server configuration currently prevents connection. Contact the application administrator.
kb_plus.statements_unavailable_authorization: Transactions cannot be imported now: the selected variant reads data via {service}, but the granted account consent does not include this permission. Choose Start new verification in KB+ and grant a new consent; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.statements_unavailable_registration: Transactions cannot be imported now: the selected variant reads data via {service}, but the application is registered at KB without this permission. Choose Enter keys again and complete the registration and consent at KB.
kb_plus.status_authorization_pending: Waiting for account access consent at KB.
kb_plus.status_expired: Previous verification has expired. Start a new verification.
kb_plus.status_not_registered: The application is not registered for KB+ yet.
kb_plus.status_registered: The application is registered. Continue to grant account access.
kb_plus.status_registration_pending: Waiting for application registration confirmation at KB.
kb_plus.title: KB Business

license.activate_desc: Enter the key you bought at myucto.cz. Activation binds the license to this installation.
license.already_bound_desc: You probably reinstalled or moved MyÚčto without deactivating the original installation. You can transfer the license here — the original binding will be released.
license.already_bound_title: This license is active on another installation.
license.annual_confirm: Switch to annual billing and charge {amount} to the saved card? The license will then be valid until {date}.
license.annual_desc: Annual billing costs ten months instead of twelve. It follows on from the month you already paid for, so you lose none of those days. Switching back to monthly or buying another year up front is not possible afterwards.
license.annual_quote_detail: You are charged {months} months instead of twelve and save {saving}.
license.annual_quote_valid_until: The license is then valid until {date}.
license.annual_success: Billing is annual now, the license is valid until {date}.
license.banner_degraded: Your license has expired — paid accounting modules are unavailable. Invoicing and the free foundation keep working.
license.banner_overage: You have exceeded your license scope. Upgrade your subscription within {days} days, otherwise renewal will be paused.
license.banner_overage_nodeadline: You have exceeded your license scope. Please upgrade your subscription.
license.banner_trial: Trial ends in {days} days — activate a license to keep double-entry accounting, stock and other commercial modules available.

terms_articles.body: Three plans by number of company agendas (1 company / up to 10 / unlimited). Pricing is per active user and month, excluding VAT; VAT is added. Monthly or annual period (annual = 10 monthly payments).
terms_articles.title: 1. Subscription, plans and pricing

terms_articles.body: You choose the plan, number of users, period and billing details. After a summary and the first payment the contract is concluded and you receive a confirmation and license key by e-mail.
terms_articles.title: 2. Order and conclusion of contract

terms_articles.body: Card payments via the GoPay gateway; card details are not available to the provider. Payment recurs with your consent, at a fixed amount, monthly or annually. You can cancel any time, effective at the end of the paid period.
terms_articles.title: 3. Payment terms and recurring payments

terms_articles.body: The key is sent immediately after payment (usually within minutes). Activation happens directly in the app. Scope upgrades take effect immediately.
terms_articles.title: 4. Delivery and activation of the license

terms_articles.body: The license lasts the paid period and extends with further payments. Cancellation is possible any time; the license runs until the end of the period with no pro-rata refund. The first 60 days are free.
terms_articles.title: 5. Term, termination and refunds

terms_articles.body: 60 days free from first launch. After the subscription expires and a 14-day grace period, the paid accounting modules become unavailable; the free foundation remains fully operational and paid-module data is not deleted.
terms_articles.title: 6. Trial period and unlicensed scope

terms_articles.body: Complaints are handled by e-mail, resolved within 30 days. The software does not replace the user's professional judgment. Consumers have the right to out-of-court dispute resolution via the Czech Trade Inspection.
terms_articles.title: 7. Support and liability

terms_articles.body: Payment cards are processed by GoPay. The provider processes billing and contact details. The license mechanism transmits only technical data — no accounting or personal data.
terms_articles.title: 8. Personal data protection

connection.claude_1: In Claude on the web or desktop, open Customize → Connectors. On an individual account choose + → Add custom connector; in an organization an Owner must add it first.
connection.claude_2: Enter the address above, add the connector, and use Connect to complete MyÚčto sign-in.
connection.claude_3: In a conversation, enable the connector with + → Connectors and try the verification prompt.
connection.claude_mobile: Once added to your Claude account, the remote connector is also available in the Claude mobile app.
connection.env_managed: The server state is controlled by MYINVOICE_MCP_ENABLED. Change it in the server configuration and restart the application.

connection.node_missing: The server needs Node.js, PHP CLI, and the proc_open function. Verify that the application can use them, then reload this page.
connection.permissions: Each call checks your current company membership, permissions, and read or read and write scope against the requested company ID. Newly assigned companies become available without another consent. Accounting and taxes remain read only.
connection.remote_intro: Once enabled, the MCP server runs on this installation's domain. Add the address to your AI assistant as a custom remote connector. You do not need to download an .mjs file or install Node.js on your computer or phone; Node.js must be available on the MyÚčto server.
connection.revoke: Revoke a connection in the list above, and remove it from the assistant's settings if needed.
connection.settings_load_error: Could not load the remote MCP server status.

connection.step_add: Add a custom remote connector in ChatGPT or Claude and enter this address.
connection.step_authorize: In the browser window, sign in to MyÚčto and review the requested access. The connection covers every company your account can currently access. If MFA is enabled, verify with a passkey or a fresh authenticator code. Without MFA, simply approve access. Choose read access for ordinary questions; allow read and write only when needed.
connection.step_copy: Copy this installation's MCP server address.
connection.step_verify: Enable the connector in a new chat and ask the assistant to verify the MyÚčto connection and list available companies. The whoami and list_suppliers tools return your account and companies; subsequent tools use the company ID.
connection.url_requirement: The domain must resolve in public DNS and be reachable from the internet over HTTPS with a publicly trusted certificate. A local address or private CA certificate is insufficient: the assistant connects from its provider's servers, not your device.

money_s3.dry_run_hint: The whole transfer runs, including closing of historical years and reconciliation, and then everything is rolled back. Nothing stays in MyÚčto.

file_help_items: A single file with the .lz extension that Money S3 creates with its Back up agenda function. The name contains the company ID and the agenda number, for example 12345678ag001.lz.
Inside is a plain ZIP with the agenda data files (*.DAT) split by fiscal year and basic information about the agenda. One backup contains all years.
Upload it exactly as Money created it, without unpacking. The same file renamed to .zip is accepted too.
The backup does not carry the Money electronic document archive. Attach document scans separately in Documents → Scans to documents.
The backup contains the company's entire accounting. The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 24 hours without any work on the migration.

pamica.export_auto_detect: Upload the resulting ZIP from any route below; the same preview, dry run and transfer follow.
export_help_items: Download the export tool and copy it to the computer that holds the PAMICA data file. It runs on Windows in PowerShell 5.1, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.
Close PAMICA so the data file is not locked. The tool opens it read-only, but a running program can still hold a write lock.

Run Export-Pamica.cmd by double-clicking it. The tool looks for the data file in the usual PAMICA locations; otherwise pass the path, for example Export-Pamica.cmd -Mdb "C:\ProgramData\STORMWARE\PAMICA\Data\Mzdy.mdb".
To migrate selected years only, use the -Rok parameter, for example -Rok 2026. Without it every year found in the data file is exported.
A pamica_export_<date>.zip file appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
file_help_items: The export carries employees and employments, processed payroll by month, pay components, absences, deductions, leave, payout accounts and the submission status for the social security and health insurance authorities.
It contains no accounting. The journal, invoices, cash and bank are migrated separately under Migration from POHODA.
The company must already exist in MyUcto with the same company ID as in PAMICA. Data is migrated into the company you are working in; create a new company first if needed.
Months preceding the payroll start period are not recalculated. Their results are stored as opening balances of annual accumulators so that annual settlement and caps follow on.
The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 24 hours of inactivity.
pamica.no_matching_agenda: The export contains no payroll for the company ID used in MyUcto ({ico}). Check the company ID in the company settings and in PAMICA.
sql_help_items: Download the tools below and extract them into one folder on a Windows computer that can reach the SQL Server running PAMICA.
Copy the pamica-sql.example.json sample as pamica-sql.json next to the script and fill in the server, port and login. Without this file the tool asks for everything; the password is entered hidden.
Double-click Export-PamicaSQL.cmd. Pick the payroll database from the list (databases with employees, employments and processed payroll are offered), or set it in the configuration.
To migrate selected years only, use the -Rok parameter, for example -Rok 2026. The result is the same as for the MDB data file.
A pamica_export_<date>.zip file appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
pamica.sql_help_requirements: All you need is Windows PowerShell 5.1 and network access to the SQL Server. The SQL user only needs read access: we recommend a dedicated login with the db_datareader role in the payroll database. An empty user means signing in with the Windows account.
pamica.subtitle: Transfers HR records and payroll from the PAMICA payroll data file: employees, employments, monthly payroll inputs, attendance summaries and opening balances of annual accumulators. Accounting is migrated separately under Migration from POHODA.
pamica.title: Migration from PAMICA
pamica.tool_group_mdb_hint: Run Export-Pamica.cmd on the computer that holds the PAMICA data file.
pamica.tool_group_sql_hint: Run Export-PamicaSQL.cmd on a computer with access to the SQL Server. It needs Export-Pamica.ps1 and PohodaSql-Common.ps1 next to it; download the entire package.
pamica.tool_hint: Download all files at once as a ZIP, or one by one. The files of one route must sit in the same folder. The tools connect to PAMICA data, not to POHODA.
pamica.tool_role_config: Configuration sample: fill it in and save it next to the script as pamica-sql.json.
pamica.upload_hint: PAMICA has no XML interface like POHODA, so payroll is read straight from the data file (Mzdy*.mdb) or from the PAMICA SQL database. The tools only read the data and change nothing in PAMICA.
pamica.upload_title: Create the PAMICA export and upload it

benefit_baskets.drift_note: The frozen split does not match today's limit; the limit changed in the rules after approval.
benefit_baskets.explainer_body: The act exempts benefits up to the limit in aggregate for the whole provision. The basket therefore adds up per person and employer — across concurrent employment relationships and across payroll components of the same basket. Benefits above the limit are not forbidden; only the excess is taxed and subject to contributions.
benefit_baskets.explainer_frozen: The exempt and above-limit parts are read frozen from the moment the input was approved, so they match the payslip. This overview does not recalculate them against today's rules.
benefit_baskets.explainer_monthly: The monthly tab shows baskets under Section 6(9)(b) and (i) of the Income Tax Act. For temporary accommodation the limit is monthly, so the monthly total can be measured against it. For the meal contribution, however, the act ties the limit to a SINGLE SHIFT — a monthly total cannot be compared with it, so this overview asserts no limit and no remainder for it.
benefit_baskets.explainer_title: The limit is a shared basket, not a cap on one component

limit_basis.calendar_month: The limit applies per calendar month.
limit_basis.per_shift: The limit is per single shift, not per month — a monthly total cannot be measured against it. The figure says how much was provided during the month, not that the limit was met.
limit_basis.tax_year: The limit applies per tax period.

discountIntents.intro: The employer discount for short working hours is reported in the monthly report, but the entitlement comes from a different filing: the notification of intent (OZUSPOJ). Without it the Czech Social Security Administration will not recognise the discount and the deducted premium becomes a debt. The discount is applied only once the intent carries the delivery date from the CSSA protocol.
discountIntents.legalBasis: Sections 7a(5), 7c and 23d-23f of Act No. 589/1992 Coll.; OZUSPOJ23 data message.
discountIntents.notEvidenced: This intent does not evidence the discount yet, so it is not applied in the payroll calculation.

eldp.intro: The record sheet is no longer an annual duty. From 2026 the employer neither draws it up nor files it — pension insurance data is reported in the single monthly employer report and the Czech Social Security Administration assembles the sheet from it; employees can see it on the ČSSZ ePortal. Here you prepare one only in three exceptions:
eldp.legalBasis: Act No. 582/1991 Coll., Section 38(1) and (2) and Section 39(1) as amended by Act No. 360/2025 Coll.; exceptions under Section 38a(2) and (3) and the transitional provisions. The form itself was not abolished, it merely stopped being routine.

Go through the schedule — if the activity is not listed and does not involve explosives, radioactive substances, radon, infectious material, poisons or work at great heights or depths, it belongs to „Other economic activities“ (5.6 ‰).
schedule.okec_warning: Annex 2 classifies activities by OKEČ, which the Czech Statistical Office retired on 31 December 2007 and replaced with CZ-NACE. The decree has not changed since, so OKEČ remains the binding classification — and the same number means something else in each: OKEČ 62 is air transport, CZ-NACE 62 is information technology. Do not match code numbers. No legal act contains a binding OKEČ to CZ-NACE conversion table either; the insurers' tables are guidance only, and some CZ-NACE codes end up with two different rates in them.

employer.accounting_hint: Postings distinguish employee wages, a partner's dependent income, statutory-office remuneration, insurance, tax and other deductions.

accounting_row_hint.accident_insurance: Quarterly premium under Decree No. 125/1993 Coll. The insurer issues no document, so under double-entry bookkeeping the charge (debit expense / credit liability) is created when payments are prepared for the last month of the quarter, and the payment is then posted against that liability.
accounting_row_hint.employee_receivable: Where a negative net wage is reclassified — typically health insurance topped up to the minimum assessment base in a month with no cash income. The employee owes the employer, so this is a receivable (335), not a payable.
accounting_row_hint.enforcement_deductions: Deductions ordered by a court, a bailiff or an insolvency administrator. Kept apart from other deductions because they carry a claim ranking and go to a different recipient than voluntary deductions — on a shared account the two balances merge and cannot be traced.
accounting_row_hint.enforcement_fee_revenue: The CZK 50 monthly flat fee the wage payer keeps from the deducted amount to cover its costs (Section 270(2) of the Civil Procedure Code). It is deducted from the employee but not sent to the creditor — without moving it to revenue, a balance would build up on the garnishment liability every month. Usually 648 Other operating revenue. Leave empty to keep the fee on the liability.
accounting_row_hint.non_deductible_benefit: The tax-exempt part of a non-cash benefit (recreation, sport, culture, health care, printed books). Under Section 25(1)(h) of the Income Tax Act it is precisely the EXEMPT part that is non-deductible; the part above the cap is taxed at the employee and stays deductible. Account 528 flows automatically into non-deductible expenses in the corporate income tax return.
accounting_row_hint.risky_savings: Statutory employer contribution to retirement savings for risk work (4% of the assessment base from 1 January 2026). It is not paid to the employee but remitted to the pension company, so it is a statutory social expense (527) against other payables (379), not insurance on 336.
accounting_row_hint.travel_expense: A travel allowance reimburses an expense under Part Seven of the Labour Code; it is not remuneration for work and does not belong in wage expenses. The contra account stays the payable account of the employment relationship, because the allowance is paid together with the wage.
accounting_row_hint.withholding_tax: Tax at a special rate under § 6(4) of the Income Tax Act (small agreements without a taxpayer declaration). It is remitted by a separate payment (account prefix 7720 instead of 7704), on a different due date and reported separately, so a shared account merges both liabilities and the balance can no longer be matched against the payments. Tax bonuses and annual settlement refunds belong to the ADVANCE tax account, not here.
