blocked.document: Find the debt relief approval decision in Documents; the payment instruction cannot be evidenced without it.
blocked.employment: Pick the employment the deduction comes from — the debt relief payment instruction cannot be created without it.
blocked.read_only: You only have read access to debt relief, so you cannot save it.

insolvency.cancel_confirm: Cancel the unused debt-relief payment instruction for {period} on employment {employment}? The approval is withdrawn and this cannot be undone.
insolvency.cancel_failed: The approved debt relief could not be cancelled.
insolvency.cancelled: The unused approved debt relief was cancelled.
insolvency.conflict: Another user changed the record. The current state has been reloaded.
insolvency.court_amount_hint: The amount from the court order. It is withheld exactly, but never above the statutory attachable part — a month with lower income yields less.
insolvency.document_permission: Selecting a decision requires permission to read Documents.
insolvency.document_search_failed: The decision could not be found in Documents.
insolvency.empty_message: Debt relief is recorded directly for a person and month; do not create an enforcement case for it.
insolvency.explicit_cancel_required: An approved instruction cannot be cancelled by changing the mode. Use the separate Cancel approved debt relief button.

impact.alert_only: Insolvency proceedings have commenced and debt relief has not been decided yet (Section 109(1) of the Insolvency Act). Enforcement deductions keep being calculated in their existing scope, but the whole withheld amount stays on deposit — nothing is remitted to creditors and deduction agreements are not withheld. Once debt relief is approved or bankruptcy is declared, hand the deposit over to the insolvency administrator in the enforcement case detail.
impact.approved_standard: The application creates an immutable payment instruction, calculates the standard deduction and prepares a real liability after payroll approval. Recorded non-priority enforcements are not carried out while debt relief runs.
impact.court_determined_amount: The application creates an immutable payment instruction and withholds the court-determined amount, capped by the statutory attachable part. Recorded non-priority enforcements are not carried out while debt relief runs.
impact.none: No debt-relief deduction. This mode does not cancel an approved instruction; use explicit cancellation.

insolvency.instruction_bound: The record is bound to immutable payment instruction #{id}.
insolvency.invalid_amount: The amount must be a positive number.
insolvency.load_failed: The debt-relief record could not be loaded.
insolvency.mode_alert: Insolvency proceedings commenced — withhold and hold
insolvency.mode_none: Debt relief does not apply this month
insolvency.no_accounts: An effective verified CZK Other recipient account is missing. Add it in Payroll settings.
insolvency.no_employments: No effective employment is available for this month.
insolvency.open_institution_accounts: Add the administrator's account in Payroll settings → Institution accounts
insolvency.save_failed: The debt-relief record could not be saved.
insolvency.subtitle: A separate monthly debt-relief record without creating an enforcement case.
insolvency.title: Debt relief

cancel_components.already: The cancellation of selected employments already exists as submission no. {id}.
cancel_components.description: The corrective report will carry cancelling forms for the selected employments only. The other forms stay valid at ČSSZ.
cancel_components.disabled_reason: Select at least one employment and confirm the impact of the cancellation.
cancel_components.failed: The cancellation of selected employments could not be prepared.
cancel_components.frozen: The cancellation of selected employments is prepared as submission no. {id}; send it the same way as the regular report.
cancel_components.impact: I understand that ČSSZ will cancel the forms of the selected employments for the period and their data will have to be filed again.
cancel_components.load_failed: The employments of the regular report could not be loaded.
cancel_components.mode_whole: The whole submission for the period

codes.eldp_absence_interval_invalid: The employment absence has an invalid start or end date, so an excluded period for the pension record cannot be safely derived. Correct the absence date.
codes.eldp_absence_kind_unknown: The absence has an unknown kind in the records that the pension record cannot write. Check and correct the absence kind.
codes.eldp_absence_kind_unsupported: This absence kind has no documented way to be written into the pension record; handle this case individually.
codes.eldp_absence_overlap_unsupported: The absence overlaps with another excluded period in this period, which would count the same days twice. Check the overlapping absences of this employment.
codes.eldp_absence_source_invalid: The absence in this period has no usable identifier or kind. Check the absence record for this employment.
codes.eldp_absences_invalid: The absences for this period are not stored as a list in the frozen revision; the source has an invalid format and support must investigate.
codes.eldp_activity_unsupported: The activity type and detailed classification of the employment for this period does not match a case from which the pension record section code can be derived automatically.
codes.eldp_assessment_base_missing: The social insurance assessment base is missing for this period. Open payroll for this month and approve the current revision.
codes.eldp_assessment_base_not_whole_czk: The social insurance assessment base for this period is not a whole number of crowns within the range the pension record can write.
codes.eldp_authority_request_date_invalid: When preparing the pension record on request, enter a valid delivery date for the CSSZ or USSZ request, which must not be before the reporting year.
codes.eldp_authority_request_due_on_invalid: The deadline stated in the ČSSZ or ÚSSZ request is not a valid date, or it precedes the day the request was received. Correct it in the pension record form.
codes.eldp_authority_request_due_on_missing: For this year the deadline for a pension record on request is set by the request itself, not by law. Enter the deadline stated in the request in the form.
codes.eldp_base_with_fully_excluded_section: All days of the section are excluded periods yet it carries an assessment base; ČSSZ would reject it. Check the section's absences and income.
codes.eldp_confirmation_document_corrupt: The confirming document bytes do not match the DMS record; the document is corrupted or altered. Upload the confirmation again.
codes.eldp_confirmation_document_missing: The confirming document bytes are not available in the DMS. Upload the confirmation of the pension record receipt again.
codes.eldp_confirmation_document_required: The confirmed result must reference an active company document of this company. Attach a valid confirmation document.
codes.eldp_confirmation_invalid: The confirmation must explicitly state whether this is a pension record prepared on request from CSSZ or USSZ.
codes.eldp_confirmation_note_invalid: The pension record note must be text with a maximum length of 500 characters.
codes.eldp_control_submission_state_invalid: The control pension record must remain in the prepared state; confirming a result is not possible in this state.
codes.eldp_copy_identity_incomplete: The record sheet copy must carry the identification of the citizen (first name, surname, birth surname, date and place of birth, permanent address) and of the employer (name, company ID, registered office, variable symbol). Fill in the missing details in the employee card or in Payroll settings → Employer and payroll offices.
codes.eldp_correction_reference_invalid: The corrective pension record does not refer to the frozen record it corrects. The application cannot build such a record; contact support.
codes.eldp_correction_without_change: The pension record data have not changed since the frozen record, so the corrective record has nothing to correct.
codes.eldp_correction_without_original: No pension record for this year has been frozen yet, so there is nothing to correct. Prepare the regular pension record first.
codes.eldp_death_date_invalid: The date of the employee's death must be a valid date not before the reported year.
codes.eldp_deducted_days_unknown: For a month with code D (after reaching retirement age) the taken-over payroll cannot document the deducted periods. Submit the pension record outside the application.
codes.eldp_employment_dates_inconsistent: The revision for this period records a different employment duration than earlier months. Compare the employment dates with the affected payroll and create a correction revision if needed.
codes.eldp_employment_dates_missing: The employment has no frozen start or end date in the revision for this period. Open payroll for this month and approve the current revision.
codes.eldp_employment_not_in_revision: The employment is not present in the frozen payroll revision for this period. Open payroll for this month, verify the employment and approve the current revision.
codes.eldp_employment_scope_mismatch: The employment is not uniquely identifiable in the frozen revision. Prepare the pension record again.
codes.eldp_environment_invalid: The pension record environment is not valid; support must investigate this technical error.
codes.eldp_excluded_days_exceed_deducted: Excluded periods of a section with code D exceed the deducted periods; support must review this technical inconsistency.
codes.eldp_excluded_days_exceed_period: The excluded periods for this period exceed the insurance duration in the month. Check this employment's absences and their range.
codes.eldp_excluded_days_not_confirmed: The excluded periods of the pension record must be explicitly confirmed by the payroll accountant before preparation.
codes.eldp_excluded_days_sum_mismatch: The total of excluded periods does not match their breakdown by kind; support must investigate this technical inconsistency.
codes.eldp_hash_mismatch: The pension record source fingerprint does not match the stored manifest. Prepare the pension record again.
codes.eldp_historic_preparation_available: The pension record for this period can be prepared in the standalone Pension records module; JMHZ no longer requires it from 2026.
codes.eldp_idempotency_payload_mismatch: Repeating the pension record preparation has different confirmation content than the original request. Prepare it again with matching data.
codes.eldp_idempotency_scope_mismatch: Repeating the pension record does not match the original scope. Prepare it again.
codes.eldp_insurance_month_without_income: No countable income was paid in this month and the recorded absences are not enough to decide whether it counts as an insurance period. Check this employment's absences.
codes.eldp_jmhz_default_on_demand_exception: From 2026 the pension record is filed separately only on request from CSSZ or USSZ, or when insurance ends; it is not required in the regular monthly report.
codes.eldp_manual_already_fulfilled: The obligation to file the pension record for this employment is already fulfilled.
codes.eldp_manual_completion_frozen: The idempotency key given is already immutably linked to a different pension record confirmation result. Use a new key or check the original entry.
codes.eldp_manual_date_future: The pension record confirmation date must not be in the future.
codes.eldp_manual_date_invalid: The pension record confirmation date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
codes.eldp_manual_reference_invalid: The pension record confirmation reference must have between 1 and 190 characters.
codes.eldp_manual_statement_not_found: The prepared pension record was not found in this company.
codes.eldp_manual_status_invalid: The pension record confirmation result must be submitted or accepted.
codes.eldp_manual_submitted_frozen: The confirmation of the pension record submission is already saved and cannot be changed.
codes.eldp_month_outside_employment: The payroll revision for this period lies outside the employment duration. Compare the employment dates with the affected payroll.
codes.eldp_month_source_ambiguous: Two approved payroll revisions exist for this period; the pension record must not rely on an ambiguous source. Keep only one valid revision for the month.
codes.eldp_month_source_missing: There is no approved payroll for this period to document insurance duration and income. Open payroll for this month and approve the revision.
codes.eldp_no_insurance_period: No pension insurance period arose for the reporting year; check whether there is approved payroll for this year.
codes.eldp_no_source_revision: There is no approved payroll revision for the employment for this year.
codes.eldp_not_kept_full_old_age_pension: No pension record is kept for this year: the employee is entitled to payment of the old-age pension in full and does not participate in pension insurance abroad.
codes.eldp_pension_age_mid_month_unsupported: The ELDP code changes in the middle of a month (retirement age reached or early old-age pension) and the application does not keep an assessment base for part of a month. File the pension record outside the application.
codes.eldp_pension_status_conflict: The statutory records show a verified working pensioner discount, but the pension record confirmation states no old-age pension. Complete the pension details in the form.
codes.eldp_pension_status_evidence_mismatch: The pension details in the record confirmation differ from the person's statutory records. Correct the records on the person card (sections Retirement age and Pension received), or leave the confirmation fields empty.
codes.eldp_pension_status_invalid: The employee's pension details are not in a valid format. Correct them in the pension record form.
codes.eldp_pension_status_not_confirmed: Confirm the employee's pension details in the form: retirement age, early or full old-age pension, and participation in insurance abroad.
codes.eldp_post_termination_code_missing: Income settled after the employment ended cannot be written to the pension record because the ELDP code list does not know the "P+" code for this activity type. Resolve the case with support.
codes.eldp_post_termination_small_scale_unsupp: For small-scale employment and agreements to perform work, income after termination is not written as a P+ row, it belongs to the month of termination. Recalculate that month or submit a corrective record outside the application.
codes.eldp_ppm_childbirth_missing: Maternity benefit in this period reaches the expected childbirth date or beyond and is missing the actual childbirth date. Add the childbirth date to the absence.
codes.eldp_ppm_expected_childbirth_missing: Maternity benefit in this period has no expected childbirth date filled in, so the start of the excluded period cannot be determined. Add the expected childbirth date to the absence.
codes.eldp_prepared_on_before_period_end: The date of preparation precedes the "To" date of a row; ČSSZ rejects such a record sheet with error 251. Enter a later date of preparation.
codes.eldp_prepared_on_future: The pension record preparation date is in the future. Enter a preparation date between the "To" date and today.
codes.eldp_prepared_on_invalid: The date of preparation of the pension record is not a valid date. Correct it in the pension record form.
codes.eldp_relationship_kind_unsupported: The pension record currently only supports employment contracts; for this period the relationship is of a different kind. Check the relationship kind on the employee card.
codes.eldp_revision_not_current_approved: The payroll revision for this period is not the current approved revision. Open payroll for this month and approve the current revision.
codes.eldp_schema_integrity_failed: The pinned official JMHZ package or XSD schema for the pension record is missing or has a different fingerprint; support must investigate this technical error.
codes.eldp_scope_already_frozen: The pension record for this year is already frozen with different content; a changed source requires a corrective filing, not an overwrite.
codes.eldp_section_15a_history_unavailable: Whether a period in a month without insurance is excluded depends on participation in months before the reported year (Section 15a of the Sickness Insurance Act). Submit the pension record outside the application.
codes.eldp_social_not_calculated: The social insurance calculation for this period is missing. Open payroll for this month and approve the current revision.
codes.eldp_social_participation_missing: Participation of the employment in social insurance for this period is not documented. Open payroll for this month and check the insurance participation.
codes.eldp_social_relationship_ambiguous: The result for this period contains this employment more than once. Open payroll for this month and remove the duplicate.
codes.eldp_source_hash_mismatch: The pension record source fingerprint for this period does not match. Prepare the pension record again.
codes.eldp_source_incomplete: The pension record cannot be prepared because the sources for the reporting year have deficiencies listed for the affected months.
codes.eldp_source_invalid: The pension record source revision or snapshot has an invalid format; support must investigate this technical error.
codes.eldp_source_mismatch: The source for this period does not match the company, period or revision result. Prepare the pension record again.
codes.eldp_standalone_statement_not_applicable: This case does not meet the conditions for a standalone pension record preparation and must be handled individually.
codes.eldp_statement_continues_previous_employ: The employment follows within three months an employment of the same person that ended in the same year. Its period belongs to further rows of the earlier employment's pension record sheet; prepare the sheet there.
codes.eldp_submission_replay_mismatch: The existing pension record submission does not match the exact XML of this request. Prepare the submission again.
codes.eldp_submission_replay_state_invalid: The existing pension record submission is no longer in a replayable state. Prepare the submission again.
codes.eldp_submission_schema_unavailable: The local package does not contain the XSD for a standalone CSSZ pension record submission; the record can be prepared and frozen, but cannot yet be filed from the application.
codes.eldp_takeover_activity_missing: The taken-over month has no CSSZ activity type 1 to 9 from which the pension record section code is derived. Add the value in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_assessment_base_missing: The taken-over month reports an insurance period but has no social insurance assessment base. Add the value in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_assessment_base_not_whole_: The taken-over month's assessment base is not a whole number of crowns within the range the pension record can write.
codes.eldp_takeover_employment_dates_ambiguous: The taken-over months of the employment state different start or end dates. Make the values consistent in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_employment_dates_inconsist: The taken-over month records a different employment duration than the approved payroll revisions. Correct the values in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_employment_end_unknown: The employment is in no approved payroll revision of the year and the taken-over months do not state its end date, nor does a month of the following period prove it lasted past 31 December. Add it in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_employment_unresolved: The employment is in no approved payroll revision of the year and the taken-over months have no unambiguous person or valid start date. Add the values in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_excluded_days_breakdown_mi: The taken-over month has excluded days but is missing their breakdown by kind. Record the corresponding absences and repeat the takeover.
codes.eldp_takeover_excluded_days_mismatch: The taken-over month has a different number of excluded days than the recorded absences give. Correct the absences or the taken-over month in the payroll takeover check.
codes.eldp_takeover_insurance_days_exceed_peri: The taken-over month reports more insurance participation days than the employment actually lasted in the month.
codes.eldp_takeover_insurance_days_missing: The taken-over month participates in pension insurance but has no participation days filled in. Add the value in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_month_ambiguous: More than one taken-over payroll month exists for this employment in this period. Keep only one row per month in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_month_not_substitutable: The application calculates payroll for this month but has no approved revision; the taken-over month must not replace it. Approve the revision or discard the draft run.
codes.eldp_takeover_participation_conflict: The taken-over month is marked as having no pension insurance participation, but carries an assessment base. Correct one of these values in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_post_termination_income_un: The taken-over month carries an assessment base after the employment ended. The application cannot write income settled after termination from taken-over data into the pension record; file it outside the application or correct the value in the payroll takeover review.
codes.eldp_takeover_relationship_kind_unsuppor: The taken-over month is not marked as an employment contract; the pension record cannot yet process another relationship kind.
codes.eldp_xml_snapshot_mismatch: The pension record XML does not match the exact source snapshot. Prepare the pension record again.
codes.eldp_xml_source_invalid: The source used to build the pension record XML has an invalid or incomplete format; support must investigate this technical error.
codes.eldp_xsd_validation_failed: The generated pension record XML did not pass the pinned XSD schema; support must investigate this technical error.
codes.eldp_year_out_of_range: An ELDP12 pension insurance record sheet can only be built for 2009 or later, and at most for the current year. File a sheet for an earlier year outside the application.
codes.jmhz_acknowledgement_class_mismatch: The VREP acknowledgement refers to a different submission class than the one that was sent.
codes.jmhz_acknowledgement_correlation_missing: The VREP acknowledgement carries no usable CorrelationID; the submission could no longer be traced or closed.
codes.jmhz_acknowledgement_endpoint_untrusted: The VREP acknowledgement refers to a query address outside HTTPS.
codes.jmhz_acknowledgement_unreadable: The VREP response could not be read as valid XML.
codes.jmhz_activity_code: The JMHZ activity type code is missing on the employment card; the application has no way to derive it. Fill in Activity type.
codes.jmhz_amendment_without_components: A corrective or cancelling submission without a selected component corrects or cancels nothing. Select at least one employment relationship.
codes.jmhz_amendment_without_regular: A corrective or cancelling submission cannot be sent before the regular submission whose GUID it references.
codes.jmhz_amount_overflow: The JMHZ amount aggregation overflowed the technical number range; support must investigate this error.
codes.jmhz_annual_evidence_scope_mismatch: The annual evidence does not match the person or previous tax period of the report being prepared. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_annual_evidence_source_missing: The frozen annual evidence for the employee's previous tax period is missing.
codes.jmhz_annual_request_source_missing: It is not documented whether the employee requested the annual tax settlement. Open Payroll → Annual settlement and record explicitly requested or not requested.
codes.jmhz_annual_request_status_unresolved: The status of the annual tax settlement request is not decided. Open Payroll → Annual settlement and decide the request status.
codes.jmhz_annual_settlement_child_details_uns: The annual settlement claims the child tax credit, but the frozen source does not yet carry the mandatory JMHZ identification data for the children.
codes.jmhz_annual_settlement_performance_sourc: It is not documented whether the annual tax settlement was performed. Refresh the JMHZ preparation over the locked annual settlement result records.
codes.jmhz_annual_settlement_request_source_in: The performed annual tax settlement does not have a matching locked request and record of annual claims.
codes.jmhz_annual_settlement_result_incomplete: The annual tax settlement result cannot be safely converted to whole crowns for JMHZ.
codes.jmhz_annual_settlement_source_inconsiste: The request and the result of the annual tax settlement contradict each other.
codes.jmhz_apz_instrument_missing: The employee is recorded with an APZ contribution, but the employment card section Evidence for CSSZ is missing the APZ instrument code.
codes.jmhz_attribute_10116_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether statutory or contractual wage deductions are reported.
codes.jmhz_attribute_10546_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether the employee claims the seasonal social-insurance discount.
codes.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_invalid: The frozen average hourly earnings have invalid data. Open Payroll → Absence and leave and document the average again.
codes.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_mismatch: The average hourly earnings do not match the reporting period or are not approved. Open Payroll → Absence and leave and check the average.
codes.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_missing: The verified average hourly earnings are missing.
codes.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_probable_mis: The average hourly earnings are missing and the employee did not work the statutory minimum number of days in the relevant period, so the actual average cannot be calculated.
codes.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_unverified: The average hourly earnings are not confirmed as a supported calculation case. Open Payroll → Absence and leave and check the average.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_component_duplicate: The same employment relationship is selected for cancellation more than once. Select each relationship only once.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_component_invalid: The selected employment relationship form does not have a valid identifier. Select the relationship again.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_component_not_frozen: The selected employment relationship is not among the components of the original submission still valid for cancellation.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_duplicate_employment: The same employment relationship is listed more than once in the corrective submission.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_duplicate_form: The same component of the submission is cancelled more than once in the corrective report.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_employment_invalid: The employment relationship ID on the cancelled component is not in a valid format.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_guid_mismatch: A cancellation or correction submission must reference the GUID of the original regular submission, which is missing or does not match.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_has_no_forms: A cancellation submission must not contain any components, because no GUID is generated for them.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_person_invalid: The person's social security identifier (IK MPSV) on the cancelled component must have ten digits.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_target_invalid: Only a regular monthly report submitted via VREP or a data box can be cancelled or corrected.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_transition_period_forb: The social security administration does not allow cancelling reports for January to March 2026; any change must be filed as a content correction.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_window_closed: The deadline for cancelling the report for this period has already passed; the correction can now only be made through a corrective report.
codes.jmhz_cancellation_would_leave_no_valid_f: Selecting all employment relationships would leave nothing in the report; use a full cancellation to withdraw the entire submission.
codes.jmhz_certificate: The signing certificate for production JMHZ submissions is not selected or is invalid.
codes.jmhz_child_claim_invalid: The frozen claim for the child tax credit has no reference or child order assigned.
codes.jmhz_component_mapping_hash_mismatch: The fingerprint of the payroll component's JMHZ mapping does not match the frozen submission.
codes.jmhz_component_mapping_mismatch: The payroll component's JMHZ mapping does not match the attached submission package.
codes.jmhz_component_snapshot_hash_mismatch: The payroll component snapshot fingerprint does not match the frozen submission.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_current_set_inva: The current JMHZ preparation does not have the company's complete set of forms or a specific person's form.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_deadline_expired: The ten-year deadline for a content correction of this period has already expired.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_duplicate_employ: The same employment relationship appears more than once in the content correction.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_employment_inval: The form being corrected in the content correction is not linked to a valid employment relationship.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_envelope_mismatc: The number of GUIDs in the submission envelope does not match the number of forms in the content correction.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_form_guid_change: A correction of an accepted form must use its original GUID; it must not change during the correction.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_full_set_control: The summary and the insurance part did not pass the checks over the company's complete effective set.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_new_guid_invalid: A newly submitted content-correction form must be assigned a new valid UUID.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_plan_mismatch: The form being corrected is missing from the content correction plan.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_preparation_bloc: The correction cannot be built; a finding lies on a selected employment or in the insurance part and summary.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_scope_mismatch: The current preparation belongs to a different social security registration or period than the one being corrected.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_source_form_miss: The current preparation does not contain the employment relationship or form selected for the content correction.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_source_guid_inva: The original GUID of the form being corrected is not a valid canonical UUID.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_state_invalid: The selected content-correction form is not in a state that can be safely corrected.
codes.jmhz_content_correction_without_forms: A content correction must contain at least one complete form.
codes.jmhz_control_period_missing: A submission without a stated reporting period cannot be checked against the control catalogue.
codes.jmhz_december_collective_agreement_sourc: The annual data on the type of collective agreement for the December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_december_ownership_form_source_miss: The annual data on the ownership and control structure for the December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_december_ozp_annual_source_missing: The annual record of employing people with disabilities for the December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_deferral_concurrent_incomplete: In this month the employee has more than one concurrent employment relationship participating in social insurance, and their deferral for reporting purposes is incomplete.
codes.jmhz_deferral_conflict: Someone else changed the deferral in the meantime; reload the overview.
codes.jmhz_deferral_employment_unknown: The employment is not part of the report preparation.
codes.jmhz_deferral_no_form_left: Excluding the concurrent employment relationships would leave no form in the report; this month must be processed manually by the accountant.
codes.jmhz_deferral_not_active: The deferral has already been cancelled.
codes.jmhz_deferral_not_blocked: The employment has no finding that blocks the report, so there is no reason to defer it.
codes.jmhz_deferral_regular_frozen: The regular report for this period is already frozen; add the employment with a corrective report.
codes.jmhz_deferral_regular_missing: The regular report without the deferred employment is not frozen yet; submit the regular report first.
codes.jmhz_deferral_regular_not_accepted: A corrective report can follow only an accepted or partially accepted regular report.
codes.jmhz_deferral_revision_missing: The payroll run has no approved revision to prepare the report from.
codes.jmhz_deferral_still_blocked: The deferred employment cannot be added yet; its data are still incomplete.
codes.jmhz_deferred_income_type_unsupported: The application processes only type 1 deferred income on its own. File other types manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_delivered_protocol_channel_unsuppor: An unsigned protocol from the social security administration is trusted only when delivered via a data box.
codes.jmhz_delivered_protocol_form_unknown: The delivered protocol refers to a form that is not part of the frozen submission.
codes.jmhz_delivered_protocol_kind_unsupported: This kind of delivered protocol is verified by the social security administration's seal, not by delivery alone.
codes.jmhz_delivered_protocol_period_mismatch: The delivered protocol belongs to a different reporting period than this submission.

codes.jmhz_dispatch_class_unsupported: The transport does not support this kind of submission to the social security administration.

codes.jmhz_dispatch_submitted_not_recorded: The submitted report could not be recorded in the dispatch log.
codes.jmhz_dry_run_is_not_a_submission: This is only a local test; new GUIDs are generated on every run and no submission is created by it.
codes.jmhz_effective_state_employment_unknown: The employment relationship is not included in the complete effective set of the JMHZ submission.
codes.jmhz_effective_state_protocol_conflict: The signed protocol refers to a form or identity that does not match the frozen submission.
codes.jmhz_effective_state_root_invalid: The regular submission this one refers to was not found in the same company and environment.

codes.jmhz_eldp_assessment_base_mismatch: The confirmed assessment base for the pension insurance record does not match the statutory result of the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_eldp_assessment_base_not_whole_czk: The assessment base cannot be safely converted to whole crowns for the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_base_with_fully_excluded_secti: All insured days of the month are excluded periods yet the month carries an assessment base; ČSSZ would reject the report. Check the month's absences and income.
codes.jmhz_eldp_capped_base_unsupported: The assessment base was capped by the annual maximum and the pension insurance record requires an individual review.
codes.jmhz_eldp_code_activity_mismatch: The pension insurance record code does not match the employment's activity type.
codes.jmhz_eldp_confirmation_note_invalid: The optional note on the pension insurance record confirmation may have at most 500 characters.
codes.jmhz_eldp_days_mismatch: The number of days on the pension insurance record does not match the length of the reported insurance interval.
codes.jmhz_eldp_deducted_days_unsupported: An employee past retirement age who does not draw an old-age pension has sickness, care, maternity, paternity, unpaid leave or unexcused absence in the month.
