codes.jmhz_eldp_deferred_section_invalid: The deferred income ELDP does not match the frozen run result. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_eldp_deferred_small_scale_unsupport: For small-scale employment and agreements to perform work, income after termination is not reported as deferred income; it belongs to the last month of work. Recalculate that month and file a corrective report for it.
codes.jmhz_eldp_employment_not_found: The employment relationship is not included in the source payroll revision of the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_employment_scope_mismatch: The employment relationship cannot be uniquely identified in the source snapshot.
codes.jmhz_eldp_environment_invalid: The pension insurance record's environment (production or test) is not valid.
codes.jmhz_eldp_evidence_mismatch: The pension insurance evidence does not match the frozen employment relationship.
codes.jmhz_eldp_evidence_missing: The prepared pension insurance evidence is missing.
codes.jmhz_eldp_excluded_days_exceed_period: The excluded periods exceed the pension insurance duration reported for the month.
codes.jmhz_eldp_excluded_days_sum_mismatch: The total of excluded periods does not match their breakdown by type.
codes.jmhz_eldp_excluded_days_unsupported: The excluded periods do not match the unworked hours in the work summary.
codes.jmhz_eldp_hash_mismatch: The pension insurance record manifest's fingerprint does not match, or the manifest does not correspond to the stored data.
codes.jmhz_eldp_idempotency_incomplete: The repeated request for the pension insurance record has no completed idempotent link to a snapshot.
codes.jmhz_eldp_idempotency_payload_mismatch: The repeated request for the pension insurance record has different confirmation content than the original one.
codes.jmhz_eldp_idempotency_scope_mismatch: The repeated request for the pension insurance record does not match the scope of the original request.
codes.jmhz_eldp_import_absence_dates_missing: The month's attendance is taken from an import and has no exact absence start and end dates, so the pension insurance record cannot be safely derived from it.
codes.jmhz_eldp_insurance_month_without_income: A month with no countable income cannot be safely decided as an insurance period based on the recorded absences.
codes.jmhz_eldp_interaction_unsupported: The first pension insurance record slice requires an explicit No confirmation for both special legal facts.
codes.jmhz_eldp_interval_invalid: The employment relationship has no valid pension insurance record interval for the reported month.
codes.jmhz_eldp_interval_outside_employment: The employment relationship has no frozen start date needed to determine the pension insurance record interval.
codes.jmhz_eldp_nonparticipation_section_inval: A non-participating work performance agreement must have a code-free pension insurance record section with zero days and no assessment base.
codes.jmhz_eldp_ordinary_activity_unsupported: The employment relationship has no frozen activity type needed for the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_period_invalid: The pension insurance record period does not start on the first day of the month.
codes.jmhz_eldp_ppm_childbirth_missing: The maternity benefit has no actual childbirth date, so the excluded period of the pension record cannot be determined. Fill in the childbirth date on the maternity absence under Absences, correct the payroll run of the month and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_eldp_relation_activity_mismatch: The activity type or detailed classification does not match the employment relationship's type for the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_relationship_kind_unsupported: This type of employment relationship cannot yet be automatically transferred into the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_revision_not_current_approved: The pension insurance record requires a current approved regular or corrective payroll revision.
codes.jmhz_eldp_revision_not_found: The source payroll revision for the pension insurance record was not found.
codes.jmhz_eldp_scenario_unsupported: The employment relationship does not fall into the scenario supported for automatic preparation of the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_scope_already_frozen: The pension insurance record for this employment relationship is already frozen with different content.
codes.jmhz_eldp_section18_days_exceed_period: The excluded days under Section 18(7) of the Pension Insurance Act exceed the reported insurance period.
codes.jmhz_eldp_section18_days_sum_mismatch: The total of excluded days does not match the breakdown under Section 18(7) of the Pension Insurance Act.
codes.jmhz_eldp_section18_days_unresolved: Excluded sickness insurance days (section 18(7)) cannot be split for this employment because the sickness is frozen in the payroll run without the wage compensation window. Create a corrective revision of the run and approve it again.
codes.jmhz_eldp_social_not_calculated: Social insurance for the pension insurance record has not been calculated for this employment relationship.
codes.jmhz_eldp_social_relationship_mismatch: The social insurance calculation result does not cover the employment relationship exactly once.
codes.jmhz_eldp_social_relationship_unsupporte: A non-participating employment relationship must not have a social insurance assessment base.
codes.jmhz_eldp_source_hash_mismatch: The pension insurance record's source snapshot fingerprint does not match.
codes.jmhz_eldp_source_invalid: The source data for the pension insurance record is not in a valid or complete format.
codes.jmhz_eldp_source_mismatch: The pension insurance record's source does not match the company, period or the payroll revision result.
codes.jmhz_eldp_work_summary_mismatch: The work summary contains an exception that cannot be safely transferred automatically into the pension insurance record.
codes.jmhz_eldp_work_summary_missing: The approved work summary needed for the pension insurance record is missing.
codes.jmhz_employee_social_discount_exclusive: One employment relationship combines the working pensioner discount with the seasonal social insurance discount; both cannot be claimed at the same time.
codes.jmhz_employee_social_discount_relationsh: The working pensioner's social insurance discount cannot be assigned to the employment relationship, because it carries a different assessment base or does not participate in insurance.
codes.jmhz_employer_annual_collective_agreemen: The annual data on the type of collective agreement needed for the employer's December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_employer_annual_evidence_scope_mism: The employer's annual evidence does not match the period being prepared for the report.
codes.jmhz_employer_annual_ownership_missing: The annual data on the employer's ownership and control structure needed for the December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_employer_annual_ozp_summary_missing: The annual record of employing people with disabilities needed for the December report is missing.
codes.jmhz_employer_part_time_discount_activit: The part-time discount can only be claimed for an employment relationship, not for this type of relationship.
codes.jmhz_employer_part_time_discount_outcome: The assessment of whether the employer is entitled to the part-time discount is missing.
codes.jmhz_employer_part_time_discount_reason_: The statutory reason for claiming the part-time discount under Section 7a(1) is missing.
codes.jmhz_employer_part_time_discount_unverif: The claim to the part-time discount is not evidenced.
codes.jmhz_employer_part_time_discount_working: The agreed shorter weekly working time needed for the part-time discount is missing.
The agreed shorter weekly working time cannot be reported for the part-time discount.
codes.jmhz_employer_rate_category_unverified: The insurance rate category for occupational injury insurance for this employment relationship is missing.
codes.jmhz_employment_scope_mismatch: The frozen employment relationship has no unambiguous owner in the preparation.
codes.jmhz_employment_set_empty: The payroll run contains no employees. A regular JMHZ report must carry at least one person form (ČSSZ check 232); a report with only the summary and insurance parts is rejected. No JMHZ is filed for a month in which no employment existed (Section 7(2) of Act No. 323/2025 Coll.); if the company no longer employs anyone, deregister it from the employer register. An employment that continues without income belongs in the run with a wage of CZK 0 and is reported with a zero form.
codes.jmhz_employment_without_office: The employment relationship has no assigned payroll office, so there is no variable symbol under which to report the insurance.
codes.jmhz_encryption_certificate_missing: The social security administration's encryption certificate is not available in the application.
codes.jmhz_encryption_certificate_unreadable: The social security administration's encryption certificate cannot be read.
codes.jmhz_encryption_certificate_untrusted: The CSSZ encryption certificate does not have a pinned fingerprint the application trusts, so the submission cannot be safely encrypted.
codes.jmhz_encryption_compression_failed: The submission could not be compressed before sending.
codes.jmhz_encryption_empty_payload: An empty submission cannot be encrypted and sent.
codes.jmhz_encryption_failed: The submission could not be encrypted for sending to the social security administration.
codes.jmhz_encryption_unavailable: The server does not support the encryption needed to send the submission to the social security administration.
codes.jmhz_envelope_filled_at_invalid: The submission fill-in date and time are not in the required format.
codes.jmhz_envelope_form_guid_missing: The employment in the submission is missing a form identifier (GUID).
codes.jmhz_envelope_form_guid_unbound: The form identifier (GUID) must be bound to a specific employment.
codes.jmhz_envelope_guid_invalid: An identifier (GUID) in the submission is not in a valid format.
codes.jmhz_envelope_guid_not_unique: The identifiers (GUIDs) of the submission and its forms must all differ from each other.
codes.jmhz_envelope_package_invalid: The order or count of the submission's data packages is outside the allowed range.
codes.jmhz_envelope_vendor_invalid: The identification of the sending software in the submission must not be empty.
codes.jmhz_excluded_summary_unavailable: The excluded employee is missing the advance tax result needed for the employer summary in the corrective submission (fields 10034, 10035).
codes.jmhz_feature_source: It cannot be verified whether the JMHZ feature is available for this installation because the feature support matrix could not be read. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_flag_combination_unsupported: This combination of submission component flags is not allowed.
codes.jmhz_form_already_valid: The component is already valid in the regular submission; a new one is not created, it is corrected under the original identifier as a correction.
codes.jmhz_form_original_not_valid: The corrected component references a component of the regular submission that was not accepted; a rejected or cancelled component cannot be corrected and must be sent again with a new identifier.
codes.jmhz_form_state_unknown: The state of the previous submission component is not defined in the JMHZ rules.
codes.jmhz_form_type_unknown: The submission component type is not defined in the JMHZ rules.
codes.jmhz_full_submission_unsupported: The insurance overview is not in the state of a complete JMHZ report, nor of a prepared, sent or received submission.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_class_unknown: The submission type is not among the values the GovTalk envelope for the social security administration supports.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_double_signature: The submission envelope is already signed; a second signature would add a layer the social security administration does not expect.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_envelope_incomplete: The assembled submission envelope is missing a required element.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_envelope_type_mismatch: The declared type of the social security administration envelope belongs to a different agenda than the submission type.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_envelope_type_unknown: There is no documented envelope type for this submission type.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_environment_unknown: The submission environment must be either test or production.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_payload_invalid: The submission body is invalid or empty.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_serialization_failed: The submission envelope could not be serialized to XML.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_shape_invalid: The declared shape of the submission envelope for the social security administration does not match the required format.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_shape_unverified: The shape of the outgoing submission envelope is not documented and must not be guessed.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_signature_broke_envelope: After signing, the submission envelope is no longer a valid message.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_signature_empty: The signing layer returned an empty submission envelope.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_signer_missing: The submission envelope cannot be sent without a signing layer.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_variable_symbol_invalid: The employer's variable symbol in the submission envelope does not have ten digits.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_variable_symbol_mismatch: The variable symbol in the submission envelope does not match the variable symbol in the submission header.
codes.jmhz_govtalk_vendor_mismatch: The software identification in the submission envelope does not match the identification stated in the submission itself.
codes.jmhz_identity_employment_scope_mismatch: The employment does not match the selected employee, or it has no valid start date for the social security administration identity as-of date.
codes.jmhz_identity_id_ppv_missing: The employment identifier (ID PPV) is missing. It is assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered - copy it from the registration receipt or the ePortal. It is filled in on the employment card, section Identifiers assigned by CSSZ for JMHZ.
codes.jmhz_identity_incomplete: The employment has no stored personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV) or employment identifier (ID PPV). Both numbers are assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered - the application cannot invent them.
codes.jmhz_identity_missing: Some employees are missing both the personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV) and the employment identifier (ID PPV); both numbers are assigned by the social security administration at registration and the application cannot invent them.
codes.jmhz_identity_oic_missing: The personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV) is missing. It is assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered - copy it from the registration receipt or the ePortal.
codes.jmhz_identity_scope_mismatch: The sensitive identity in the saved JMHZ preparation does not match the person, employment or environment; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_identity_unresolved: The employment has an unresolved identity task towards the social security administration. Finish it on the employment card; the report cannot be built until then.
codes.jmhz_interaction_in13_unresolved: The occurrence of the specific employment legal fact has not been confirmed.
codes.jmhz_interaction_in28_unresolved: Employment support for persons with disabilities has not been confirmed.
codes.jmhz_interaction_in30_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether the employee performed deep-mining work.
codes.jmhz_isds_environment_unknown: There is no documented CSSZ data box for this environment (production or test) to send to.
codes.jmhz_isds_payroll_submission_scope_misma: The document received via the data box does not match the scope of the payroll submission it was assigned to.
codes.jmhz_isds_protocol_already_processed: The protocol from the data box has already been processed before.
codes.jmhz_isds_protocol_ambiguous: The data box message contains more than one readable protocol and it cannot be safely determined which belongs to the submission.
codes.jmhz_isds_protocol_attachment_missing: The message from the social security administration's data box does not contain the expected protocol attachment.
codes.jmhz_isds_protocol_untrusted: The protocol from the social security administration's data box could not be verified and processed as trustworthy.
codes.jmhz_isds_response_ambiguous: The data box response matches more than one submission at once and the correct one cannot be safely selected.
codes.jmhz_isds_response_unmatched: The data box response could not be matched to any sent submission.
codes.jmhz_mapping_not_allowed: This change to the payroll component's JMHZ mapping cannot be made because it violates the current mapping rules.
codes.jmhz_negative_or_deferred_income_unsuppo: The payroll component has no amount determined for the reporting month.
codes.jmhz_obligation_missing: No JMHZ monthly report, not even a preparation, has been created yet for this payroll revision.
codes.jmhz_office_variable_symbol_invalid: The employer variable symbol of the payroll office fails the CSSZ check (check digit or district code); CSSZ would reject the report. Correct it in Payroll settings, under the office's effective registrations (or the test variable symbol for the test environment).
codes.jmhz_office_variable_symbol_mismatch: The variable symbol in the insurance overview does not match the variable symbol set for the payroll office.
codes.jmhz_office_variable_symbol_missing: The payroll office has no employer variable symbol for the social security administration in a submittable format (ten digits); without it the report cannot be filed.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_catalog_mismatch: The application's catalog of legal facts for the JMHZ confirmation is incomplete.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_confirmation_inva: The confirmation of legal facts for JMHZ does not have a valid format or a trustworthy source.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_deduction_conflic: The wage deduction evidence for the JMHZ confirmation is incomplete or does not match the payroll run calculation; finish the deduction calculation.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_hash_mismatch: The fingerprint of the saved JMHZ legal facts evidence does not match; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_idempotency_incom: The idempotent record of the JMHZ legal facts confirmation is incomplete; try the action again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_idempotency_paylo: The repeated request to confirm JMHZ legal facts has different content than the original one; refresh the page and try again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_idempotency_scope: The repeated request to confirm JMHZ legal facts has a different person or employment scope than the original one; refresh the page and try again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_incomplete: The confirmation must include all five mandatory legal facts.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_interaction_misma: The confirmed legal facts do not match the JMHZ scenarios prepared for this submission; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_invalid: Each legal fact must be confirmed explicitly as Yes or No.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_missing: The ordinary-profile legal facts are not confirmed.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_monthly_exception: The employment has a recorded unusual situation that automatic JMHZ preparation does not support yet; process this month's report individually.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_not_found: The JMHZ legal facts confirmation or its source payroll revision was not found.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_period_invalid: The reporting period for the JMHZ legal facts confirmation does not start on the first day of the month.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_positive_unsuppor: The ordinary JMHZ profile only supports an explicit No for the confirmed legal facts; process the report individually when a fact is confirmed as Yes.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_profile_incomplet: The frozen JMHZ unusual-situations setting for this payroll revision is incomplete.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_profile_missing: This payroll revision was created before the JMHZ data was added; recalculate and approve the payroll again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_result_mismatch: The payroll run result for the JMHZ confirmation does not contain the expected person, or contains it more than once.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_revision_not_curr: The monthly data for the JMHZ legal facts confirmation requires the current approved payroll revision.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_scenario_unsuppor: This payroll revision does not fall under the supported ordinary JMHZ scenario; process the report individually.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_scope_already_fro: The employment already has a different immutable JMHZ legal facts confirmation saved for this period.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_scope_mismatch: The JMHZ legal facts confirmation does not match the payroll revision, person or employment being prepared; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_selector_mismatch: The immutable confirmation no longer matches the JMHZ classification. Create and approve a new correction revision; the original evidence remains preserved.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_source_hash_misma: The fingerprint of the frozen source for the JMHZ legal facts confirmation does not match; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_source_invalid: The frozen source for the JMHZ legal facts confirmation has an invalid or incomplete structure.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_source_mismatch: The frozen source of the JMHZ legal facts confirmation does not match the company, period or payroll revision; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_specification_mis: The saved data was prepared under a different version of the JMHZ rules; check its applicability before a new preparation and do not resend an already accepted report just because of this.
codes.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_values_mismatch: The JMHZ legal facts confirmation contains a combination of values the application does not support.
codes.jmhz_original_at_cssz: ČSSZ already holds the original of this report (response 20022), so sending it again makes no sense. Check the status in the submission transport history.
codes.jmhz_period_invalid: The JMHZ reporting period does not start on the first day of the month.
codes.jmhz_period_mismatch: The date of the social insurance result does not match the reported payroll period.
codes.jmhz_period_submitted_externally: The monthly report for this month was already filed by the previous payroll program. Send the correction from it; if the record is wrong, remove it in the Filed by previous program section.
codes.jmhz_person_identifier: The person is missing the personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV), assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered.
codes.jmhz_person_not_calculated: The employee's social insurance result is not calculated, or is only preliminary; recalculate and approve the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_person_set_mismatch: The frozen input for the JMHZ insurance part does not contain the correct or unique set of people; prepare the overview again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_environment_invalid: The JMHZ preparation environment (production or test) is not valid.
codes.jmhz_preparation_hash_mismatch: The fingerprint of the saved JMHZ preparation does not match, or the preparation is not in the expected shape; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_idempotency_incomplete: The idempotent binding of the JMHZ preparation is incomplete; try the action again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_idempotency_scope_misma: The repeated request for the JMHZ preparation does not match the original source revision; refresh the page and try again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_issue_invalid: The JMHZ preparation contains a finding with an invalid or missing code.
codes.jmhz_preparation_not_found: The JMHZ preparation was not found.
codes.jmhz_preparation_not_ready: The sources for the JMHZ monthly report are incomplete; open the JMHZ check and complete the highlighted groups of data.
codes.jmhz_preparation_source_not_current: The JMHZ preparation no longer matches the current approved payroll revision; prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_too_large: The JMHZ preparation is larger than the database accepts in a single statement (max_allowed_packet); raise the limit in the MariaDB configuration and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_preparation_version_unsupported: The version of the saved JMHZ preparation is not supported.
codes.jmhz_primary_employment_unresolved: The primary employment relationship is not determined. An employee with concurrent relationships must have exactly one relationship marked as the main one; the others are secondary.
codes.jmhz_projection_form_unbound: The person's form in the XML submission has no parent submission component.
codes.jmhz_projection_path_ambiguous: The attribute path belongs to more than one attribute in the JMHZ dictionary at once.
codes.jmhz_projection_path_unknown: An element of the JMHZ monthly report XML has no counterpart in the JMHZ dictionary.
codes.jmhz_projection_xml_unreadable: The JMHZ monthly report XML cannot be loaded to process its attributes.
codes.jmhz_protocol_ambiguous: The CSSZ response contains protocols for several submissions, and without the expected CorrelationID it cannot be determined which one belongs to this submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_anchor_unreadable: The trusted CSSZ certificate (trust anchor) could not be loaded, so the protocol cannot be verified. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_canonicalization_unstable: The verified protocol produces a different digest after serialization than the one used to verify the signature; releasing it would pass on unverified data. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_certificate_expired: The CSSZ certificate used to sign the protocol had already expired at the time of signing. The protocol cannot be trusted. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_certificate_not_yet_valid: The CSSZ certificate used to sign the protocol was not yet valid at the time of signing. The protocol cannot be trusted. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_chain_broken: The CSSZ certificate does not match the issuer attached in the protocol's signature. The protocol cannot be trusted. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_channel_unsupported: Protocol verification is only supported for the VREP/APEP channel or the data box. Load the protocol from a supported source.
codes.jmhz_protocol_class_mismatch: The CSSZ protocol belongs to a different submission type than the one it was assigned to. Load the correct protocol for this submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_class_unknown: The submission type in the CSSZ protocol is not among the documented values. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_class_unsigned_mismatch: The submission type in the protocol envelope does not match the signed processing protocol. The protocol cannot be trusted. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correction_form_unpaired: Error 238: the corrective submission contains an employee form whose IK MPSV and ID PPV pair ČSSZ could not find in the previous submission. Forms that were rejected or missing before are sent in the corrective submission with a new part GUID and type regular.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correction_guid_invalid: Error 219: the corrective submission carries a wrong GUID. It was usually sent with a new GUID instead of the GUID of the partially accepted regular submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correlation_invalid: The CorrelationID in the CSSZ protocol is not in a valid format. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correlation_mismatch: The processing protocol belongs to a different submission than the one it was loaded for. Load the protocol that belongs to this submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correlation_missing: The verified protocol does not state a CorrelationID, so it cannot be safely assigned to this submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_correlation_unknown: The submission has no stored CorrelationID, so a protocol cannot be safely assigned to it.
codes.jmhz_protocol_digest_algorithm_unknown: The signed timestamp in the protocol does not state a digest algorithm, or it is undocumented. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_digest_mismatch: The digest signed by CSSZ does not match the protocol content; the protocol was modified after signing. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_employment_identifier_mism: The employment identifier (ID PPV) in the CSSZ protocol does not match the records. Check the identifiers on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_protocol_employment_not_found_at_cs: Control 262: ČSSZ found no insurance relationship with the stated ID PPV. The employment is not registered at ČSSZ, the registration has not propagated yet, or the ID PPV was copied incorrectly.
codes.jmhz_protocol_environment_unknown: The protocol does not state whether it is the CSSZ test or production environment. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_error_code_conflict: The code of the first error in the protocol does not match its error message. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_error_code_unknown: The error code in the CSSZ protocol is not in the control catalogue nor among the documented errors. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_error_kind_unknown: The error type in the CSSZ response (DZMH) is not documented. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_error_message_unreadable: An error in the CSSZ protocol does not have a readable code or format. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_error_not_a_control: The error code in the protocol does not refer to any control in the catalogue. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_form_mapping_invalid: The mapping of employee forms to submission parts is not valid. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_form_outcome_conflict: The protocol reports a conflicting result or identity for the same employee's form. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_form_unidentified: A part of the protocol should relate to a specific employee's form, but it has no form identifier. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_form_unmapped: The protocol carries a form identifier that does not belong to this submission. Check that this protocol belongs to this submission.
codes.jmhz_protocol_identifier_unreadable: The identifier attribute in the protocol is not in a documented format. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_kind_unknown: The protocol's root element does not match any supported CSSZ response shape. Check that this is a valid JMHZ protocol.
codes.jmhz_protocol_not_delivered: The processing protocol could not be delivered from CSSZ despite repeated attempts. Try to re-verify the submission later, or contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_outcome_conflict: The protocol reports an overall OK result, but one of its parts is rejected. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_package_count_invalid: The number of report packages in the protocol is not a positive number. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_part_unknown: The kind of submission or protocol part in the CSSZ response is not documented. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_period_invalid: The period value in the protocol is out of the allowed range. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_person_identifier_mismatch: The personal identifier (OIC) in the CSSZ protocol does not match the records. Check the identifiers on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_protocol_person_not_found_at_cssz: Control 263: ČSSZ found no insurance relationship with the stated IK MPSV (OIČ). The employee is not registered at ČSSZ, the registration has not propagated yet, or the IK MPSV was copied incorrectly.
codes.jmhz_protocol_qualifier_conflict: The protocol envelope reports a rejection, but the processing result states otherwise. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_qualifier_unknown: The Qualifier value in the protocol is not documented. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_regular_submission_duplica: Error 326: only one regular submission may exist for a reporting period. ČSSZ will not accept another regular submission; changes are sent as a corrective submission with the GUID of the regular one.
codes.jmhz_protocol_result_not_recorded: The ČSSZ protocol is verified and the submission was updated from it, but the result was not recorded on the sickness benefit case or the discount intent. The reason is in the technical details; record the result on the case or intent manually from the protocol.
codes.jmhz_protocol_result_unknown: The control result in the protocol is not a documented value. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_reverify_artifact_mismatch: The stored original of the protocol does not match its digest and cannot be re-verified. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_reverify_channel_unsupport: Only a protocol retrieved from the VREP gateway can be re-verified. This protocol was received through a different channel.
codes.jmhz_protocol_reverify_not_found: No protocol was found for this submission, so it cannot be re-verified.
codes.jmhz_protocol_reverify_unavailable: The submission platform is currently unavailable, the protocol cannot be re-verified. Try again shortly.
codes.jmhz_protocol_service_authorization_miss: ČSSZ did not process the submission (error 103): the district social security office (OSSZ) has no authorisation recorded for this e-service, or the certificate the submission is signed with is not registered there. The submission itself is not faulty. Have the authorisation or certificate registered at the OSSZ, then send the submission again with Discard and file again.
codes.jmhz_protocol_shape_undocumented: The ČSSZ protocol for this submission does not match the documented shape. The protocol is stored with the submission; record the processing result from it manually.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_detached: The protocol's signature does not contain an embedded digest; only an attached signature is supported. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_invalid: The CSSZ protocol signature is not valid, the signature content does not match the signed data. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_missing: The CSSZ protocol does not contain a signed timestamp or its value. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_scope_unexpected: The signed part of the protocol does not contain the processing result. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_unavailable: The server does not support verifying the protocol's signature. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_unreadable: The protocol's signature could not be prepared for verification, or is not valid base64. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signature_verifier_missing: The CSSZ protocol cannot be declared trustworthy because signature verification is not available. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signer_missing: The protocol's signature does not contain the signer's certificate. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signer_unreadable: The signer's certificate for the protocol could not be loaded, or its validity period could not be read. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_signer_untrusted: The protocol was signed by a certificate that is not a trusted CSSZ certificate. An untrusted protocol cannot move the submission forward. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_status_conflict: The report status code and label in the protocol contradict each other. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_status_unknown: The submission status in the protocol has a code that is not among the documented statuses. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tax_advance_with_withholdi: Error 245: the employee has no taxpayer declaration and the income is subject to withholding tax, but the report fills in advance tax attributes.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tax_nonresident_with_decla: Error 243: a tax non-resident with a signed declaration may claim only the basic taxpayer relief, not other reliefs, the child tax benefit or the special tax rate.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tax_reliefs_without_declar: Error 244: the employee has no taxpayer declaration, but the report fills in tax relief or child tax benefit attributes.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tax_withholding_with_advan: Error 325: tax is collected as an advance, but the report fills in withholding tax attributes.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tax_withholding_with_decla: Error 242: the employee has a signed taxpayer declaration, but the report applies withholding tax at the special rate.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tenant_mismatch: The protocol is issued for a variable symbol that does not belong to this company. A foreign protocol cannot be loaded.
codes.jmhz_protocol_tenant_unverifiable: It cannot be verified that the protocol belongs to this company. Fill in the registration number or workplace variable symbol in payroll settings.
codes.jmhz_protocol_timestamp_unreadable: The signed timestamp in the protocol does not state a readable signing date and time. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_too_large: The uploaded file is too large to be a CSSZ protocol. Check that this is the actual protocol, not another attachment.
codes.jmhz_protocol_unreadable: The CSSZ protocol is empty or has no readable content. Load the protocol again from the data box.
codes.jmhz_protocol_untrusted: The CSSZ protocol could not be declared trustworthy. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_variable_symbol_conflict: The variable symbol in the file name does not match the variable symbol in the protocol. Load the original attachment from the data box.
codes.jmhz_protocol_variable_symbol_invalid: The variable symbol in the protocol is not in a valid format (at most ten digits). Contact support.
codes.jmhz_protocol_variable_symbol_missing: The protocol does not state a variable symbol, so it cannot be verified that it belongs to this company. Load the original attachment from the data box.
codes.jmhz_pvpoj_rate_category_unsupported: The breakdown of insurance rates by category does not match the calculated result, or contains an unknown or duplicate category. Check the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_pvpoj_source_not_found: An approved social insurance result (PVPOJ) was not found. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and check the insurance calculation.
codes.jmhz_pvpoj_whole_czk_required: An amount in the insurance part of the report cannot be safely converted to whole crowns as required by the XSD format. Check the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_pvpoj_xsd_limit_exceeded: An amount or the number of employees with a discount exceeds the XSD form's technical limit. Process this case individually.
codes.jmhz_readiness_check_failed: The report readiness check could not be completed. Contact support with the technical details.
codes.jmhz_registration_change_settling: ČSSZ accepted a change of employee data (REGZEC A3) for an employment in the report within the last 48 hours. A report sent earlier could be rejected (error 243), so it is not prepared yet.
codes.jmhz_registry: The employer's registration number with the social security administration is not filled in payroll settings.
codes.jmhz_regular_submission_cancelled: The regular submission for this period has been cancelled. A new regular submission must be created first before continuing.
codes.jmhz_relationship_not_calculated: The employment's social insurance result is not calculated, closed or verified. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_relationship_set_mismatch: The frozen employment in the preparation does not match the revision input. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_result_employment_set_mismatch: The payroll revision result does not cover exactly the frozen employments. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_result_person_set_mismatch: The payroll revision result does not cover exactly the frozen people. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_revision_input_mismatch: The frozen preparation input does not match the company or the report period. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_revision_not_current_approved: Preparing the report requires the current approved payroll revision. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and approve the revision.
codes.jmhz_revision_not_found: The source payroll revision for this report was not found. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_revision_result_mismatch: The payroll revision result does not come from the same frozen input. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_risk_categorization_missing: The employment is classified as a paramedic or a member of a company fire brigade, but it is not stated which of the two it is. Select the risk categorization for JMHZ on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_ruleset_mismatch: The ruleset of the frozen social insurance result does not match the one currently in use. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_advance_tax_incomplete: The advance tax result is incomplete.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_advance_tax_missing: The advance tax result is missing.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_annual_fields_unsupported: Annual attributes are not supported by this profile yet.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_credit_caregiver_id: The other person supporting the same children is not named in the submission. Open Payroll → Employees → Dependants and fill in that person's name and date of birth.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_credit_caregiver_in: Child credit claims in the same household contradict each other regarding the other caregiver. Open Payroll → Employees → Dependants and align the answer.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_credit_caregiver_un: It has not been answered whether the same children are also supported by another person in the household. Open Payroll → Employees → Dependants and decide.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_credit_source_incon: The frozen child tax credit claim does not match the calculated amount.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_credit_without_decl: The monthly child tax credit is claimed without a signed taxpayer declaration.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_identity_incomplete: A dependent child is missing a first name, last name or valid date of birth. Open Payroll → Employees → Dependants and fill them in.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_child_order_unsupported: The dependent child's order is outside the monthly report's code list.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_concurrent_participation_: In this month the employee has more than one concurrent relationship participating in social insurance. The application cannot split contributions between them yet. File this month's report manually through the CSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_deductions_unsupported: Wage deductions are not supported by this profile yet.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_earnings_vector_incomplet: Payroll components are not fully assigned to the monthly report fields. Open Payroll → Components and complete the mapping.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_health_result_not_calcula: The health insurance result is not calculated. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_income_tax_result_not_cal: The income tax result is not calculated. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_net_result_not_calculated: The resulting net wage is not calculated. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_pvpoj_source_mismatch: The insurance part does not match the selected CSSZ registration. Refresh the overview and check the payroll office assignment.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_pvpoj_unavailable: The insurance part of the submission is missing.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_resolution_blocked: The compiled scenario_1 report is not complete while findings remain open. Resolve them and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_scope_unsupported: The preparation contains mixed or special JMHZ scenarios that cannot be issued as an ordinary report. Check the activity types and process unsupported relationships individually.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_social_result_not_calcula: The social insurance result is not calculated, or its discounts are not verified. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_source_version_unsupporte: The report preparation has an older version that cannot safely recognize this scenario. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_statutory_result_not_calc: Statutory contributions (social and health insurance, tax) are not calculated. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and finish the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_tax_credit_breakdown_unav: The breakdown of claimed tax credits exceeds the claimed amount or is negative. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and check the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_whole_czk_required: An amount that must be reported in whole crowns came out with hallers. Under Sections 142 and 144 of the Labour Code it is rounded up: open Payroll → Payroll runs, correct the component's haller amount and recalculate the run.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_withholding_above_thresho: The person has withholding tax, but the total of agreements to complete a job reaches the DPP threshold and the other relationships reach the small-scale employment threshold. ČSSZ rejects such a report (check 325). Check the taxpayer declaration and activity code on the employment card and recalculate the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_withholding_base_missing: The withholding tax base is missing or incomplete. Open Payroll → Payroll runs and check the calculation.
codes.jmhz_scenario1_withholding_tax_unsupport: Withholding tax is not supported by this profile yet.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_evidence_gap: The frozen preparation does not carry a verified source for all mandatory foster-care allowance data. Process this scenario individually according to CSSZ documentation.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_frozen_resolution_invalid: The frozen classification of the foster-care allowance does not match the pinned catalogue or the XSD format. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_frozen_resolution_missing: The preparation flags a foster-care allowance but does not contain its frozen employment. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_resolution_blocked: The compiled scenario_2 report (foster-care allowance) is not complete while findings remain open.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_scope_unsupported: The preparation does not contain the frozen foster-care allowance scenario. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario2_source_version_unsupporte: The preparation does not have the version needed to safely recognize the foster-care allowance. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_scenario_2_preparation_unsupported: The application does not yet build a foster-care allowance (activity type M, form pestoun) into the monthly report. File this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_scenario_3_preparation_unsupported: The application builds the cinnostKS form only for activity types K and N through S with detail 1. It does not yet build a specific-group employment or any other detail; file this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_scenario_7_preparation_unsupported: The application does not yet build an employment with activity type 10 (form ozpTpp) into the monthly report. File this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_scenario_8_activity_10_forbidden: Activity type 10 cannot be used with this JMHZ scenario. Check the activity type on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_scenario_activity_code_invalid: The activity type code on the employment card is not in the JMHZ code list. Correct the activity type.
codes.jmhz_scenario_activity_code_missing: The JMHZ activity type code is missing.
codes.jmhz_scenario_manual_selection_invalid: The manual JMHZ scenario selection is not valid for this employment. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_scenario_not_supported: The combination of activity type and employment detail is not among the JMHZ scenarios the application can issue. Check the employment card.
codes.jmhz_scenario_profile_unsupported: The activity type or employment detail does not match a supported JMHZ profile. Check the employment card.
codes.jmhz_scenario_relationship_detail_invali: The employment relationship detail does not match the chosen activity code. Correct it on the employment card in the agreed terms.
codes.jmhz_scenario_relationship_detail_missin: The employment relationship detail for JMHZ is missing.
codes.jmhz_scenario_relationship_detail_not_ap: The employment relationship detail must not be filled in for the chosen activity code. Remove it on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_scenario_social_insurance_unreporta: An employment with activity type 11 to 14 is reported on the other-income or international hiring-out form, which carries no insurance, yet the calculation assessed social insurance for it. Check the activity type on the employment card and recalculate the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_schema_integrity_failed: The pinned monthly report XSD package is missing or has a different fingerprint; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_signing_certificate_expired: The signing certificate for JMHZ submissions has expired; the social security administration would reject a filing signed with it. Choose a valid certificate in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_certificate_not_registered: The certificate stored in the vault does not match the certificate registered with the social security administration. Register the current certificate there or choose the correct one in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_certificate_not_yet_valid: The signing certificate is not yet valid; its validity starts in the future. Wait until it becomes valid or choose a different certificate in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_certificate_unidentified: The certificate stored in the vault has no serial number, so it cannot be verified against the registration. Re-upload the certificate or choose a different one in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_credential_unlock_failed: The signing certificate's private key cannot be unlocked. Check the password or the certificate file in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_empty_payload: The JMHZ submission is empty and cannot be signed; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_signing_failed: The submission could not be signed due to a server-side technical error. Try again, and contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_signing_private_key_missing: The selected certificate has no usable private key, so the JMHZ submission cannot be signed with it. Upload a certificate with a private key or choose a different one in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_profile_missing: No signing certificate is selected for this company and environment in the JMHZ submission settings. Set one in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_serial_unreadable: The signing certificate's serial number cannot be read. Re-upload the certificate or choose a different one in the signing profile.
codes.jmhz_signing_unavailable: The server does not support the CMS/PKCS#7 signing required for JMHZ submissions; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_snapshot_hash_mismatch: The frozen JMHZ preparation's fingerprint does not match the stored data. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_snapshot_invalid: The saved JMHZ preparation has an invalid format and cannot be read. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_snapshot_missing: The saved JMHZ preparation needed for this report is missing. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_social_multiple_offices: The payroll run includes employments from several payroll offices. The insurance part (PVPOJ) is filed separately per office; choose which one to build it for.
codes.jmhz_social_office_allocation_failed: The split of social insurance across payroll offices could not be calculated; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_social_office_unknown: The chosen payroll office does not exist in the company's registry, or it has no employment in this payroll run. Check the office setup.
codes.jmhz_social_relationship_mismatch: The social insurance result in the payroll run does not match the employments (missing, duplicated or invalid). Recalculate and approve the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_social_result_not_calculated: Social insurance for the employment is not fully calculated in the payroll run. Recalculate and approve the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_social_totals_mismatch: The social insurance data in the report's insurance part (PVPOJ) is internally inconsistent - discounts or totals do not add up. Recalculate and approve the payroll run; contact support if the mismatch persists.
codes.jmhz_software_identification_invalid: The identification of the sending software for JMHZ is empty; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_source_invalid: The input data for assessing the ordinary JMHZ legal facts has an invalid format. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_source_scope_mismatch: The social insurance result used for the insurance part (PVPOJ) does not belong to the selected company or payroll revision. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_special_scenarios_evidence_gap: The employment belongs to a special JMHZ scenario for which the required evidence is missing. File this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_special_scenarios_frozen_resolution: The special JMHZ scenario for this employment has no validly frozen classification. This case requires individual handling and filing through the ČSSZ ePortal.
The preparation does not contain the frozen special JMHZ scenario classification for this employment. File the report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_special_scenarios_resolution_blocke: The normalized special-scenarios JMHZ document is incomplete; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_special_scenarios_source_version_un: The JMHZ preparation was built by an older builder version and its special scenario cannot be safely determined. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_artifact_mismatch: The stored artifact's fingerprint does not match the frozen JMHZ XML. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_component_identity_missi: The frozen JMHZ submission is missing the employment identification. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_components_missing: The regular submission does not contain any employment that could be corrected.
codes.jmhz_submission_components_unreadable: The components of the frozen JMHZ submission cannot be read. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_controls_failed: The JMHZ submission failed the ČSSZ control catalog and was not created. Fix the report according to the check details and try again.
codes.jmhz_submission_form_type_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission form does not have a supported type R, O or S. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_identity_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission does not carry a valid GUID or variable symbol. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_identity_missing: The frozen JMHZ submission is missing a required identification value. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_payload_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission's data record cannot be read. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_payload_missing: The submission has no stored frozen data record, so it cannot be worked with further. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_period_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission does not carry a valid reporting period. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_frozen_xml_unreadable: The frozen JMHZ submission XML cannot be read. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_identity_missing: The frozen submission is missing a required identity. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_late_discount_confirmati: The report is filed late and claims a premium discount that ČSSZ may not accept (check 290). It can only be prepared after you confirm.
codes.jmhz_submission_obligation_required: The original JMHZ submission has no recorded obligation and deadline, so a cancellation or correction cannot be linked to it.
codes.jmhz_submission_obligation_scope_mismatc: The recorded obligation does not match the payroll run, period or JMHZ agenda, so the submission cannot be linked to it.
codes.jmhz_submission_period_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry a valid reporting period. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_preparation_blocked: The JMHZ preparation is incomplete, the submission is not created. Complete the missing data according to the check details.
codes.jmhz_submission_refreeze_filled_at_missi: The frozen submission carries no fill-in time, so it cannot be frozen again with a new GUID after rejection. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_submission_refreeze_guid_not_unique: The rejected submission's GUID does not occur exactly once in the frozen report, so it cannot be replaced safely. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_submission_refreeze_identity_mismat: The re-frozen submission does not carry the expected GUID, variable symbol or period. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_submission_replay_mismatch: The frozen artifact of the corrective JMHZ submission is missing or does not match the original submission. Prepare the corrective submission again.
codes.jmhz_submission_replay_state_invalid: The existing JMHZ submission is no longer in the ready-to-send state, so it cannot be recreated with the same content. Refresh the submission state.
codes.jmhz_submission_run_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry the payroll run it belongs to. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_snapshot_hash_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry the fingerprint of the preparation it was built from. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_split_payload: The report is split into partial packages and each package is handled separately. Open the packages in the submission detail.
codes.jmhz_submission_split_refreeze_unsupport: A report split into partial packages cannot be frozen again one package at a time. Discard the rejected submission and freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_state_unknown: The previous JMHZ submission's state is not defined in the application; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_submission_type_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission does not have a supported type R, O or S. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_type_unknown: The JMHZ submission type is not defined in the application's rules; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_taxpayer_declaration_unresolved: The taxpayer declaration is not evidenced.
codes.jmhz_temporary_assignment_user_missing: The employee is temporarily assigned to a user, but the employment lacks the user's identification (ČSSZ check 103). Fill in the user's company ID, or for a foreign entity the country, registration number and name.
codes.jmhz_verified_boolean_missing: The recorded value for the APZ contribution, functional benefits or temporary assignment is invalid.
codes.jmhz_vrep_correlation_invalid: The JMHZ submission's CorrelationID has an invalid format; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_endpoint_missing: The operation address for VREP is not configured for this environment; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_http_error: The ČSSZ VREP server returned an HTTP error while sending the JMHZ submission. Try sending it again after a while.
codes.jmhz_vrep_invalid_response: The ČSSZ VREP server returned an empty or oversized response while sending the JMHZ submission. Try sending it again after a while.
codes.jmhz_vrep_poll_request_mismatch: The JMHZ submission status query does not reference the correct CorrelationID; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_request_empty: An empty JMHZ submission envelope cannot be sent to VREP; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_response_lost: The VREP request was sent but no response arrived; ČSSZ may have accepted it. Check the submission status before sending it again.
codes.jmhz_vrep_unavailable: The ČSSZ VREP system is temporarily unavailable or the response did not arrive. Try sending the JMHZ submission again after a while.
codes.jmhz_work_month_not_approved: The month's working time has not been approved.
codes.jmhz_work_summary_v2_missing: The approved monthly work summary is missing.
codes.jmhz_workplace_codebooks_unverified: Verified workplace code-list data is missing.
codes.jmhz_xml_attribute_unresolved: The frozen JMHZ document does not have evidence for a required attribute, and it must not be auto-filled with zero or false. Prepare and freeze the report again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_bonus_without_declaration: The monthly tax bonus cannot be reported without a signed taxpayer declaration. Add the taxpayer declaration for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_child_credit_without_children: The monthly child tax credit cannot be reported if the employee has no recorded dependent children. Add the dependent children for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_credit_without_declaration: A claimed tax credit cannot be reported without a signed taxpayer declaration. Add the taxpayer declaration for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_period_invalid: The deferred income month must be 1 to 12. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_periods_unsuppo: Type 1 deferred income carries exactly one ELDP period; the application cannot build another layout. File the report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_type_invalid: The deferred income type must come from the ČSSZ code list (1 to 6). Contact support.
codes.jmhz_xml_document_version_unsupported: The JMHZ serializer can only process the current version of the scenario 1 normalized document. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_code_required: An ELDP pension insurance record section with a nonzero number of days must have an ELDP code. Prepare the evidence sheet again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_excluded_days_sum_mismatch: The total excluded periods in the pension record do not match their breakdown by type (Section 16(4) of Act No. 155/1995). Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_excluded_days_without_code: Excluded periods cannot be reported in the pension record without an excluded-period type code. Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_missing: A submission component must contain at least one ELDP pension record section. Prepare the report again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_section18_days_sum_mismatc: The total excluded days in the pension record do not match their breakdown under Section 18(7) of Act No. 187/2006. Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_employee_social_discount_mispla: The employee's social insurance discount can only be carried on the form that reports that person's contributions. Check the discount assignment and insurance participation of the employments.
codes.jmhz_xml_employee_social_discount_zero: The employee's social insurance discount is marked as claimed but its amount is zero. Check the discount calculation or its confirmation for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_employer_rate_category_unknown: Without the employer's rate category, the assessment base cannot be split under Section 5a(1) of the Social Security Contributions Act. Set the employer's rate category in the payroll office settings.
codes.jmhz_xml_exempt_income_exceeds_total: Exempt income must not exceed the total processed income. Check the payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_form_limit_exceeded: One data package of a submission carries at most 1500 forms. The application splits a regular report above that limit into partial packages itself; an amending or cancelling submission of that size does not fit into one package. Amend fewer employments at once and send the rest in another amending submission.
codes.jmhz_xml_identity_name_incomplete: The employee is reported by name because the social security administration has not yet assigned an OIC or ID PPV, and in addition the surname, first name, date of birth, start date or activity type is missing.
codes.jmhz_xml_international_hire_attribute_un: The international hiring-out form (activity type 12) carries only the basic taxpayer credit and no monthly tax bonus. File an employment with another credit, a child benefit or a bonus manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_no_valid_form: The JMHZ submission must contain at least one valid component, but none remained after processing. ČSSZ rejects a regular report without any person form (check 232). Check the employments included in this report; an employment that continues without income is reported with a zero form.
codes.jmhz_xml_not_byte_stable: Re-serializing the same JMHZ submission did not return identical bytes; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_xml_overtime_exceeds_worked_hours: Overtime hours in the work summary must not exceed the number of worked hours. Check and correct the working time for the month.
codes.jmhz_xml_paid_unworked_hours_below_sickn: The paid non-worked hours in the work summary do not cover the hours of sickness with wage compensation. Check the sickness records and working time for the month.
codes.jmhz_xml_period_invalid: The JMHZ submission's reporting period is out of the valid range; it must be a valid calendar month matching the pinned schema. Check the reporting period of the report or the cancellation.
codes.jmhz_xml_primary_employment_invalid: The employee must have exactly one employment marked as primary, on which the summary data is reported. Check and correct the primary-employment marking on the employee's card.
codes.jmhz_xml_prisoner_excluded_days_unsuppor: The prisoner form carries only sick leave and maternity among excluded periods. Family member care, paternity or another excluded period cannot be entered there; file this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_pvpoj_missing: A regular JMHZ submission must contain the insurance part (PVPOJ). Check the social insurance calculation in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_resolution_blocked: The JMHZ document has unresolved blocking findings, so it cannot be serialized into a submission or a content correction. Fix the earlier findings listed in the report check.
codes.jmhz_xml_risk_categorization_invalid: The risk categorization must come from the ČSSZ code list (1, 6 or 7). Correct it on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_xml_scenario_3_profile_unsupported: An employment with activity type K through S only supports the statutory profile S with detail 1; any other combination requires individual handling and filing through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_scenario_unsupported: The submission component does not belong to a JMHZ scenario the application can build automatically. File this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_serialization_failed: The JMHZ submission XML could not be created due to a technical error. Try again, and contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_split_submission_unsupported: The data package order does not match the number of packages of the report. A report with more than 1500 forms is split into partial packages when it is frozen; run the report test and freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_xml_submission_type_unsupported: The source document for building the XML must be a complete regular preparation; another document type cannot be serialized. Prepare the regular report again.
codes.jmhz_xml_surcharge_total_missing: The surcharge breakdown cannot be reported without the total surcharge amount (field 10332). Check the surcharge payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_temporary_assignment_user_inval: The temporary assignment user is not filled in correctly (the company ID must have eight digits). Correct it on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_xml_variable_symbol_invalid: The employer's variable symbol must have exactly ten digits. Check the variable symbol setting for the payroll office or the OSSZ registration.
codes.jmhz_xml_wage_breakdown_without_wage: The wage breakdown cannot be reported when the processed wage is zero. Check the payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_work_summary_missing: The submission component has no frozen monthly work summary. Approve the working time for the month and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_xsd_validation_failed: The monthly JMHZ report XML failed validation against the pinned XSD schema; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_zero_report_attribute_unknown: The requested zero-report JMHZ attribute is not defined in the application; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_zero_report_situation_unknown: The zero-report situation for JMHZ is not described in the application's rules; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.

steps.absences: In Absences, correct or add the absence of the employment and recalculate the run.
steps.annual_settlement: In Annual settlement, record the request or the result of the settlement.
steps.averages: In Absence and leave (Average earning tab), create and approve the average earnings of the employment and recalculate the run.
steps.components: In Payroll components, complete or confirm how the component maps to the monthly report.
steps.correction: Open the Sent tab and review the regular report the correction relates to.
steps.dependants: On the employee card, under dependants, complete the child or claim data and recalculate the run.
steps.employee_identity: On the employee card, complete the personal data (name, date of birth, birth number) and prepare the report again.
steps.employer_annual: In Payroll settings, on the Submissions tab, complete the employer annual data for the December report.
steps.employment_identity: On the employment card, copy the OIČ and ID PPV from the ČSSZ protocol, or file the employee registration first.
steps.employment_profile: On the employment card, in the ČSSZ evidence section, fill in the answer and prepare the report again.
steps.employment_terms: Correct the value in the employment terms on the employee card. A value frozen in the payroll run takes effect only after the run is recalculated; then prepare the report again.
steps.manual: The application deliberately does not process this case automatically. File the report for the affected employment manually through the ČSSZ ePortál, or defer the employment and add it later.
steps.office: In Payroll settings, complete or correct the OSSZ registration and variable symbol of the payroll office.
steps.ordinary_evidence: In Payroll submissions, confirm the ordinary legal facts of the employment and prepare the report again.
steps.registration: On the employment card, in the Registration section, file or complete the employee registration (REGZEC) and prepare the report again once it is accepted.
steps.retry: The sources changed in the meantime or the preparation fingerprint does not match. Run the report test again; if the finding stays, contact support.
steps.runs: Open the payroll run of the period, correct the result and approve the current revision; then prepare the report again.
steps.statutory_evidence: On the employee card, in the statutory evidence, complete the taxpayer declaration or discounts and recalculate the run.
steps.submission: Open the Sent tab and review the frozen submission and its sending.
steps.support: This is an internal inconsistency of the application. Contact support and attach the period and technical details.
steps.takeover: In Imports, on the Takeover review tab, complete the missing value of the taken-over payroll.
steps.time: In Working time, review and approve the month of the employment and recalculate the run.
steps.workplace: Fill in the municipality and country of the workplace from the codebook and prepare the report again.

jmhz_gate.unlabelled: Finding without a description. Run the report test again; if it stays, contact support.

jmhz_protocol_help.empty_attributes: These attributes must carry no value at all, not even zero:

source.cssz_faq_2026_06_09: Source: ČSSZ FAQ on filing the monthly report (JMHZ), 9 June 2026

jmhz_protocol_correction_form_unpaired: In the protocol, find the employee (IK MPSV and ID PPV) whose form ČSSZ rejected in the previous submission or which was missing from it.
In the corrective submission carrying the GUID of the regular submission, such an employee form is sent as new: with a new part GUID and type regular.
Prepare the corrective submission again in Sent tab and send it.
jmhz_protocol_correction_guid_invalid: In Sent tab, find the regular submission for the same period that ČSSZ accepted partially.
The corrective submission must carry the GUID of that regular submission, not a new GUID. Prepare the correction of the regular submission again and send it.
ČSSZ will not accept a submission with a new GUID as a correction; do not send it again.
jmhz_protocol_employment_not_found_at_cs: On the employment card, check the ID PPV in the identifiers assigned by ČSSZ. It must match the registration acceptance protocol or the ČSSZ ePortal.
If the employment is not registered at ČSSZ, file the employee registration (REGZEC). If it has been filed, check that ČSSZ accepted it and wait until the registration propagates.
Then send a corrective submission with the GUID of the regular submission.
jmhz_protocol_person_not_found_at_cssz: On the employment card, check the IK MPSV (OIČ) in the identifiers assigned by ČSSZ. It must match the registration acceptance protocol or the ČSSZ ePortal.
If the employee is not registered at ČSSZ, file the employee registration (REGZEC). If it has been filed, check that ČSSZ accepted it and wait until the registration propagates.
Then send a corrective submission with the GUID of the regular submission.
jmhz_protocol_regular_submission_duplica: ČSSZ already holds a regular submission for this period. It will neither accept nor process another regular submission.
In Sent tab, open the original regular submission and send the changes as a corrective submission with its GUID.
jmhz_protocol_tax_advance_with_withholdi: On the employee card, check the taxpayer declaration and the tax regime of the employment. Without a declaration and with withholding tax, advance tax is not reported.
After correcting the data, recalculate the payroll run.
Send a corrective submission. Attributes the protocol marked as filled in incorrectly must be left out of the affected forms entirely, not even as zero.
jmhz_protocol_tax_nonresident_with_decla: Check that a REGZEC action 3 (change) registration has been filed for the employee with the tax residence country code (attribute 10068) “CZ” and the change effective date (attribute 10459) from 1 January 2026, or from the start date. You file the change in the registration on the employment card.
After REGZEC action 3 is accepted, wait at least 48 hours until the data propagates to the ČSSZ systems. A report sent earlier ends with the same error.

If the report went out too early, after 48 hours a corrective submission with only the summary part is enough: the GUID of the original regular submission, type O and the current values. Employee forms and PVPOJ are not sent again.
If the employee remains a non-resident with a declaration, only the basic taxpayer relief may be claimed. Remove other reliefs and benefits on the employee card and recalculate the run.
jmhz_protocol_tax_reliefs_without_declar: If the employee is entitled to reliefs, first record the signed taxpayer declaration in the statutory evidence on the employee card and recalculate the run.
Without a declaration, reliefs and the child tax benefit are not claimed, not even with a zero value.
Send a corrective submission. Attributes the protocol marked as filled in incorrectly must be left out of the affected forms entirely, not even as zero.
jmhz_protocol_tax_withholding_with_advan: On the employee card, check the taxpayer declaration and the tax regime of the employment. When tax is collected as an advance, withholding tax is not reported.
After correcting the data, recalculate the payroll run.
Send a corrective submission. Attributes the protocol marked as filled in incorrectly must be left out of the affected forms entirely, not even as zero.
jmhz_protocol_tax_withholding_with_decla: On the employee card, check the taxpayer declaration in the statutory evidence. With a signed declaration, tax is collected as an advance, not withheld at the special rate.
Correct the declaration or the tax regime of the employment and recalculate the payroll run.
Send a corrective submission. Attributes the protocol marked as filled in incorrectly must be left out of the affected forms entirely, not even as zero.

migration_reconciliation.all_matching: The figures match in every month.
migration_reconciliation.calculated_not_compared: Months {periods} are kept only in MyÚčto and the previous system has nothing for them, so they are not compared. Only months present on both sides are compared.
migration_reconciliation.employer_social_note: Employer social security contribution (company-wide only, it is not a per-person amount):
migration_reconciliation.empty_description: Either no processed payroll was migrated from the previous system, or no payroll run exists for that year yet.
migration_reconciliation.empty_no_overlap: Taken-over and calculated months do not overlap this year: what the previous program processed was not recalculated in MyÚčto, and what MyÚčto calculates is unknown to the previous system. That is normal for a transition. Completeness of the taken-over part of the year is checked above.
migration_reconciliation.empty_title: Nothing to compare for the selected year
migration_reconciliation.grain_hint: A row is one person and month. The migrated side is summed across employment relationships, because contributions and tax are by law amounts of the person, not of the relationship — splitting them back would mean inventing an allocation key.
migration_reconciliation.incomplete_hint: Not every row contributed to the total — some have no counterpart.
migration_reconciliation.load_failed: The check could not be loaded.
migration_reconciliation.month_no_deviations: In this month our recalculation matches the migrated payroll.
migration_reconciliation.months_hint: Expanding a month shows its deviations; the full breakdown of every figure is drawn only on request.
migration_reconciliation.not_compared: Taken-over months {periods} are not compared: the previous program processed them and MyÚčto does not recalculate them, so every person-month would show as a deviation. Only months calculated by MyÚčto are compared.
migration_reconciliation.relationship_count: {count} employment relationships in the previous system
migration_reconciliation.subtitle: Compares the payroll recalculated in MyÚčto with the payroll taken over from the previous system. The previous system already filed those figures with social security, the health insurers and the tax office, so any difference has to be known before the recalculation is approved.
