takeover.upload_hint: CSV or XLSX with the columns from the sample file: the employee by name (employee_name) and the employment code from the card (employment_code), amounts in crowns (12 345,50), days and hours as decimals. The duration and type of the employment relationship come from the records, not from the file. Uploading the same data again overwrites the rows instead of duplicating them. The file fills taken-over wages; add the opening balances for tax with the manual entry below or on the employee card.

problem.attachment_duplicate_name: Attachment {name} has the same name as another attachment. Attachment names must be unique.
problem.attachment_extension: Attachment {name} has an unsupported extension. ČSSZ accepts only .doc, .docx, .rtf, .xls, .xlsx, .pdf, .jpg and .txt.
problem.attachment_file_size: Attachment {name} is larger than 2 MB, the most ČSSZ accepts.
problem.attachment_total_size: The attachments together are larger than 4 MB, the most ČSSZ accepts.
problem.codebook: {field} is not in the {codebook} code list, it is “{value}” now. Pick a code from the list.
problem.country: {field} must be a two-letter country code, for example CZ or SK.
problem.date: {field} must be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-08-05.
problem.date_period: {field} must be later than the start date ({from}), it is {to} now.
problem.digits: {field} must be a numeric code of exactly {length} digits.
problem.education_not_relevant: {field} is not tracked for a Czech citizen working under an agreement (activity “{activity}”), it must be “Z” (not relevant), it is now “{value}”.
problem.foreign_insurance_current: {field} must be P (last carrier) or S (current carrier), it is now “{value}”.
problem.foreign_insurance_sector: {field} must be a code from the Sector codebook (01 to 08), it is now “{value}”.
problem.health_restrictions_max: {field} may contain a single restriction, it has {count} now. Keep the one valid on the start date.
problem.house_number_cz: {field} must be a number of at most four digits for a Czech address (no letters or slashes), it is now “{value}”. Put the orientation number in its own field.
problem.missing: {field} is missing — the ČSSZ registration (REGZEC A1) cannot be filed without it.
problem.orientation_number_cz: {field} may have at most {max} characters for a Czech address, it is now “{value}”.
problem.orientation_number_cz_residence: {field} may have at most {max} characters for an address of stay in the Czech Republic, it is now “{value}”.
problem.postal_code_cz: {field} must have five digits for an address in the Czech Republic and must not start with 0, 8 or 9 (for example 60200), it is now “{value}”.
problem.profession_five_digits: {field} must be a five-digit CZ-ISCO code (category), it is now “{value}”. ČSSZ does not accept a four-digit sub-group in the registration; pick a five-digit category on the employment card.
problem.residence_country_mismatch: {field} must match the tax residency country (“{tax}”), it is now “{value}”.
problem.small_scale_dpp: {field} must not be switched on for activity “{activity}” (agreement to complete a job), small-scale employment is not used for agreements.
problem.status_for_activity: {field}: for activity type “{activity}” only {allowed} is allowed, it is now “{value}”.
problem.status_format: {field} must be a four-digit code from the NKPZ classification, it is now “{value}”.
problem.status_unknown: {field} is not in the NKPZ classification, it is now “{value}”. Pick a code from the list.
problem.too_long: {field} is longer than ČSSZ accepts: at most {max} characters, it now has {length}.
problem.underage: The employee is younger than {min_age} on the start date and ČSSZ rejects such a filing on entry. Check the date of birth and the start date.

completion.hint: The supplement is for employees registered earlier via the ONZ form. The filing is built from the saved registration profile (A1) — status in employment, work mode, place of work, occupation, position, education, country of residence; the full profile adds addresses, health insurer and pension. The date is the day of sending (ČSSZ takes it as "valid from"). It works for a relationship that has already ended too — the filing then carries the end date. If the profile is missing or incomplete, open it above and complete it.

section_hint.health_coverages: Whether the person is subject to Czech health insurance and which insurer they are registered with.
section_hint.health_minimum_reductions: Who the minimum assessment base does not apply to (Section 3(8) of Act No. 592/1992 Coll.): a state-insured person (pensioner, student, parent on parental leave…), a ZTP or ZTP/P card holder, someone who reached pension age without pension entitlement, a self-employed person paying advances at least from the minimum, and someone receiving only a foster carer reward. If the exception starts during a month, the minimum is reduced proportionally by days, so it is entered with an exact date. A documented working pensioner discount, the ZTP/P tax credit, sickness, quarantine, caring, maternity and parental leave are applied by the calculation itself; you do not need to enter them here.
section_hint.health_month_evidence: Left empty means the employee pays the top-up to the minimum assessment base — that is what the law says. Add a record only for the exception: an obstacle on the employer's side, or the choice of employer when there are several.
section_hint.health_other_employer_bases: With concurrent employments the minimum is assessed from the sum of the assessment bases with all employers. Enter the base the employee had with another employer for the month; which of them pays the top-up is set in the monthly evidence of the health minimum.
section_hint.social_discount_claims: Insurance discount for an employee drawing an old-age pension. If it is not claimed, pick “not claimed”.
section_hint.social_jurisdictions: Whether the person is subject to Czech social insurance. A foreign regime needs a country; a supporting reference is optional.
section_hint.social_pension_age: The day the employee reached or will reach retirement age. From that day the activity has code D both in the pension insurance record and in the monthly report, and if no old-age pension is received, deducted periods are reported. Leave empty if you do not know the day; code D then does not arise.
section_hint.social_pensions: The pension the employee receives, with its kind from the CSSA (ČSSZ) code list (the same as in the REGZEC registration). An early old-age pension gives code D; an old-age pension ends deducted periods from the first whole month of payment and, from 2025, also the annual pension insurance record. Importing REGZEC registrations fills it into empty records.
section_hint.tax_credit_claims: Monthly tax credits for the taxpayer, disability and ZTP/P card holders. They apply only with a signed declaration; without a record the credit is not deducted and the tax advance is higher by its amount. Each kind of credit is its own series, so they may apply concurrently.
section_hint.tax_declarations: Decides whether monthly credits and allowances apply, or tax is withheld without them.
section_hint.tax_residences: A non-resident is taxed differently than a resident; a supporting reference can be stored optionally.

surcharge_policy.below_statutory_warning: The rate is below the statutory minimum for a kind where the law does not allow it — the server will reject such a record:

surcharge_policy.edit_blocked_no_open: Only the version that is currently effective and has no end date can be corrected. Older versions are never rewritten — payrolls calculated from them still point at them.

surcharge_policy.factors_hint: 1 to 255. Without a documented count the difficult environment surcharge is not calculated and the month does not pass approval.
surcharge_policy.factors_invalid: Enter the number of aggravating factors between 1 and 255, or leave the field empty.
surcharge_policy.fixed_hint: The amount for every worked hour of that kind. The statutory minimum still applies: if the agreed amount is lower, overtime, public holidays and difficult environments are paid at the statutory minimum and the difference is visible on the payslip.
surcharge_policy.fixed_invalid: The fixed amount must be positive and at most CZK 1,000 per hour.
surcharge_policy.fixed_statutory_note: For a fixed amount the statutory minimum is derived from each person's own average earnings, so it cannot be shown here in advance.
surcharge_policy.hint: What is agreed for this employment relation beyond the statutory minimum. Without an agreement the statutory default applies — and a month with work on a public holiday or in a difficult environment cannot be approved.
surcharge_policy.history_locked_error: This policy version can no longer be changed — it is closed or a newer one supersedes it. Create a new version instead.
surcharge_policy.holiday_mode_hint: A wage agreed with regard to holiday work does not exist — Section 114(3) covers overtime only.
surcharge_policy.load_failed: Failed to load the surcharge policy.
surcharge_policy.lower_allowed: a lower rate may be agreed
surcharge_policy.lower_forbidden: a lower rate cannot be agreed
surcharge_policy.new_hint: A policy is never rewritten — a new version is created next to the old one and the history stays readable.
surcharge_policy.no_permission: Only a user allowed to write employment relations can change the surcharge policy. Ask your company administrator for the permission.
surcharge_policy.rates_hint: For each surcharge choose whether it is agreed as a percentage of average earnings or as a fixed amount per hour. An empty field means the statutory minimum is used.

surcharge_policy.title: Statutory surcharge policy (Sections 114–118)

surcharge_policy.valid_to_hint: Optional. Filling it in closes the policy; from the next day the statutory default applies, so compensatory time off for holidays and a missing basis for a difficult environment.

category_note.non_monetary_neutral: An informational row, not a difference. Non-monetary benefits (typically 1 % of the vehicle purchase price) are not posted separately — the expense is already in the books from the source document, so they are excluded from the gross wages being compared.
category_note.partner_settlement: An offset pays out nothing — it only reclassifies the liability (331/366 debit / 365 credit). The Net pay category is lower by this amount and the payments column stays empty.
category_note.risky_savings: The expense side (527) is tracked. If you post other payroll items to 527 as well, separate the contribution with an analytical account (e.g. 527.100).
category_note.tax_bonus_receivable: An informational row, not a difference. Tax bonuses paid out exceeded the advance tax due; the excess reduces future remittances or is refunded on request (Sec. 35d(5)). The Income tax category already accounts for it.
category_note.unposted_liabilities: An informational row, not a difference. Employer liability insurance and benefits are paid from payroll but posted from their own document — the payroll bridge does not post them, so there is nothing to compare.

steps.absence_dates: Open this employment’s absences and check dates and overlaps for the reporting period. Correct only erroneous records, then recalculate and approve affected payroll. If overlapping absences are accurate, do not remove them just to pass validation; contact support.
steps.absence_overlap: Open this employment’s absences and check dates and overlaps for the reporting period. Correct only erroneous records, then recalculate and approve affected payroll. If overlapping absences are accurate, do not remove them just to pass validation; contact support.
steps.activity: On the employment card, verify Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract and their effective dates. Correct erroneous data and recalculate the affected payroll. If the data is correct, do not change the employment type; contact support for this case.
steps.ambiguous: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.confirmation: In the form above, tick the confirmations of excluded periods and days without insurance, fill in the date the authority request was delivered when preparing on request, and shorten the note to 500 characters. Then prepare the record again.
steps.confirmation_document: In the Settle pension record section, select or upload the supporting document (for example the ePortál filing confirmation) and save again.
steps.correction: If the source data changed after freezing, tick Corrective record sheet and prepare it again. If nothing changed, no corrective sheet is needed; if no sheet exists yet, prepare the regular one first.
steps.dates: Compare the actual start and end dates on the employment card with the affected payroll months. An error confined to old approved payroll requires a correction revision for that month. Do not alter accurate employment dates to make them agree; ask support to investigate an unclear mismatch.
steps.income_month: Open this employment’s absences and verify the absences in the indicated month. If an absence or forgotten pay is missing, add it and recalculate payroll. If the records are accurate, the law decides only about the whole month and the application cannot resolve it; process that month manually and do not change anything just to pass validation.
steps.integrity: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.manual_state: You can see the settlement state in the pension record overview; no new entry is needed.
steps.missing_employment: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.missing_month: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.no_insurance: Check that the correct year and employment are selected. If there really was no insurance period in the year, no pension record is filed and nothing else is needed.
steps.no_revisions: In Payroll, select the reporting year and check the months during which the employment existed. Complete genuinely missing calculations and approvals. If payroll was processed elsewhere, do not create fictitious calculations; contact support about historical evidence.
steps.not_applicable: Do not file anything separately; make sure the monthly reports for the year are submitted and accepted.
steps.pension: In the form above, fill in the employee's pension details according to the pension decision (date retirement age was reached, early pension, first month of full pension payment, insurance abroad), confirm them and prepare the record again.
steps.pension_not_kept: Do not file anything. If the employee participates in pension insurance abroad, tick it in the form and prepare the record again.
steps.prepared_on: In Date of preparation enter a day no earlier than the last "To" date (on termination, the end date or later), or clear the field to use the end of the last accounted month.
steps.previous_employment: Open the record sheet of the earlier employment (link below) and prepare it; the following employment is added as further rows. If the earlier sheet is already frozen, the following employment gets a sheet of its own.
steps.revision: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.social: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.takeover: Open the payroll takeover review, fill in the missing value for the indicated month (activity kind, insured days, assessment base, employment dates) and repeat the takeover. Do not estimate the value: the evidence sheet feeds a pension calculation. If the previous program never issued it, file the evidence sheet for that month outside the application.
steps.takeover_revision: Open payroll for the indicated month, finish the calculation and approve the current revision, or discard the draft run. Only then prepare the evidence sheet again. Taken-over data will not substitute the month so that a draft calculation with different figures cannot stay hidden.
steps.unknown: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.unsupported: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.

problems.absence: This month contains an absence request or correction that is not yet approved or closed.
problems.break: A break is longer than the entire recorded work interval.
problems.calendar: A day in the month has no work calendar or is covered by multiple calendar versions.
problems.import_missing: The month takes attendance from an import summary, but its current revision has none (typically after the month was reopened).
problems.import_values: The attendance import summary has no worked hours, or its overtime exceeds the worked hours.
problems.integrity: The month’s saved attendance has incomplete or invalid data; a summary cannot safely be built from it.
problems.month_boundary: A recorded work interval starts and ends in different calendar months.
problems.overlap: Regular or overtime work intervals overlap.
problems.terms: Weekly working time is not uniquely defined throughout the month or changes during it.
problems.unknown: The working time summary could not be verified. Support must investigate.
problems.work_source: The month takes attendance from an import summary but also has time entries. Two sources of the same time are never merged.

steps.absence: The link opens this employment’s absences for the same month. Complete approval or rejection of pending requests and corrections according to the facts. Return to attendance, refresh and reopen month approval.
steps.break: Check the start, end and break duration in this employment’s records. Correct the wrongly entered time using actual attendance. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.calendar: Check the calendar for this employment. Create calendar / New calendar version currently sets Monday to Friday at 8 hours per day from the month’s start. Use it only if this matches the actual schedule. Ask an administrator to resolve other schedules or overlapping versions; do not change the calendar merely to pass validation.
steps.import_missing: Open Attendance imports and apply this month’s batch again with the summary written to working months. Then refresh the summary and approve the month.
steps.import_values: Correct the data in the attendance system (worked hours and overtime) and import it again. Overtime is part of the worked time and must not exceed it.
steps.integrity: Contact support with the month, employment and technical details below. Do not change attendance blindly because of this error.
steps.month_boundary: Check the work interval’s start and end. Split work crossing a month boundary into the actual portions worked in each month without changing the total duration. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.overlap: Compare this employment’s records by date and work category. Remove only an incorrect duplicate or correct the actual time; do not record regular work and overtime twice for the same interval. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.terms: Open Weekly working time in this employment’s terms. Compare the effective versions for the month with the contract. Correct missing or wrongly effective terms and refresh attendance. Do not erase a real change of working hours; contact support if the summary cannot handle it.
steps.unknown: Contact support with the month, employment and technical details below. Do not confirm substitute values just to complete the report.
steps.work_source: Decide which attendance source applies to the month. If the imported data is right, remove the wrongly recorded time entries; if the entries are right, do not use the import summary for this month. Refresh the summary afterwards.

For each person the longest period across all applicable categories wins.

command_hint.calculate: Recalculates payroll from the frozen input snapshot. The snapshot does not change, so you can recalculate as often as you need.

command_hint.post: Posts the approved payroll to the general ledger. A company on tax evidence gets no journal entry and the run simply moves on.
command_hint.prepare_payments: Prepares the payment liabilities (net pay, contributions, tax) and opens payments. This is where a missing verified institution account shows up.
command_hint.refresh_inputs: Takes a new snapshot of the current approved inputs, absences and statutory records and returns the run to recalculation. The work-in-progress revision stays in the history as abandoned; approved revisions are never affected.

insurance.health_top_up_why: Why: an employee's health insurance is paid at least from the minimum wage (Section 3(6) and (10) of Act No. 592/1992 Coll.). This applies also to a managing director or board member with a low reward and no tax declaration. Some payroll programs do not compute the top-up for them, the law still requires it. The top-up is waived only for an exception: a state-insured person (e.g. a pensioner, student, parent on parental leave), a ZTP or ZTP/P card holder, pension age without pension entitlement, a self-employed person paying advances at least from the minimum, a foster carer reward only; with concurrent employments the bases are added up.
insurance.health_top_up_why_detail: An employee's health insurance is paid at least from the minimum wage (Section 3(6) and (10) of Act No. 592/1992 Coll.), including a managing director, board member or partner with a low reward. The top-up is waived only for an exception: a state-insured person (e.g. a pensioner, student, parent on parental leave), a ZTP or ZTP/P card holder, pension age without pension entitlement, a self-employed person paying advances at least from the minimum, a foster carer reward only; with concurrent employments the bases are added up.

outcome.payments_not_applicable: Nothing to pay — the whole net pay is settled by offset. The run moved forward.
outcome.payments_settled: Every liability of the run is covered by payments.
outcome.posted: Payroll has been posted to accounting.
outcome.posting_not_applicable: The company keeps tax records, so no journal entry was created. The run moved forward.

override.awaiting: This warning is waiting for a person. Until someone takes responsibility for it and writes down why, the payroll run cannot be approved.
override.awaiting_group: These warnings are waiting for a person. Until someone takes responsibility for them and writes down why, the payroll run cannot be approved.
override.bulk_scope: One reason for all {count} checks. It is recorded with each of them separately, and each exception can still be taken back individually.
override.failed: The exception could not be approved.
override.granted: The exception is approved, the run can continue.
override.granted_all: The exception is approved for {count} checks, the run can continue.
override.locked_after_approval: The run is approved, so the exception can no longer be taken back — that would rewrite the record the payout was based on.
override.no_permission: Only someone allowed to approve the payroll run may approve an exception.
override.reason_hint: Write a full sentence — at least 20 characters and three words. A year from now it has to show what you knew and why you decided this way.
override.reason_prompt: Why is the payroll being paid out despite this finding?
override.reason_required: An exception cannot be approved without a reason.
override.revoke_failed: The exception could not be taken back.
override.revoked: The exception was taken back, the warning is unresolved again.

runs.payments_unsettled: The run has not actually been paid in full yet. Under Payroll payment orders and settlement, match every amount to a bank transaction or posted cash document and resolve any refunds or reversals.

preparation.absences_hint: Holiday, sickness and other obstacles to work.
preparation.checklist_title: What will be paid and filed for this month
preparation.components_hint: Recurring components and benefits that apply beyond this month.
preparation.description_draft: The run is still a draft, so inputs can still be changed. Fill in whatever is missing for this month.
preparation.description_missing: Before you create the run, check that everything the wages are calculated from is recorded for this month.
preparation.freeze_warning: “Lock inputs” freezes a snapshot of the inputs. Anything recorded afterwards will not reach the calculation or the reports until you reopen the run and create a new revision.
preparation.people_hint: Starters, leavers, tax declarations and personal records.
preparation.quick_inputs_hint: Gross wages, bonuses and one-off items for this month.
preparation.title: Input preparation for {period}

readiness.all_clear: The check came back clean, you can calculate payroll.
readiness.clear: The pre-flight check found nothing that would stop you from calculating payroll for this period.
readiness.confirm_intro: The pre-flight check found the following before anything gets frozen. None of it blocks the run — decide whether to continue or fix it first.
readiness.confirm_note: Starting locks the inputs and calculates payroll right away. Anything entered afterwards stays out of the calculation until the run is reopened.

impact.anytime: Can be added any time, the run is not held up
impact.blocking: Payroll cannot be calculated without this
impact.revision: Fixing this later requires a correction revision

impact_hint.anytime: No effect on the payroll calculation. It just has to be filled in before filing.
impact_hint.blocking: The calculation has nothing to work from. Resolve this before anything else.
impact_hint.revision: The run can start now, but this value goes into the frozen snapshot — after inputs are locked it can only be fixed with a new revision.

scope.setup: Company setup — one-off, then it is done.

readiness.subtitle: You would see these after starting the run anyway — we show them now, while the inputs can still be fixed. None of it blocks the run: payroll can be calculated with these findings.

source_drift.action: Click “Refresh inputs”, then recalculate the run.
source_drift.action_forbidden: Inputs can be refreshed by a user allowed to calculate payroll and write payroll inputs.

source_drift.employments_removed: Employments that no longer belong to the period: {count}
source_drift.title: Since the inputs were locked ({date}), sources used by this revision have changed: {count}. The run can be approved only after the inputs are refreshed and the payroll recalculated.

takeover.badge_hint: The result comes from the previous payroll program; MyÚčto did not calculate it.
takeover.build_all_failed: Taking over stopped at {period} (months taken over: {built}): {reason}
takeover.build_failed: The month could not be taken over.
takeover.detail_failed: Payment evidence could not be loaded.
takeover.discard_failed: The takeover could not be discarded.
takeover.discard_hint: A taken-over run is never edited. Discard it and take the month over again from the current data.
takeover.evidence_note: Payment evidence, not a payment order. No liability or settlement is created, so it never shows up in the balance or in the journal — the historical month was already posted during the migration.
takeover.jmhz_note: The previous program filed the JMHZ reports for these months and MyÚčto does not build corrective reports for them. File the correction where the regular report came from (the previous program or the ČSSZ portal) and carry the corrected totals over to the taken-over wages and the opening balances.
takeover.subtitle: Months processed by the previous payroll program. A taken-over run mirrors them: it is not calculated, not approved and never posted again.
takeover.title: Taken-over months of the transition year

issues.income-component-tax-treatment-unverifie: The payroll component tax treatment is not verified.
