steps.activity_invalid: Open this employment and its effective terms. In the basic details check Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract. Save the correct terms effective for the reporting month, then recalculate payroll and approve a new revision. Do not substitute incorrect values just to pass validation.
steps.activity_missing: Open this employment and its effective terms. In the basic details check Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract. Save the correct terms effective for the reporting month, then recalculate payroll and approve a new revision. Do not substitute incorrect values just to pass validation.
steps.catalog: Contact your administrator or support with the period, revision number and technical details below. Do not change employee data just to pass validation.
steps.confirmation: Open payroll for this period. For a new preparation or an actually required correction, create and approve a new correction revision and prepare the report from it. Do not resend accepted reports solely because of this warning. Contact support if a new revision has the same problem.
steps.deduction_calculation: In Enforcement and deductions, check this person’s unresolved warnings, claim priorities and any concurrent insolvency. Resolve the reported issues, then recalculate and approve payroll. Contact support if the evidence is correct but the mismatch remains.
steps.deduction_register: In Enforcement and deductions, check this person’s claim register completeness. Record the verification; mark it not applicable only if that is accurate. Then recalculate and approve payroll for this month.
steps.deduction_title: Compare the calculated deduction with this person’s Deduction agreements and Enforcement and deductions records. Record the actual basis effective for the month, or correct an incorrectly entered deduction. Recalculate and approve payroll. Do not create a fictitious claim.
steps.deductions: Open Enforcement and deductions for this person and review unresolved warnings, claims and insolvency. For contractual deductions, also check Deduction agreements. After correcting the evidence, recalculate and approve payroll for this month.
steps.detail_invalid: Open this employment and its effective terms. In the basic details check Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract. Save the correct terms effective for the reporting month, then recalculate payroll and approve a new revision. Do not substitute incorrect values just to pass validation.
steps.detail_missing: Open this employment and its effective terms. In the basic details check Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract. Save the correct terms effective for the reporting month, then recalculate payroll and approve a new revision. Do not substitute incorrect values just to pass validation.
steps.detail_not_applicable: Open this employment and its effective terms. In the basic details check Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract. Save the correct terms effective for the reporting month, then recalculate payroll and approve a new revision. Do not substitute incorrect values just to pass validation.
steps.exception: Open this employment and its effective terms, More details → Exceptional situations → JMHZ unusual circumstances. Check the flagged option for the reporting month. If it was entered by mistake, correct the terms with the appropriate effective date, recalculate payroll and approve it. If the information is correct, do not change it to No; contact support about handling this case. A monthly editor for this exception is not yet available.

steps.incomplete_operation: Refresh the page and check whether the operation has already completed. If the error repeats, contact support with the technical details below; do not change employee data because of this error.
steps.integrity: Contact your administrator or support with the period, revision number and technical details below. Do not change employee data just to pass validation.
steps.interactions: Open payroll for this period. For a new preparation or an actually required correction, create and approve a new correction revision and prepare the report from it. reason.accident_insurance_calculated_and_materi: MyÚčto calculates the quarterly assessment base from social insurance and assesses the premium using the rate set in Payroll Settings (at least CZK 100). JMHZ does not replace the obligation. MyÚčto does not yet know the statutory rate table by prevailing activity — enter the rate manually from the insurer's assessment.
reason.accident_insurance_calculation_output_li: Assessment-base and rate calculation, assessment, output and payment liability for statutory accident insurance are not implemented. JMHZ does not replace the obligation. MyÚčto can only preserve evidence of an externally verified amount and an actually completed payment.
reason.eldp_historic_preparation_available: A historic ELDP can be prepared on its dedicated tab. This overview does not duplicate its data or status.
reason.eldp_jmhz_default_on_demand_exception: From 2026, ordinary ELDP data comes from JMHZ, but historic and on-demand scenarios remain. Preparation is available on the dedicated tab.
reason.hzupn_remains_standalone: HZUPN remains a standalone report alongside JMHZ. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.
reason.nempri_legacy_variant_not_supported: The pre-2025 NEMPRI variant is not supported by this workflow. Use the period-specific procedure and do not mark anything as fulfilled here.
reason.nempri_only_partially_in_jmhz: JMHZ only absorbed part of the data, so NEMPRI remains a separate action and must not be switched off automatically. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.
reason.nempri_standalone_manual: NEMPRI is a standalone obligation for this period. An accountant must complete both its content and submission in an official channel.
reason.nempri_standalone_prepared: NEMPRI is a standalone obligation for this period. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.

workflow.calculate_accident_insurance_externally: Determine the period, assessment base, rate and amount from professionally verified external sources; MyÚčto neither calculates nor validates them.
workflow.pay_accident_insurance_externally: Make the actual payment outside MyÚčto and verify both its amount and the payee identification.
workflow.pay_accident_insurance_liability: Pay the assessed liability the same way as other payroll levies and match the payment against the bank statement.
workflow.prepare_hzupn_submission: Prepare the HZUPN data message and have it validated against the pinned XSD.
workflow.prepare_nempri_submission: Prepare the NEMPRI data message and have it validated against the pinned XSD.
workflow.record_payment_evidence: Only then record the amount, references and DMS document as immutable manual-completion evidence.
workflow.record_receipt_evidence: Only then record the reference and DMS document below as evidence of manual completion.
workflow.record_sickness_case: Record the sickness case on the Sickness benefits tab — the report is built from it.
workflow.review_accident_insurance_liability: Review the calculated assessment base and assessed premium on the payments list for the last month of the quarter.
workflow.review_accident_insurance_rate_setting: Check that the company has an up-to-date rate from the insurer's assessment and the insurer's account set up in Institutions.
workflow.send_via_data_box: Send it through the data box with the button on the case in the Sickness benefits tab. You get a delivery note back, not a numbered confirmation.
workflow.store_official_receipt_in_company_dms: Store the real receipt or protocol as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.store_payment_evidence_in_company_dms: Store the payment confirmation or a specific official document as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.submit_in_official_channel: Complete and submit the report through a verified official ČSSZ channel.
workflow.use_eldp_workspace: Use the dedicated Pension record sheet tab; preparation never implies that the form was submitted.
workflow.verify_case_and_source_data: Verify the specific case, relevant period and source data, including earnings and shifts, outside this P0 overview.

imported.hint: This overview does not know about submissions filed by other software. The processing protocol delivered by ČSSZ to your data box can be imported here as XML, so filings made outside the app show up as well. The JMHZ partial protocol (attachment JMH-DILCI-PROTOKOL-…) can be imported too; upload it under its original name, which carries the variable symbol and period. A protocol issued to another variable symbol, with an invalid ČSSZ seal or with an employment the company does not have on record is refused.
imported.note: This document arrived through the data box; the app did not send it. It therefore holds no submission payload — the status cannot be polled and no transaction can be closed. The protocol itself is the result.

takeover_check.all_ok: The taken-over months are complete and the opening balances agree with the taken-over wages.
takeover_check.differences_hint: Fix the side that does not match the previous program's records. For the tax base a difference can be legitimate (exempt income is in gross pay, not in the tax base).
takeover_check.differences_title: Opening balances and taken-over wages disagree
takeover_check.discount_intents_hint: These taken-over employments have a premium discount reason filled in, but the records lack an intent accepted by ČSSZ. Without it the discount is not applied (section 7a(5) of Act No. 589/1992 Coll.). If the previous program notified the intent, take over its accepted OZUSPOJ filing with the delivery date from the protocol; otherwise notify the intent.
takeover_check.discount_intents_title: Insurance premium discount without an accepted OZUSPOJ intent
takeover_check.estimated_start_person: {name} — start {start}, may have lasted in months {months}
takeover_check.estimated_starts_hint: For these employments the JMHZ report carries no start date, so the insurance start in the earliest reported month was used. If the employment lasted longer, the taken-over wages for the earlier months are missing and the annual tax settlement and the tax statement would be based on an incomplete year. Import the reports for the missing months (Payroll → Imports → Registrations and reports), or correct or confirm the start on the employment card. It does not block the payroll run or the monthly report.
takeover_check.estimated_starts_title: Start date estimated from reports — earlier months may be missing
takeover_check.gaps_hint: These employees' employment lasted in taken-over months, but the opening balance says nothing about them. Enter the totals from the previous program, or confirm a month without income as zero.
takeover_check.hint: Months {months} were processed by the previous payroll program. Each of them needs an opening balance (used by the annual settlement, the tax statement and the income certificate) and taken-over wages (used by the pension insurance record sheet), and both must say the same.

overtime.averaging_hint: Total overtime must not exceed an average of 8 hours per week over an averaging period of at most 26 consecutive weeks. transport_delivery.original_title: The original submission is at ČSSZ
transport_delivery.original_what: ČSSZ answered the repeated dispatch that it already has an identical submission (control 22, error 20022). This is not a rejection and nothing is resent.

transport_delivery.possibly_what: The request to ČSSZ went out but no response came back. ČSSZ may have received it, so the submission is not resent automatically: a second dispatch could create a duplicate.
transport_delivery.possibly_where: First look for the protocol: in the company data box (message from ČSSZ) or on the ČSSZ ePortal among submissions. Load it here; if the original is at ČSSZ, this proves the submission. Confirm a retry only if there is no protocol anywhere.

absences.average_awaiting_approval: An average earning for this relation has been calculated but is awaiting approval. Approve it on the Average earning tab and come back.

absences.childbirth_recorded: The date of birth has been added.
absences.correction_pending: The related payroll run requires correction review.
absences.empty: No absences in the selected period.
absences.invalid_termination_hint: The period during which, under a final court decision (or an out-of-court settlement after the action was filed), the employment continued after an invalid termination and no wage compensation was awarded. No wage is due for it; the monthly report and the pension record report it as an excluded period under Section 16(4)(j) of Act No. 155/1995 Coll. (10536). If wage compensation was awarded, do not use this type and enter the compensation as a payroll input.
absences.lone_carer: Single employee caring for a child under 16
absences.lone_carer_hint: Nursing benefit is then paid for up to 16 calendar days instead of 9 (Section 40(1) of the Sickness Insurance Act). The monthly report uses it for the excluded care period (10360) and the benefit days (10475); days beyond the support period are reported as excused absence without compensation (10473).
absences.new_needs_person: A new absence can only be created for a specific employee — it is tied to an employment.
absences.record_childbirth_once: The date of birth can be added only once. To correct a wrong date, cancel the absence and record it again.
absences.sickness_window_carried_days: Days of the compensation window used up before this part
absences.sickness_window_carried_edit: Edit days of the compensation window
absences.sickness_window_carried_hint: Fill in only when the employee was with a different employer or a previous payroll program at the start of the incapacity — the wage compensation window (Section 192 of the Labour Code) shortens by the days already used up there. For a continuation of an incapacity recorded here, the days are calculated on approval automatically. It can no longer be changed once the wage compensation has been calculated.
absences.sickness_window_carried_saved: The compensation window days have been saved.
absences.unpaid_excused_hint: Time off without wage compensation (Sections 199–202 of the Labour Code). No compensation input is created; the hours go to the monthly report only as unworked hours (10275), in the unpaid leave block. If the law grants compensation for the office, enter it as a payroll input.

dpn.first_day_worked: The first scheduled shift was fully worked
dpn.not_eligible: The employee is not entitled to compensation (incapacity without entitlement)
dpn.not_eligible_hint: Wage compensation belongs only to an employee participating in sickness insurance (Section 192(1) of the Labour Code). For agreements to perform work and small-scale employment, participation in the month in which the incapacity began decides (Section 15a of Act No. 187/2006 Coll.). Without entitlement the wage is reduced for the days of incapacity and neither compensation nor a sickness benefit case is created.
dpn.reduction_hint: The compensation must be reduced to one half when the incapacity arose in the cases of Section 31 of Act No. 187/2006 Coll. (a fight, drunkenness, addictive substances, an intentional crime or offence). For a breach of the regime the employer may reduce the compensation or not provide it at all (100 %). The reduction is applied to the exact compensation before rounding.

reduction_kinds.half_192_4: To one half (Section 192(4) of the Labour Code)
reduction_kinds.reduced_192_5: Breach of the sick-leave regime (Section 192(5) of the Labour Code)

empty.no_employments_message: Absences, average earnings and the leave ledger are all tracked per employment. Create an employee and their employment in People, then come back here.

assessment.after: After the decision the affected relationships become ready; select them and press Calculate selected. Calculate an exception for one person (such as a work injury) under Manual calculation and adjustments.

hint_by_type.dpn: Sick leave counts up to 20 times the weekly working time per year; the automatic calculation applies the limit. A work injury or occupational disease counts in full, calculate it manually.
hint_by_type.other: Assess under § 216(2) and § 348(1) of the Labour Code whether the time counts as work for leave purposes.
hint_by_type.parental: Parental leave counts only for a father during the period the mother could take maternity leave; otherwise Do not count.

hints.blood_donation: § 203(2)(d) and (e) of the Labour Code: 100 % for travel, donation and recovery within 24 hours (48 hours for other biological material).
hints.child_wedding: Government Decree 590/2006, item 5(b): 1 day at 100 %. A parent's wedding is without compensation.
hints.childbirth_transport: Government Decree 590/2006, item 6(a): necessary time at 100 %. Attending the birth is without compensation.
hints.commute_prevented_disabled: Government Decree 590/2006, item 4: at most 1 day at 100 %, only for a severely disabled employee whose own vehicle journey was prevented by weather or an emergency.
hints.coworker_funeral: Government Decree 590/2006, item 9: necessary time at 100 % for employees designated by the employer.
hints.death_close_relative: Government Decree 590/2006, item 7(a): 2 days plus a day for the funeral at 100 %. Up to 5 further days are without compensation.
hints.death_relative: Government Decree 590/2006, item 7(b): 1 day for the funeral and another day if the employee arranges it, at 100 %.
hints.disabled_child_escort: Government Decree 590/2006, item 8(b): at most 6 working days a year at 100 %.
hints.downtime: § 207(a) of the Labour Code: machine breakdown, missing materials or energy, faulty documents. At least 80 % of average if the employee was not moved to other work.
hints.employee_representation: § 203(2)(a) to (c) of the Labour Code: trade union, works council, OSH representative or union training at 100 %.
hints.family_escort: Government Decree 590/2006, item 8(a)(1): at most 1 day at 100 % for spouse, partner, child, parent or grandparent. No compensation if the employee is entitled to care allowance.
hints.job_search_redundancy: Government Decree 590/2006, item 11(a): at most 4 days at 100 % on notice under § 52(a) to (e) of the Labour Code.
hints.medical_examination: Government Decree 590/2006, item 1: 100 % compensation only for the necessary time at the nearest contracted doctor, if it could not be done outside working hours. For part of a shift, fill in the missed hours of the first day.
hints.other_employer_obstacle: § 208 of the Labour Code: other employer-side obstacles (lack of work, closed operations). 100 % of average.
hints.other_paid_employee: A paid obstacle based on an internal regulation, collective agreement or special law (sick day, personal leave). 100 % compensation; state the basis in the reason.
hints.own_wedding: Government Decree 590/2006, item 5(a): 2 days off, 100 % compensation only for the day of the ceremony. Record the second day as an obstacle without compensation.
hints.partial_unemployment: § 209 of the Labour Code: temporary drop in sales or demand. At least 60 % only under an agreement with the union or an internal regulation; otherwise it is another obstacle at 100 %.
hints.partial_work: Section 120a et seq. of the Employment Act: partial work for which the employer claims a contribution. At least 80 % of average. The employee is listed in the monthly cost statement, so no social security discount is due for them in that month (Section 7a(3)(e) of Act No. 589/1992 Coll.).
hints.qualification_training: § 205 and § 232 of the Labour Code: training or study required for the agreed work and in line with the employer's needs, at 100 %.
hints.relocation_employer_interest: Government Decree 590/2006, item 10: at most 2 days; 100 % only when relocating in the employer's interest.
hints.weather_interruption: § 207(b) of the Labour Code: work interrupted by bad weather or a natural disaster. At least 60 % of average.

registration.hint: Upload employee registration XML files (REGZEC, PREZEC) accepted by ČSSZ, the employee export from the ČSSZ ePortal or JMHZ monthly reports from another payroll program. Registrations are matched to people and employments, the missing ones are created and changed data is filled in. The employee export fills in OIČ and ID PPV; a new person is created from it only together with a monthly report from which the start date is derived. From monthly reports the app takes over the taxpayer declaration, tax credits and dependants and offers to take over the payroll history. First and last names are never changed automatically. NEMPRI, HZUPN and OZUSPOJ submissions the previous program already sent are recorded as settled by it and nothing is sent again: NEMPRI and HZUPN are attached to a benefit case (or create one), for OZUSPOJ you enter the delivery day from the ČSSZ protocol. A sickness absence without HZUPN stays in the deadline watcher.

pohoda.dry_run_background_hint: The dry run is one transaction, so it does not report individual steps while running — the full protocol with every step appears when it ends. It usually takes up to a minute; you can close this page.
pohoda.dry_run_hint: The whole transfer of the selected years ({years}) runs, including reconciliation, and then everything is rolled back. Nothing stays in MyÚčto.
pohoda.dry_run_locks_hint: The dry run runs in a single database transaction. Run it outside normal work in the company: entries it touches wait until it ends.
pohoda.dry_run_years_hint: The dry run transfers each selected year separately and rolls it back. A later year therefore does not see the data of the previous year (opening balances, transferred documents and payments) and its result may differ from the live transfer.
pohoda.export_auto_detect: Upload the resulting ZIP from any route below. The wizard detects its format automatically; all routes use the same preview, dry run and transfer.
export_help_items: Download the export tool and copy it to a computer with POHODA installed. It runs on Windows in PowerShell 5.1, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.
Run Export-Pohoda.cmd by double-clicking it, or with parameters, for example Export-Pohoda.cmd -Uzivatel Admin -Rok 2026 -Ico 12345678.
Enter the password of the POHODA user. The user needs the XML import/export right; Admin is the simplest choice.
If POHODA keeps more companies, the company ID must be given with -Ico. Without -Rok all fiscal years are exported.
The export only reads; nothing in POHODA is changed. A large agenda takes tens of minutes.
The file pohoda_export_<date>.zip appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
file_help_items: POHODA keeps every fiscal year separately. The years you tick in the preview are transferred (one or several at once).

The POHODA XML export does not contain assets or payroll. The wizard takes the fixed asset and small asset cards from the 90_majetek.xml file that the export tool adds to the export (see the manual); payroll from 91_mzdy.xml is not processed by this wizard.
The ZIP may contain subfolders. The wizard finds the XML files of all agendas in them and offers for transfer those that belong to the MyÚčto company by company ID.
The company must exist in MyÚčto with the same company ID as in POHODA. The transfer goes into the company you are working in; create a new company first.
The export contains the company's entire accounting. The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 24 hours without any work on the migration.
pohoda.files_hint: The transfer reads these files as empty. This explains why part of the data is missing from the transfer.
pohoda.import_confirm: I understand: the transfer writes the journal, address book, invoices, internal tax documents, cash and bank of {years} from the agenda {company} into this company and switches it to double-entry bookkeeping. The years are transferred in ascending order. Repeating the transfer duplicates nothing.
pohoda.import_confirm_first: Confirm first that you understand the impact of the transfer.
pohoda.later_year_hint: A POHODA agenda also keeps documents after the year end (journal entries, bank and cash movements, invoices dated in the next year). A later year can only be transferred together with the agenda year: checking it selects the agenda year too, unchecking the agenda year clears it. An unselected later year is skipped and a repeated transfer including it adds it without duplicating anything.
pohoda.later_year_row: Documents of {year} kept in the {agenda} agenda

mdb_help_items: Prepare the .mdb data file for the correct company and fiscal year. Close POHODA for all users and make a copy of the file. If you have a ZIP backup, restore the data file from it first; the backup ZIP itself is not an MDB.
Download the tools below and extract pohoda-export.zip into one folder on a Windows computer.
Double-click Export-PohodaMdbAccounting.cmd and select the prepared MDB copy.
The converter reads the accounting data directly and creates a ZIP containing XML. It displays the output path when finished.
Upload only the resulting ZIP from the converter here. The source MDB stays on your computer; do not upload it or the original POHODA backup.
pohoda.mdb_help_requirements: The converter runs in Windows PowerShell 5.1; you do not need to install PHP on your computer. This route supports MDB data files; POHODA SQL databases are handled by route 3.
pohoda.mdb_help_title: 2. Convert an MDB data file on Windows
pohoda.no_matching_agenda: The export contains no agenda with the company ID of the MyÚčto company ({ico}). Create the export with the -Ico parameter, or check the company ID in company settings.
pohoda.other_wizard_hint: The export contains further agendas this wizard does not migrate (count: {n}). Migrate accounting under Migration from POHODA and payroll under Migration from PAMICA.
pohoda.payroll_approve_taken_over: Approve the taken-over attendance and payroll inputs right away. PAMICA months have already been processed and filed; as unapproved drafts they would block starting and closing a payroll run. Note: a started run recalculates the month with its own rule set, so the result may not match what was already filed to the last crown. Leave it unchecked to review and approve them manually under Payroll → Inputs and Payroll → Attendance.
pohoda.payroll_dry_run_hint: The whole payroll transfer of the selected years ({years}) runs: missing employees and relations are created and all months are imported. Everything is then rolled back, nothing stays in MyÚčto.
pohoda.payroll_identifiers_confirm: I confirm that the OIČ and ID PPV numbers kept in PAMICA (on the cards and in the sent JMHZ reports and registrations) come from the social security administration protocols. The transfer stores them with the employees and relations, JMHZ reports are matched by them. Without this confirmation these numbers are not transferred.
pohoda.payroll_import_confirm: I understand: the transfer creates the employees and employment relations missing in this company and imports the payroll of {years} from the agenda {company} as monthly payroll import batches. Repeating the transfer duplicates nothing.
pohoda.payroll_only_hint: The agenda contains payroll only (91_mzdy.xml). Employees, employment relations and processed payroll are transferred month by month.

payroll_period_range.hint: Leave empty to take over every month PAMICA has closed. Fill it in to limit the takeover, e.g. to 1-8/2026 even if the export also contains September: payroll, reference totals and filed reports of other months are not taken over and payroll start is set no later than the month after the range ends.

payroll_start.keep_confirm: I confirm that MyÚčto will calculate {from} to {last} itself, although PAMICA has already processed them.

pohoda.sql_driver_hint: The default driver ships with Windows. Only if you choose driver odbc in the configuration (for example because of TLS), install
pohoda.sql_driver_link: Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server.
sql_help_items: Download the tools below and extract pohoda-export.zip into one folder on a Windows computer that can reach the SQL Server running POHODA.
Copy the pohoda-sql.example.json sample as pohoda-sql.json next to the script and fill in the server, port and login. Without this file the tool asks for everything; the password is entered hidden.
Double-click Export-PohodaSQL.cmd. Pick the agenda from the list (database StwPh_<company ID>_<year>), or set it in the configuration or with the -Ico and -Rok parameters.
The tool sends SELECT queries only over a read-only connection and creates the same ZIP as the MDB conversion. It displays the output path when finished.
Upload the resulting ZIP here unchanged, do not unpack it.
pohoda.sql_help_requirements: All you need is Windows PowerShell 5.1 and network access to the SQL Server. The SQL user only needs read access: we recommend a dedicated login with the db_datareader role in the agenda database. An empty user means signing in with the Windows account.

Fix the differences in the source and repeat the dry run, or run the migration with them and resolve them in MyÚčto. Accepted differences stay in the migration protocol.

premier.dry_run_hint: The full migration of the selected years ({years}) runs, including reconciliation, but everything is rolled back at the end. Nothing remains in MyUcto.
premier.dry_run_locks_hint: The dry run runs in a single database transaction. Run it outside normal work in the company: entries the dry run touches wait until it finishes.
premier.dry_run_years_hint: The dry run migrates each selected year separately and rolls it back. A later year therefore does not see the data of the previous year (opening balances, migrated documents and payments) and its result may differ from the live migration.
file_help_items: The backup contains all fiscal years kept in PREMIER, not just one. Years are still migrated one at a time, starting with the oldest.
The company must already exist in MyUcto with the same company ID as in PREMIER. Data is migrated into the company you are working in; create a new company first if needed.

The backup also contains payroll. The wizard creates the employees and takes over the processed payroll as records of the previous system. For a company that has no payroll in MyÚčto yet it enables the Payroll module, creates a payroll office and sets the payroll start after the last processed month; fill in the social security variable symbol and institution accounts in Payroll → Settings. Payroll entries are in the migrated journal and are not created again.
The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 24 hours of inactivity.
premier.import_confirm: I understand: the migration writes the journal, address book, invoices, VAT documents outside invoices, bank, assets and employees with payroll of {years} from agenda {company} into the company and switches it to double-entry bookkeeping. The years are migrated in ascending order. Repeating the migration will not duplicate anything.
premier.import_confirm_first: Confirm you understand the impact of the migration first.
premier.no_matching_agenda: The backup contains no year for the company ID used in MyUcto ({ico}). Check the company ID in the company settings.
premier.preflight_blocked: The pre-migration check reports an error. Fix it and upload the backup again.
premier.preflight_ok: The agenda is fine, migration can start.
premier.processing_hint: The server is extracting and reading the backup. For a large backup this can take several minutes; you may refresh the page meanwhile.

protocol.automation_left_off: Automation stays off until the migration finishes without errors. Documents without a journal link would otherwise be booked twice.

protocol.unmapped_accounts: Accounts unknown to the reports: {accounts}. Map them in report mapping.

premier.rights_missing: The live migration writes the accounting journal and changes company settings. You are missing write permission: {rights}. Ask your company administrator.
premier.run_delete_confirm: Delete the log of dry run #{id}? The dry run changed nothing in MyÚčto, only the record is deleted.
premier.start_failed: The migration could not be started.

premier.subtitle: Migrate a fiscal year from a PREMIER data backup: journal, address book, invoices, VAT documents outside invoices, bank, assets, employees and payroll and reconciliation to the last cent. Years must be migrated one by one, oldest first, because a year's opening balances derive from prior years in the same backup.

premier.supplier_ico_missing: The company you are working in has no company ID set in MyUcto, so no year from the backup can be matched to it. Fill in the company ID in the company settings and upload the backup again.
premier.support_notice: This import is intended for smaller amounts of data. Migrations from other systems are not supported by their vendors and data exports differ between versions and installations, so {recommend}. As part of our paid service we will be happy to help with the migration and tailor it to your needs; it typically takes up to 10 hours at CZK 1,500/h + VAT. Whether you import on your own or with us, always verify the transferred data.
premier.support_notice_recommend: we recommend {contact} and leaving the import to us

warning.advance_has_tax_document: The linked advance already has a tax document for payment (DDKP) — its VAT was claimed separately. On this final invoice claim the deduction only from the VAT TOP-UP (the difference against the DDKP), otherwise the deduction would be taken twice.
warning.credit_note_positive_total: Credit note has a positive total — it should have negative amounts. A negative sign on one side is enough (e.g. −1 pc × 1000, or 1 pc × −1000); if both quantity and price are negative, VAT/control-statement reports will add the amount instead of subtracting it. Please check the signs.
warning.eu_acquisition_delivery_date_missing: This intra-EU acquisition of goods has no delivery date, so the tax point under § 25 of the Czech VAT Act can be neither computed nor verified. Fill in the delivery date from the document — the VAT period and the CNB rate both depend on the tax point. The system deliberately does not guess it: the month of acquisition cannot be derived from the issue date.
warning.eu_acquisition_tax_date_mismatch: The tax point does not match the § 25 calculation from the delivery date you entered (the 15th day of the month following delivery, or the earlier invoice issue date). Check both dates — the difference moves the supply into a different VAT period and changes the CNB rate.
warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the relevant day by {diff} %. Please check the rate. This is the accounting conversion — the CZK VAT amount on the document (§73/6) is unaffected.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded: The relevant date (tax point) or the currency changed, but the exchange rate stayed as it was ({rate} as of {date}) — {reason} Please check the rate on the document.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_cnb_unavailab: the CNB rate for the new date could not be fetched.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_source_locked: the rate on the document does not come from an automatic conversion (a person entered it, it came from an import, or its origin is unknown), so automation does not overwrite it.
warning.linked_advance_unpaid: Advance {advance} has no posted payment yet, so this invoice did not settle the advance (321/314). Match the advance payment with advance {advance}, not with this invoice; the settlement is then added to this invoice's entry automatically.
warning.missing_vat_classification: This document carries VAT (or is under reverse charge) but has no VAT classification, so it reaches neither the VAT return nor the control statement. Typically a rate the Czech codebook does not know (e.g. German 19%) or a vendor with an undetermined country. Check the line rates and pick a classification manually.
warning.public_authority_fee_out_of_scope: This document looks like a public-authority fee (court fee, administrative fee, duty stamp). A public authority acting in that capacity is not a taxable person (Section 5(4) of the Czech VAT Act), so the supply is outside the scope of VAT — including fees charged by a foreign court or office: no self-assessment under Section 9(1), and the document enters neither the VAT return nor the control statement. That is why no VAT classification was assigned. If this really is an ordinary purchased service, pick the classification manually.
warning.receipt_looks_like_prepayment: This document is classified as a receipt, but its content looks like a tax document for a received payment (advance). A receipt books the cost (518) immediately — when the final invoice later arrives, the cost is double-counted. Consider the type "Tax document for payment" (DDKP → VAT deduction only, 343/314) or "Advance".
warning.vendor_non_payer_deduction: The vendor is not a VAT payer, yet a VAT deduction is claimed. VAT cannot be deducted from a non-payer — please check the deduction setting.
warning.vendor_unreliable_payer: According to the VAT payer registry (CRPDPH), the vendor is listed as an unreliable VAT payer — paying them carries liability risk for unpaid VAT (§109 VAT Act). Consider special-mode payment (§109a) or verifying with the vendor.

recurring.amount_czk_hint: Multi-currency sum converted to CZK at today's CNB rate.
recurring.auto_issue: Issue immediately after generating (assign invoice number)
recurring.auto_send_email: Send to client by email after issuing
recurring.branding_profile_hint: The selected profile is used for every invoice generated from this template.
recurring.catalog_requires_context: Select a customer and document currency before choosing a price list item.

recurring.delete_confirm:
Delete template „{name}"?

Invoices generated so far stay — they just lose the link to the template.
recurring.draft_open_mode_hint: „At start of period" opens the draft on the 1st day of the billed month, so you can add extra work to the work report throughout the month. The draft is automatically closed, issued and sent the day after the period ends (so work logged on the last day is captured too) — the issue date and tax date still stay at the end of period.
recurring.draft_open_mode_monthly_only: „At start of period" is only available for monthly frequency.
recurring.draft_open_mode_period_start: At start of period (for ongoing work report)
recurring.end_date_hint: After this date the template is paused automatically (status „Expired").
recurring.end_of_month: End of month (28/29/30/31 depending on month)
recurring.increment_month: Sync month in item descriptions to DUZP (e.g. „Hosting 03/2026" → „Hosting 05/2026" if DUZP falls in 5/2026)
recurring.items_required: Template must have at least one item.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.name_required: Give the template a name for easier orientation.
recurring.notes_placeholders_hint: Period placeholders are supported (see the items help) — evaluated when each invoice is generated.
recurring.oss_country_required: Fill in the Member State of consumption for the OSS line — without it the line is saved as domestic.
recurring.oss_rate_type_missing_hint: Without a rate type the generator will try to fill it from the codebook, but only if it derives the same Member State of consumption. Otherwise the line will not reach the OSS return — set the type according to the rate applicable in the Member State of consumption.
recurring.oss_registration_hint: OSS set on a template line is a stored decision: it takes precedence over automatic derivation when invoices are generated. It is only used when the company holds a valid OSS registration on the tax point date of the generated invoice. Once the registration ends, the line is issued as domestic and flagged for manual review.
recurring.pause_confirm: Pause template „{name}"? Cron will skip it until you resume.
recurring.payment_due_unit_hint: "Follow customer" takes the unit from the customer record (which may in turn inherit the company default). Calendar month: Jan 31 → Feb 28, not a fixed 30 days.
recurring.payment_variable_symbol_hint: All generated invoices get this variable symbol (e.g. for a standing order). Empty = derived from the document number.
recurring.period_start_requires_auto_issue: „At start of period" mode requires auto-issue (the draft closes itself at the end of the period).
recurring.period_start_requires_monthly: „At start of period" mode can only be used with monthly frequency.
recurring.placeholders_example: Example: "Renewal of domain example.cz for period {'{DATE}'} - {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'}" → "Renewal of domain example.cz for period May 15, 2026 - May 14, 2027"
recurring.placeholders_intro: Replaced on every invoice generation based on the tax date (issue date for proformas). They also work in the notes above/below items carried over from the template. Unrecognized tokens are left untouched. Examples below for tax date May 15, 2026:

placeholders_rows.d: year → 2026, 26 · shift by years: {'{YYYY+1}'} → 2027, {'{YY-1}'} → 25 · year of a shifted month: {'{YYYY+8M}'} → 2027 (pairs with {'{MMMM+8}'})
month → 5, 05 · shift by months incl. year rollover: {'{MM+8}'} → 01
month name per document language → May · {'{MMMM+1}'} → June
full date → May 15, 2026 · ±D/M/Y arithmetic: {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'} → May 14, 2027 · month overflow is clamped (Jan 31 {'{DATE+1M}'} → Feb 28)
start/end of month → May 1, 2026, May 31, 2026 · shift by months: {'{EOM+1}'} → Jun 30, 2026, {'{EOM-1}'} → Apr 30, 2026

recurring.reschedule_confirm: I have checked existing invoices and confirm the date change.

recurring.reschedule_expired: An expired template will become paused. Resume automatic generation separately.

recurring.reschedule_too_late: The new date must not be after the template’s end date ({max}).
recurring.reschedule_unchanged: The new date matches the current schedule. Enter a different next generation date.
recurring.reschedule_warning: This change may skip a period or cause duplicate billing. For an active template, a date of today may be processed by the next automatic run. Existing invoices and history stay unchanged. Subsequent cycles follow the new date using the template’s interval and day rule.
recurring.revenue_category_hint: Fixed category for all invoices generated from this template. If not selected, the project default (or customer default) effective at issue time is used.
recurring.run_now_advance: Replace the scheduled occurrence and advance the schedule by one interval
recurring.run_now_advance_hint: The next date is based on the scheduled cycle, rather than this invoice’s date.
recurring.run_now_draft_hint: Creates a draft for the chosen date — does not issue or send. You'll edit and issue it manually.
recurring.run_now_draft_period_note: The draft will be created for the period with planned issue date {date} — you can edit it throughout the month.
recurring.run_now_expires: The next date is past the template’s end date; the template will expire.
recurring.run_now_extra_hint: An extra invoice will be created. The schedule stays unchanged and automation will generate another invoice on the scheduled date.
recurring.run_now_future_warning: Selected date is in the future. For tax purposes the issue date should reflect actual issuance — consider whether you really want this.
recurring.run_now_result_date: Next scheduled date after this action: {date}

It is derived automatically from the rate and unit of measure — set it only where the derivation is not enough (e.g. supply of goods to the EU with the unit "ks", or a sale of fixed assets). The choice carries over to every generated invoice.

refundInvoice.negative_item_hint: Enter a discount or a return as a negative quantity or a negative price. When deductions exceed the supply, the document ends with an amount to refund to the customer.
refundInvoice.settings_hint: An invoice whose deductions (e.g. returned packaging or an overpayment) exceed the supply may end with a negative amount. Refunds are then offered in payment orders and in the cash register.

cnb_audit.fixed_mode: The company uses a fixed rate (§24/7) — deviation from CNB is intentional and lawful, the audit is skipped.
cnb_audit.no_data: No document exceeds the deviation threshold — rates match.
cnb_audit.note: Impact = total amount × (CNB rate − rate on document). This is the accounting conversion (563/663); it does not affect the CZK VAT amount on the document (§73/6).
cnb_audit.subtitle: Foreign-currency documents where the accounting rate on the document deviates from the daily CNB rate for the relevant day beyond the chosen threshold. The report never changes rates — it only warns.
cnb_audit.title: FX rate audit vs. CNB

blocked.date_locked: The period end date is locked (filed return / manual lock). Recomputing is possible only after moving the lock in accounting settings (admin only).
blocked.no_accounting_period: There is no accounting period covering the period end.
blocked.period_not_open: The accounting period is not open — the document will not be recomputed. The difference belongs in a supplementary return, not in closed books.

clearing.done_deleted: The period came out zero — the clearing document was deleted.
clearing.missing_hint: The period still has an untransferred balance on the VAT accounts — the clearing document is missing.
clearing.stale_hint: The document was posted at {posted}, but today's data gives {fresh} — a document was added or changed in the period after it was cleared. Recompute so the general ledger shows the real liability.
clearing.title: Internal VAT clearing document
clearing.trigger_hint: Transfers the period's VAT from 343.100/343.200 to the settlement account 343.900. Created automatically when the VAT return is FILED — run it here manually for periods whose return is not filed from the app.

cross_check.confirm_download_anyway: The return diverges from the VAT control statement, EC sales list, or account 343 turnover (see breakdown above). The tax office matches filings automatically — a mismatch risks a query. Download the XML anyway?
cross_check.download_gate_hint: Download is blocked until the mismatch is resolved, or you consciously confirm via the Download XML button.
cross_check.draft_advance_note: Issue or review the listed advance-payment tax documents or final invoices before filing; VAT becomes due when the payment is received.
cross_check.draft_advance_title: Unissued tax documents for advance payments in the period
cross_check.explained_title: Account 343 difference explained by a § 73 VAT Act timing shift

reason.timing_booked_later: booked on {date} in a later period; the deduction is claimed now

dph_book.section_filter: VAT return line / control statement section
dph_book.filtered_line_note: Only sections for the selected line and their subtotals are shown. Clear the filter to view full-period totals or download the full ledger PDF.
dph_book.current_book_note: The ledger shows current documents including drafts, rather than amendment differences or a saved filing. Drafts are excluded from the VAT return. Rounding or partial deductions may also cause amounts to differ.
dph_book.open_line_beside: Open documents for line {line} in the VAT ledger
dph_book.open_section_beside: Open the document list for section {section}

claim_hint.issue_date: The deduction period follows the issue date: input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act), and you cannot hold it before it was issued. An earlier tax point therefore cannot pull the deduction into its own month.
claim_hint.received_at: The deduction period follows the date the document was received: input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act). If the date received is wrong, correct it on the document.
claim_hint.tax_date: The deduction period follows the tax point — the document was issued and received no later than that day.

dph_book.claim_period_note: Received documents are placed by their deduction period (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act): input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document. A document with a tax point at the end of a month but issued or received in the next month therefore belongs to that next month.
dph_book.claim_shift_legend: * The deduction period was shifted by the date the document was received. Check it matches the day you actually got the document — for AI-extracted documents it is pre-filled with the processing date.

col.claim_date_hint: The date that placed this received document into the current period. Not shown for supplied transactions or § 74b corrections.

dph_book.disclaimer_body: The VAT ledger is an internal accounting journal grouping issued and received documents by VAT return rows. It includes drafts — visually distinguished in the table. It is NOT an official tax submission.
dph_book.nil_kh_hint: A document with zero base and VAT is not included in the control statement. The supply is reported on the tax document for the received payment.
dph_book.nil_row_note: Zero base and VAT (typically settlement of a fully paid advance)
dph_book.no_data: No entries in the VAT ledger for the selected period.
dph_book.note_d_marker: (If the VAT amount is marked with code D, VAT is valued at a different exchange rate than the base accounting rate.)
dph_book.subtitle: Internal VAT journal grouped by VAT return rows. Not an official tax submission.
dph_book.title: VAT ledger

kh_evidence.title: Control statement document list

monthly_export.no_selection: Select at least one part to export.
monthly_export.period_rule_note: Documents are assigned to the period in a tax-correct way, consistent with the VAT ledger and VAT return: issued by tax date (DUZP), received by the later of tax date / issue date, statements by statement date, and GoPay by clearing period.

oss.archive_empty: No OSS filing has been archived yet.
oss.archive_note: Every OSS XML download is archived with its SHA-256 digest and the underlying data it was built from. An archived file proves what was generated — not that it was filed. Record the actual filing in Taxes → EPO filing & archive.
oss.evidence_empty: No records exist for this quarter — they are created when the OSS XML is downloaded.
oss.evidence_note: Records of the covered supplies are kept for {years} years from the end of the calendar year in which the supply took place and are provided electronically upon request of the tax administrator. Records are created when a filing is archived and cannot be modified or deleted.
oss.evidence_unsupported: Points of Article 63c the application cannot evidence
oss.filing_channel_hint: The OSS return is filed in the MOSS/OSS application on the Czech tax portal, not through the general EPO route. Download the XML and upload it there after signing in to MOSS/OSS.
oss.manual_review_link: Show documents with lines awaiting review ({n}) in the invoice list
oss.no_data: No OSS rows are marked for the selected quarter.
oss.reconciliation_in_sync: Today's preview matches the archived filing.
oss.reconciliation_no_filing: No filing is archived for this quarter — there is nothing to compare.
oss.reconciliation_no_snapshot: The archived filing has no stored source data, so it cannot be compared with today's preview. Check the differences manually against the downloaded XML.
oss.reconciliation_not_proven: The reference snapshot was only generated/downloaded, not proven as filed. Downloading XML is not filing — mark the snapshot as filed once submitted.
oss.reconciliation_note: Compares the archived filing with what would be filed for the same period today. Its main purpose is to surface documents edited retroactively after filing.
oss.reconciliation_out_of_sync: Today's preview differs from the archived filing. Consider whether a corrective filing for the original period is due.
oss.return_rate_note: All foreign-currency rows are converted using the ECB rate published for the last day of the tax period (Art. 91 of Directive 2006/112/EC). A manual rate entered on the line takes precedence.
oss.return_rate_shifted: The ECB published no rate for the period end ({end}) — a weekend or TARGET holiday; the next available day was used.
oss.subtitle: Quarterly One Stop Shop overview from issued invoices. Lines are assigned to OSS automatically; uncertain cases are flagged for manual review.
oss.threshold_note: The threshold (§ 8(3) of the Czech VAT Act) counts all cross-border B2C supplies to the EU, including those invoiced with Czech VAT. The EUR conversion is indicative (daily CNB rate) — verify with your accountant near the threshold.
oss.title: OSS return

pending_approval.confirm_download_anyway: Self-assessed received documents awaiting approval are missing from the filing (see the list). Self-assessed tax belongs to the period of the tax point. Do you really want to download the XML anyway?
pending_approval.deduction_note: These documents are awaiting approval or were rejected, so they are missing from the filing. You can claim the deduction later.
pending_approval.download_gate_hint: Downloading the XML requires an explicit confirmation until the self-assessed documents are approved or cancelled.

relatedParties.action_adjust_hint: Tax base adjustment under § 23(7) — difference against prices between unrelated parties.
relatedParties.adjustment_form_hint: State how the difference is documented, or why it is not — without it the adjustment cannot be defended during an audit.
relatedParties.adjustments_hint: Recorded per counterparty and per reason; that is exactly how it is proven during an audit.
relatedParties.delete_confirm: Really delete this tax base adjustment?
relatedParties.deviations_hint: Price charged to a related party against the median price of the same item for unrelated parties.
relatedParties.explainer_body: A deviation is computed only where a comparison exists — that is, when the same item was also sold to unrelated parties; the median is used so a one-off clearance sale does not skew the result. Where no comparison exists, the system does NOT know the arm's-length price and does not claim one: documenting it is up to the accountant. The system never adjusts the tax base on its own — § 23(7) requires it only when the difference is not satisfactorily documented.
relatedParties.explainer_title: What the system claims and what it does not

s46.delivered_on_hint: § 46f — determines the taxable period in which the correction is reported.
s46.explainer_body: The candidate list shows unpaid issued documents with output VAT past due — it does not imply an entitlement to a correction. The legal ground (insolvency, execution, debtor's death, liquidation, small receivable up to CZK 10,000 after 6 months) and delivery of the corrective tax document to the debtor are substantiated by the accountant when recording the correction. The correction is reported in the VAT return (lines 1/2 negative, line 33) and control statement (A.4) for the delivery period. Restoration after payment (§ 46e) is computed automatically from recorded payments. Sensitive tax output — verify with a tax advisor before filing.
s46.explainer_title: A working list, not an entitlement

vatCoefficient.action_settle_hint: Computes the settlement coefficient from the actual year data and stores it (admin only). Belongs in the return for the last taxable period of the year.
vatCoefficient.carried_forward: carried forward from last year's settlement
vatCoefficient.explainer_body: The provisional coefficient (§ 76(6)) is applied to line 52 of the VAT return in every taxable period of the year — when not set, last year's settlement coefficient carries forward. The settlement coefficient (§ 76(7)) is computed from the actual full-year data and the settlement is reported in the return for the last taxable period of the year. Settlement is always an explicit action — it never runs on its own.
vatCoefficient.final_hint: Computed from the actual supplies of the whole year (numerator = supplies with deduction entitlement, denominator = all supplies).
vatCoefficient.not_settled: The annual settlement for this year has not been performed yet.
vatCoefficient.provisional_hint: Applied to the reduced deduction (line 52) during the year. Whole percentage 0–100.
vatCoefficient.provisional_invalid: The coefficient must be a number 0–100 %.
vatCoefficient.resolved_none: none — the deduction is not reduced
vatCoefficient.settle_confirm: Perform the annual coefficient settlement for {year}? The settlement coefficient will be computed from actual data and stored — it is reported in the return for the last taxable period of the year.

s43.empty: No § 43 correction recorded for the selected year.
s43.explainer_body: § 42 corrects the tax BASE (credit note, discount) and belongs to the period in which the corrective document was DELIVERED — forwards. § 43 corrects the tax AMOUNT (wrong rate, miscalculation) and belongs BACK in the period of the ORIGINAL supply; an amended return is filed. The rate applicable to the original supply is used, not the current one. After the assessment period expires (usually 3 years from the end of the period) no correction is possible.
s43.form_hint: Enter the period of the ORIGINAL supply; for a received invoice, the period in which you claimed the deduction. For a received invoice the correction adjusts the deduction (lines 40/41), not output tax. The delivery date only determines the earliest date the correction could be made.
s43.form_title: Correction of the tax amount (§ 43 VAT Act)
s43.increase_rejected: A correction of the tax amount under § 43 of the VAT Act may only reduce the tax (for a received invoice, reduce the deduction), so the tax change must be negative. Tax declared lower than the law requires is added in a supplementary tax return for the period of the original supply under § 141 of the Tax Procedure Code.
s43.required: Fill in the document, delivery date and reason.
s43.reverse_charge_rejected: For a received document under reverse charge, the recipient corrects the self-assessed tax (lines 3–13) and the mirrored deduction (lines 43/44). The § 43 correction register does not know the supply regime needed to pick the line; enter the correction directly in the supplementary return and the follow-up control statement.

s79.empty: No § 79 item recorded for the selected year.
s79.explainer_body: The deduction entitlement on registration is reported POSITIVELY in the return for the period containing the day the person became a payer — it covers assets acquired within the preceding 12 months that the company still holds on that day. The reduction on deregistration is reported NEGATIVELY in the last period of registration: inventory returns the whole deduction, a fixed asset only the proportional part for the years remaining in the adjustment period.
s79.form_hint: Effective date = the day the person became a payer, or the day of deregistration. It determines the period in which the figure is reported.
s79.form_title: Deduction on registration / its reduction (§ 79, § 79a VAT Act)
s79.required: Fill in the asset description and both dates.

net_turnover.hidden_rows: Rows hidden for having no turnover: {count}
net_turnover.hint: For periods from 1 January 2024, net turnover is revenue from the sale of products, goods and services (§ 1a(2) of the Accounting Act, § 35 of Decree 500/2002 Coll.), by default income statement rows I. and II. If other revenue belongs to the company's business model, such as proceeds from selling assets for a lessor or income from shares for a holding company, tick its rows. This is the entity's judgement; disclose it in the notes to the financial statements.

reason.holding: Holding or fund company: income from shares and from other long-term financial assets is ordinary business-model revenue here, not an exceptional event.
reason.lending: Lending or finance leasing: interest is revenue from the main activity, even though the income statement reports it under financial results.
reason.operating_lease: Renting and leasing of tangible goods: selling a retired leased item belongs to the model. Nothing is suggested for the statement by function - it has no separate row for proceeds from selling assets.
reason.other_financial: Other financial activity: both interest and other financial income may be business-model revenue. Pick according to what the company actually does.
reason.rental: Letting and management of real estate: selling a let property is the end of a lessor’s ordinary cycle. Nothing is suggested for the statement by function - it has no separate row for proceeds from selling assets, and the whole Other operating income row would overstate turnover.
reason.securities_own_account: Trading securities on own account: the income is reported as other financial income, yet it belongs to the business model.

net_turnover.show_rows_without_amount: Show rows with no turnover as well
net_turnover.suggestion_binding: The suggestion is an aid, not a decision. Check it against what the company actually does.
net_turnover.suggestion_title: Based on the registered CZ-NACE activity
net_turnover.title: Net turnover: business-model revenue

settings.proforma_payment_document_hint: A tax document for the payment received is the default because it is correct unconditionally: the duty to declare VAT arises on the day the payment is received, and so does the duty to issue a document. Choose the final invoice only when the supply happens on payment (fast sales, same-day shipping or service) — otherwise the document claims a supply that has not happened and makes the customer's VAT deduction harder to prove. The "Nothing" option creates no draft; paid advances without a document are then listed in the daily tasks, because the document is due within 15 days.

settings.purchase_import_received_at_hint: Applies to every import format for received documents: AI import from PDF, ISDOC, ISDOCX, PDF/A-3, Pohoda XML, iDoklad, Fakturoid and the scan inbox. The document option takes the issue date, falling back to the tax point when the document carries none; a future date is never used. steps: In Shoptet open Settings → Orders → Documents → Document export and turn on Use the ISDOC format.
In the Tax documents overview click Export and choose XML (ISDOC), the period and the currency. Export Credit notes and Documents for received payment the same way.

steps: Generate the feed link below and copy it. It is shown only once.
In the Shoptet admin open Products → Import → Automatic imports and add a new import from URL.
Paste the link, choose the Shoptet XML format and pairing by product code. In the update import tick only Stock, and Price if you send it.
On MyÚčto product cards turn on export to the e-shop. The card code must match the product or variant code in Shoptet.

steps: In the Shoptet admin open Orders → Export and create your own XML template (or copy the system template Shoptet - XML). For CSV, enable exporting individual order items and the header row.

The template must contain the order code, date, currency and exchange rate, e-mail, billing and delivery address with country code, company ID, VAT ID, total price and items with type, code, EAN, quantity, price including VAT and VAT rate.
In Include orders choose All. MyÚčto keeps track of changes since the last download itself.
In Settings → Administration → Export security create a partner with a hash and allow downloads only from the IP address of the MyÚčto server.
Paste the permanent export link in the Settings tab, or download the export and upload it here as a file.

settings.url_hint: The link contains a hash that allows downloading customer data. We store it encrypted and show it only shortened. In Shoptet export security allow downloads only from the IP address of the MyÚčto server.

tax.pausal_unavailable: Not in flat tax / not possible — standard regime is used.
tax.pension_hint: deductible amount from the pension company's certificate (not the gross annual payment), deduction max 48,000 CZK
tax.social_secondary_cross: projected profit {profit} crosses it in {month} — you will pay social insurance

tax.verdict_pausal_hint: Flat tax wins. It flips to the standard regime once your credits (spouse, children, mortgage) exceed ~73,700 CZK.
tax.verdict_regular_hint: Your credits beat flat tax — the standard regime can push tax into a bonus, flat tax ignores credits.

taxReturn.advances_override_deleted: Decision removed, schedules recomputed from prediction.
taxReturn.advances_override_hint: Enter the new advance amount per the tax office decision (e.g. a reduction on request under §174). From its effective date, schedules are computed at this amount instead of the prediction and payment matching is measured against it — so a genuinely reduced advance matches as certain.
taxReturn.advances_override_saved: Advance amount decision saved, schedules recomputed.
taxReturn.advances_override_title: Tax office decision on advance amount (§174)
taxReturn.advances_suggestion_kept: Manual value in the return was kept (not overwritten) — bank suggestion: {list}. Verify and adjust manually in the Adjustments tab if needed.

updates.cancel_stuck_confirm: Clear the in-progress upgrade flag? Use this if you update manually or the watcher isn't running.
updates.cancel_stuck_hint: Updating manually via terminal, or the host-side watcher isn't running? Clear the flag so the state no longer shows as in progress.
updates.how_docker_desc: Clicking 'Update' writes a flag file `storage/upgrade-requested.json`. A host-side watcher (`cmd/docker-update-watcher.(sh/ps1)` as systemd unit / Scheduled Task) picks it up and runs `cmd/docker-update.(sh/ps1)` — pulling the new image, restarting the stack, running migrations. The result and log appear on this page.
updates.how_docker_setup: If the watcher is not yet installed, follow § 19.4 of the manual (systemd unit on Linux, Scheduled Task on Windows). Without the watcher, run on the host manually after clicking 'Update':
updates.how_native_desc: Clicking "Update" downloads the production bundle from the GitHub release (`myucto-X.Y.Z.tar.gz`), verifies its SHA-256, deploys it over the installation and runs migrations — no Composer or Node needed on the host, the bundle ships vendor, web/dist and the manual prebuilt. Configuration (`cfg*.php`) and data (`storage/`, `private/`, `log/`) are never overwritten and replaced files are backed up to `storage/updates/<version>/backup/`.
updates.how_native_manual: If the automatic path is unavailable (missing permissions, PHP CLI or disk space), deploy the same bundle manually:
updates.in_progress_desc: Flag file exists, the host-side watcher is processing it. The result will appear here when finished.
updates.in_progress_native_desc: A background worker is downloading the bundle, deploying files and running migrations. Keep the installation running — progress refreshes automatically.
updates.managed_desc: Updates are deployed by the operator so every instance runs the same version. They cannot be started from the application.
updates.no_admin: Updates are available to administrators only.
updates.no_check_yet: No check has been performed yet
updates.preflight_blocked: The automatic update cannot run right now:
updates.preflight_ok: This installation can update itself from the release bundle.
updates.queued_desc: Host-side watcher (cmd/docker-update-watcher.(sh/ps1)) will apply it. If the watcher is not running, run cmd/docker-update.(sh/ps1) manually on the host.
updates.step_backup: Backing up files the update will overwrite.
updates.step_download: Downloading the production bundle from the GitHub release.
updates.step_extract: Extracting the bundle into a staging directory and validating it.
updates.step_finish: Finishing — writing the new version and cleaning up.
updates.step_preflight: Environment check — permissions, free disk space, PHP CLI, extensions.
updates.step_swap: Deploying the new files over the installation.
updates.step_verify: Verifying the SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded bundle.
updates.subtitle: Check available MyÚčto.cz versions and upgrade
updates.title: Updates
updates.trigger_native_confirm: Update to {version}? The app will download the production bundle from the GitHub release, deploy it over this installation and run migrations. Configuration and data are left untouched and overwritten files are backed up. Having a fresh database backup is recommended.
updates.warning_app_url_hostname_conflict: The hostname from `cfg.app.url` is also stored as a company custom domain. Restore the former canonical address and disable and delete the custom domain, or configure another canonical hostname.
updates.warning_app_url_invalid_origin: `cfg.app.url` is not a valid HTTP(S) origin. Remove credentials, path, query and fragment; keep only the scheme, hostname and optional port.
updates.warning_app_url_missing: `cfg.app.url` is missing or blank. After setup, configure the application's exact HTTP(S) origin.
updates.warning_app_url_webauthn_incompatible: The regular UI can work over HTTP or a LAN IP, but passkeys require an HTTPS DNS origin. `http://localhost` is the only exception.
updates.warning_secret_key_text: Set `cfg.app.secret_encryption_key` to a 32B base64 value to avoid TOTP setup failures due to misconfiguration.
updates.warning_webauthn_text: Check `cfg.app.url`: it must exactly match the origin in use and use HTTPS outside localhost.

acceptance.confirm: I explicitly confirm that I verified the calculation and that the reference points to the verification record.
acceptance.revokeConfirm: I confirm the withdrawal of the acceptance; finalization, XML and filing will be blocked.
acceptance.adminOnly: Only the company administrator can change the acceptance.

nonprofitDppo.title: Nonprofit corporate income tax
nonprofitDppo.intro: Period legal profile, verified return evidence and use of tax savings.
nonprofitDppo.profileHelp: Select the legal entity type and tax status supported by evidence. Confirmation applies to the selected period.
nonprofitDppo.nonbusiness: The main activity under the founding legal instrument is nonbusiness.
nonprofitDppo.notReady: The return becomes available after the server verifies the legal profile and tax evidence.
nonprofitDppo.notRequired: Verified evidence does not require filing
nonprofitDppo.taxSaving: Tax saving calculated by the return
nonprofitDppo.savings: Use of tax savings under section 20
nonprofitDppo.savingsHelp: Assign an evidenced purpose to an eligible posted cost. The server verifies the cost selection and available amount.
nonprofitDppo.noSavings: No tax savings have been recorded.
nonprofitDppo.savingSource: Source tax saving and remaining amount
nonprofitDppo.void: The source tax saving is void.
nonprofitDppo.acknowledge: I have verified the stated facts and supporting evidence.
nonprofitDppo.retry: Verify and retry the same confirmation
nonprofitDppo.stale: The evidence has changed. Refresh it and review the new decision.
nonprofitDppo.error: Could not load or save the evidence.
nonprofitDppo.uncertain: The confirmation outcome is unknown. Retry the same request; its identifier and original evidence are preserved.

kinds.non_vpp: Other taxpayer outside public benefit status

nonprofitDppo.reductionHelp: Enter an evidenced reduction in the return draft. The server recalculates entitlement, statutory limits, tax and the actual saving.
nonprofitDppo.reductionUncertain: The save outcome is unknown. Verify the current draft. The same request can only be repeated against the original unchanged revision.

frameworkConversion.followup: The source closing includes a follow-up requiring verified adoption: reversal of a receivable/payable FX revaluation, method-B stock release or small-asset accrual release. Provide the original native entry and its exact role/cell mapping protocol for framework 504.
frameworkConversion.offbalance: Nonzero offbalance positions require explicit register adoption: account, legal title, dimensions and exact quantity of each item.
frameworkConversion.title: Controlled conversion 500 → 504
frameworkConversion.intro: The conversion follows an actual closed period. Each balance requires an explicit target classification. Historical statements retain their original framework.
frameworkConversion.subject: Taxable
frameworkConversion.definitionHelp: You confirm every target definition. Account identity and type remain preserved. New accounts are created only at the start of the next period.
frameworkConversion.name: Name
frameworkConversion.acknowledgement: I reviewed every cell, roles 931 and 932, activities and dated definitions and approve the displayed entry.
frameworkConversion.error: The operation could not be completed. Check the evidence and load a new preview.
frameworkConversion.stale: Evidence or permissions changed. Load and review a new preview.
frameworkConversion.uncertain: The connection result is uncertain. You may explicitly repeat the same operation with the same reviewed preview.
frameworkConversion.integration: Financial operations require verified owner protections to be integrated.
frameworkConversion.svj: An owners association conversion requires S6 evidence: units and owners, legal debt titles, service advances, long-term advances and exact reconciliation to every opening cell. A general ledger alone cannot provide this evidence.
frameworkConversion.subledger: This balance requires verified native evidence adoption: specific fund or grant contracts or individual securities reconciled to the general ledger.
frameworkConversion.sourceApproval: First approve the original financial statements and provide the competent authority decision.
frameworkConversion.consumed: The conversion has already been used or its dependent evidence changed. Cancellation is unavailable.
frameworkConversion.cancelAck: I approve removing the opening entry and only the definitions and catalog entries created by this unused conversion.
frameworkConversion.decisionReference: Evidence of the result appropriation decision
frameworkConversion.noManualIds: Accounts, periods and source cells are selected from verified server evidence.

svjGuide.title: Moving an owners' association to Decree 504
svjGuide.why: An owners' association does not convert balances from the general ledger. Its receivables and liabilities belong to specific units and owners, so they are taken over through evidenced opening balances.
svjGuide.newSvj: An association without accounting history (no journal entries and an untouched default chart of accounts) switches to framework 504 in Settings, Accounting framework section. A newly created association gets framework 504 and the 504 chart of accounts right away.
svjGuide.existingSvj: An association that already keeps accounts closes its last year under Decree 500, creates the following period under framework 504 and takes over the opening balances of units, owners, debts, service advances and long-term advances reconciled to every balance.
